plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: Force the model's internal reasoning to Simplified Chinese for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-thinking-zh

让 DeepSeek Harness 里模型的**内部思考（reasoning / thinking）使用简体或繁体中文**的提示词汉化包。

> 非官方插件，与 DeepSeek 无关。英文说明见 [README.en.md](README.en.md)。

## 30 秒看懂

| 你想做的事 | 怎么做 |
|---|---|
| 装完就能用 | 默认简体中文 + 严格模式，不用配置 |
| 确认已生效 | 日志出现 `dsh-thinking-zh: 已启用 — 简体中文 / 严格模式` |
| 在对话里查状态 | 输入 `/thinking-zh` |
| 换成繁体 | `config.language: zh-TW` |
| 放宽要求 | `config.mode: prefer` |
| 关掉 | `config.enabled: false` |

## 它做什么

- 向 DSH 的系统提示词注册一个固定段落（`dsh-thinking-zh:reasoning-language`），要求模型：
  - 内部思考与推理一律使用简体或繁体中文；
  - 代码、命令、路径、API 名、错误原文、专有名词保持原样；
  - 中文推理不得省略步骤、降低严谨度；
  - 只约束内部思考，最终回复仍按用户语言；
  - 用户在当前对话中明确要求换语言时，以用户要求为准。
- 只改提示词，不改 DSH 程序文件、不改 UI、不发网络请求。

## 安装

从 npm：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-thinking-zh
```

从本地 tarball：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:C:/path/to/dsh-thinking-zh-0.2.0.tgz"
```

然后确认 profile 的 `package.json` 里 `dsh.profile.bundles` 含 `"dsh-thinking-zh"`，**完全退出并重开 DSH**（包括托盘图标）。

## 配置

三个字段，全部可选。写错只会回退默认并打一条警告，不会让 DSH 启动失败。

```yaml
- id: dsh-thinking-zh
  name: dsh-thinking-zh
  config:
    enabled: true      # 默认 true
    language: zh-CN    # zh-CN | zh-TW
    mode: strict       # strict | prefer
```

| 字段 | 默认 | 可选值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | `true` / `false` | 关闭后不注册段落 |
| `language` | `zh-CN` | `zh-CN` / `zh-TW` | 繁体同时调整用词，不只是字形 |
| `mode` | `strict` | `strict` / `prefer` | `strict` 发现英文思考立即改回；`prefer` 只要求尽量 |

配置固定时提示词完全稳定，不会在请求之间抖动，也不影响 KV cache。

## 状态命令

在交互式 UI 中输入：

```text
/thinking-zh
```

返回当前是否启用、语言、模式，以及去哪里修改配置。没有命令服务的环境（如纯 ACP）会自动跳过，不影响提示词。

## 确认生效

日志里出现这一行就说明生效：

```text
dsh-thinking-zh: 已启用 — 简体中文 / 严格模式（order=6000）
```

关闭时：

```text
dsh-thinking-zh: 配置中已关闭，未注册提示词段落
```

注册失败时会有带修复建议的警告，例如检查 `cordis.patch.yml` 是否有同名段落。

## FAQ

**模型偶尔还是用英文思考？**
提示词只能引导，不能强制。保持 `mode: strict`（默认），或在对话里直接要求“用中文思考”。

**改了配置没生效？**
插件配置在启动时读取，改完需要完全退出并重开 DSH。

**会不会重复注册？**
段落名带命名空间前缀；同一作用域内重复注册会报错，日志会提示检查 `cordis.patch.yml`。

**支持繁体吗？**
支持 `zh-TW`，用词会一起调整（程式碼 / 檔案 / 使用者）。

## 卸载

从 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 与 `dependencies` 中删掉 `dsh-thinking-zh`，
再执行 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH 即可。它不写入任何用户数据。

## 目录

| 文件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主插件：配置、日志、段落注册、状态命令 |
| `lib/text.js` | 简繁 × 严格/宽松 文本模板 |
| `test/smoke.mjs` | 冒烟测试 |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | bundle 层：把自己插入 profile 的组合 |
| `package.json` | 包声明，`dsh.bundle.patch` 指向上面的 patch |
| `README.en.md` | 英文说明 |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | 版本记录 |
| `LICENSE` | MIT 许可证 |

## 安全说明

- 无网络、无文件读写、无子进程、无凭据访问；
- 只新增一段提示词，不覆盖、不删除任何已有段落；
- 段落名带命名空间前缀，避免与其他插件冲突。

## 兼容性

- 只用公开的 `ctx.systemPrompt.section()` 与 `ctx.commands`（可选），不 import 任何 DSH 内部模块；
- `inject = ['systemPrompt']`：服务不存在时插件静默不激活；
- 固定段落顺序 `6000`，不依赖未来可能改动的顺序表；
- 纯 ESM、零运行时依赖、无客户端（client）部分。

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

# dsh-pet 官方桌面端适配发行版（二次创作，非原创）

> **本仓库不是原创作品。** 它是桌宠 [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)（作者 **PC2005-cloud**，MIT）的**二次创作**，只做一件事：让上游桌宠在 **DeepSeek Harness 官方桌面端（Electron 版）** 装上、能启用、可管理。桌宠本体、动画素材、全部玩法与文档都来自上游，版权归原作者。 --- ## 📌 非原创声明 | 内容 | 归属 | | --- | --- | | 桌宠本体、106 段动画与素材、提示词、玩法（待机 / 漫游 / 拖拽抛掷 / 余额 / 碎碎念 / 对话 / 工作状态 / 系统通知 / pet pack） | 上游 **[PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)**（MIT） | | 官方桌面端适配层（`adapter/`）、组合包声明、上游产物同步与校验、安装 / 兼容 / 排障文档、测试 | 本仓库（基于上游的二次创作） | `vendor/` 内是上游 npm 发布版 `dsh-pet@0.3.7` 的已构建产物，`dsh-pet/assets/` 内是上游的动画与素材——本仓库没有、也不试图拥有上游的任何内容。按上游「二创约定」：任何介绍、展示、分发本仓库的地方，请保留上游作者地址 。 ## 🚀 安装（官方桌面端） 1. 桌面应用 → **插件管理 → 添加插件**； 2. 填本仓库地址： ```text https://github.com/zhuge886/DSH-pet-Deepseek-Official-Desktop ``` （等价 pnpm spec：`github:zhuge886/DSH-pet-Deepseek-Official-Desktop`） 3. 启用 `dsh-pet` 组合包，**重开桌面应用**。 默认只显示**一只**：窗口外那只透明置顶小窗（`display: desktop`）。想改成应用内 / 两只 / 不显示，见 [DESKTOP.md §12](DESKTOP.md) 或设置页「桌宠配置」。 ## ✅ 验证 桌宠加载后，DSH 自己的 Web 服务上会多一个只读接口： ```text GET http://127.0.0.1:/dsh-pet-desktop/health ``` 返回 `status: active`、`host.kind: desktop`、`upstream.applied: true` 即适配层与上游都已就绪（字段含义见 [DESKTOP.md §3](DESKTOP.md)）。 ## 📦 仓库结构 ```text adapter/ 适配层：宿主识别、运行时诊断、健康检查、失败降级 cordis.patch.yml 组合包声明（桌面端插件管理据此把它当插件） vendor/dsh-pet-0.3.7/ 上游已构建产物（免构建，SHA-256 逐文件校验） dsh-pet/assets/ 运行时素材（webm / 字体 / 表情包 / 默认配置） animations/webm/ 本仓库额外收录的动作素材（文件名即动作名） tests/ 清单、适配层纯逻辑、启动冒烟 DESKTOP.md 为什么需要、兼容矩阵、排障、版本记录 scripts/sync-vendor.mjs 上游产物同步与可审计补丁 ``` **不在本仓库**（都在上游）：`src/` 源码、素材生成链（提示词 + Python 脚本）、HTTP API 文档、生态清单、玩法与配置手册。 ## 🎞 额外动作 除了上游自带的 106 段动画，本仓库额外收录的动作放在 [`animations/webm/`](animations/README.md)——目录约定与上游一致（`webm/` 子目录 + **文件名即动作名**，VP9-alpha、640×360）： | 文件 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | [`animations/webm/非洲之心.webm`](animations/webm/非洲之心.webm) | 开保险箱、捧起钻石的 10 秒动作（用户自制，已去水印/去音频/抠成透明） | 装法、配置写法与转换参数见 [animations/README.md](animations/README.md)。 ## 🔗 功能、玩法、二次创作 → 去上游 - 功能与配置、动画与 pet pack、HTTP API、问题反馈： - 本仓库改了什么、兼容性与排障：[DESKTOP.md](DESKTOP.md) ## 许可 - 代码：MIT（上游版权归 **PC2005-cloud**；本仓库的适配改动同样以 MIT 提供） - 素材（动画 / 提示词 / 源视频）：允许开源使用，**禁止商用** - 二次创作：请保留上游作者地址 ## 版本 当前 `0.3.7-desktop.5`（基于上游 `dsh-pet@0.3.7`）。变更见 [DESKTOP.md §11](DESKTOP.md)。

DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. plugins.description: Offline/online import-export and migration for DeepSeek Harness: profiles, plugins, skills, hooks, boards
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-portable

**Offline and online export/import for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): pack a whole working DSH home into one `.dshpkg` file and restore it on another machine — no network, no `pnpm install`, no manual path fixing.**

[中文说明](README.zh-CN.md) · [CHANGELOG](CHANGELOG.md) · [PUBLISHING](PUBLISHING.md) · [HANDOFF](HANDOFF.md)

---

## Why

Moving a DSH setup between machines is painful for three reasons:

1. A working profile is not one file. It is `profiles/<name>/` plus plugins **with their `node_modules`**, skills, hooks, task boards, storages, `AGENTS.md`, installed runtimes, and session logs.
2. Plugins are installed by pnpm from the network. An air-gapped machine, a locked-down corporate laptop, or a machine behind a dead proxy simply cannot run `dsh plugin add`.
3. Configuration files embed absolute paths (`C:\\Users\\me\\.dsh`, `/home/me/.dsh`) and the profile name, so copying the directory tree produces a DSH that boots with broken plugin paths.

dsh-portable solves all three: it packages a whitelist of roots into a single self-describing archive, refuses to walk outside that whitelist, and on import rewrites the six configuration files that actually contain machine-local paths.

## What goes into a package

| Root | Path | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| profile | `profiles/<name>` (config **and** plugin `node_modules`) | always |
| skills | `skills` | always |
| skills-disabled | `skills-disabled` | always |
| hooks | `hooks` | always |
| storages | `storages` | always |
| task boards | task-board / todo-board storage | always |
| browser host | dsh-builtin-browser-host | always |
| agent instructions | `AGENTS.md` | always |
| sessions | session logs | opt-in (`includeSessions`) |
| runtimes | downloaded runtimes | opt-in (`includeRuntimes`) |
| credentials | `.credentials.yaml` | **opt-in, off by default** |
| source maps | `*.map` inside the package | on (`includeSourceMaps`) |
| backups | `*.bak-*` next to config files | off (`includeBackups`) |

Anything not listed is never collected — there is no recursive "copy the whole home directory" step anywhere in the code.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-portable
```

The plugin has to be registered in the profile's own `package.json` — under `dependencies` **and** `dsh.profile.bundles`. Copying the package directory into `profiles/<profile>/node_modules` by hand looks like it works, until that profile runs `npm install` again: npm treats an undeclared package as extraneous and deletes it, and from then on the panel still renders its cards while every request answers `404`. `dsh plugin add` (or `npm install dsh-portable` inside the profile) writes both halves.

Then open **DSH settings → Portable Migration** (便携迁移). The panel is registered at `settings.section` with order 70, and is bilingual (zh/en) automatically.

Nothing is written to the DSH home until you press a button.

## Using the panel

Six cards:

1. **Export** — pick which optional roots to include, name the file, press Export. Packing runs in a worker thread; the progress bar streams entry counts, and a 20 MB package over ~14 000 entries takes about 3 seconds.
2. **Packages** — every `.dshpkg` under `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-portable/exports`, with size, modification time and buttons: Select / Download / Share / Delete (delete asks for confirmation). *Select* marks a package for the Import card below; *Download* streams it to the browser so it can be saved to disk and carried to another machine on a USB stick — the LAN share is only reachable while both machines are on the same network.
3. **Upload** — drag or pick a `.dshpkg` and it is streamed to disk (`.part` then rename) with a live percentage, so a 2 GB package never sits in memory.
4. **Import** — pick merge or replace (the active choice is highlighted), press *Preview* first (zero writes), then *Run import* — which opens an inline confirmation before anything is written. The result is a small key/value summary: applied items, rewritten paths, backup folder and warnings.
5. **LAN share** — publish a package as a one-shot download link (`http://<lan-ip>:<port>/d/<token>`). Defaults: **1 download, 60 minutes**, Range/HEAD supported, 410 on expiry or exhaustion. *Copy* puts the link on the clipboard and only reports success when the clipboard really accepted it (a textarea fallback covers plain-HTTP origins). No relay, no cloud, no account.
6. **Backups** — the automatic pre-install backups (`<DSH_HOME>/portable-backups/<stamp>`), newest 5 kept. Each one has **Restore**, which copies its files back over the live tree after first saving the current versions under `<stamp>-pre-restore`.

## Screenshots

Taken from the DSH settings panel. The DSH home path and the LAN share link in these images are placeholders.

![Export card and package list](assets/panel-export.png)

![Upload, import, LAN share and backups](assets/panel-import-share.png)

## HTTP API

Base: `/dsh-portable/api`. All responses are JSON except the download route and the uploaded-file streaming route. Authentication reuses the host's `connection.requestRejection` fence (cookie + trusted origin), and falls back to a loopback-only check when that service is absent.

| Method | Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/status` | host info, package counts, active job, share server state |
| GET | `/profiles` | profiles present in this DSH home |
| GET | `/jobs` | recent jobs (export / preview / import) |
| GET | `/jobs/detail?id=` | one job with live progress |
| POST | `/jobs/cancel` | cancel a running job |
| POST | `/export` | start an export |
| GET | `/artifacts` | packages available for import |
| GET | `/artifacts/meta?id=` | manifest of one package |
| GET | `/artifacts/download?id=` | stream a package to the browser as an attachment (save it to disk) |
| POST | `/artifacts/delete` | delete a package (confirmed in the UI) |
| PUT | `/upload/<name>` | stream an uploaded package to disk |
| POST | `/import/preview` | two-phase install, phase 1 (zero writes) |
| POST | `/import` | two-phase install, phase 2 (`confirm:true` required) |
| GET | `/backups` | automatic pre-install backups |
| POST | `/backups/restore` | copy one backup back over the live tree (current files saved first) |
| POST | `/share` | mint a one-shot LAN download link |
| GET | `/share` | list live links |
| POST | `/share/remove` | revoke a link |

**Everywhere a package is named, the API takes an `artifactId` such as `exports:machine-20261018.dshpkg`, never a filesystem path.** `/`, `\\`, `..` and control characters are rejected, so neither the model nor a web page can use this plugin to read or write an arbitrary file.

## Model tools

Registered on the host tools service (silently skipped if the service is absent):

| Tool | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `portable_export` | package the current profile; returns id, size, entry count, per-root breakdown |
| `portable_inspect` | read a package manifest without importing |
| `portable_import` | **without `confirm:true` it is a dry run**; with it, performs the two-phase install |
| `portable_share` | mint a one-shot LAN link (1 download, 60 min) |

## CLI bootstrap (target machine without DSH)

```bash
# Windows
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File bootstrap\install.ps1 preview .\machine.dshpkg
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File bootstrap\install.ps1 install .\machine.dshpkg --yes

# macOS / Linux
sh bootstrap/install.sh preview ./machine.dshpkg
sh bootstrap/install.sh install ./machine.dshpkg --yes
```

Flags: `--home <dir>` (default `$DSH_HOME` or `~/.dsh`), `--profile <name>`, `--mode merge|replace`, `--keep <n>`, `--yes`. Exit codes: `0` success, `1` failure, `2` usage error. Without `--yes` on a non-TTY it refuses to write.

## Package format

`.dshpkg` is a gzipped tar. The manifest is the **first** entry:

```text
.dsh-portable/manifest.json
profiles/desktop/...
skills/...
hooks/hooks.json
...
```

```json
{
  "format": "dsh-portable/1",
  "createdAt": "2026-10-18T02:11:03.000Z",
  "tool": { "name": "dsh-portable", "version": "0.1.0" },
  "source": {
    "hostname": "WORKSTATION",
    "platform": "win32",
    "arc

# dsh-agnes-tools

**Agnes AI image & video generation as native [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) tools.**

`agnes_image` · `agnes_edit_image` · `agnes_video` · `agnes_video_status` · `agnes_models`

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

---

## English

A small, tool-only plugin: it adds five tools to the agent and nothing else — no UI panel,
no settings page, no runtime dependencies beyond the Schemastery peer DSH already ships.

### Why this one

Five Agnes plugins already exist, so here is the honest difference:

- **Video jobs are resumable.** `agnes_video` submits, polls, and downloads — but when the
  in-call wait runs out it returns the `video_id` instead of losing the job. `agnes_video_status`
  picks it up later and downloads the mp4. On a queue that is regularly full
  (`503 video_queue_full`), that is the difference between a lost render and a finished one.
- **`agnes_models`** lists the models your key can actually reach, so you can tell a bad key
  from a bad model name in one call.
- **Free-tier aware.** Retries with backoff on `503`/`429`, 6 s polling to stay under 20 RPM,
  and tolerance for the ~20 s window after submission where a status query wrongly reports 404.
- **Tool-only, zero runtime deps.** If you work in the chat and do not want a floating panel.

### Install

From the DSH plugin market, once listed — then restart `dsh web`.

<details>
<summary>Manual install (verified on Windows)</summary>

Add the package to your web profile and register it as a bundle:

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-agnes-tools": "file:/path/to/dsh-agnes-tools"   // or: "github:zuihouye/dsh-agnes-tools"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-agnes-tools"]
    }
  }
}
```

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" && pnpm install
```

Then restart `dsh web`. Host-side plugins are loaded at startup — there is no hot reload.

> Two traps worth knowing: `dsh plugin --profile web install` can answer *"Already up to date"*
> without installing anything, so run `pnpm install` in the profile yourself. And the hoisted
> linker **copies** `file:` dependencies, so re-run `pnpm install` after editing the source.

</details>

### Configure

`cordis.patch.yml` holds the defaults; override any key in your profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` or plugin settings.

| Key | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKeyRef` | `AGNES_API_KEY` | Name of the DSH credential holding your key. Recommended. |
| `apiKey` | *(empty)* | Inline key. Takes precedence over `apiKeyRef`. Not recommended. |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.agnes-ai.cn/v1` | Mainland endpoint. International: `https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1`. |
| `imageModel` | `agnes-image-2.5-flash` | |
| `videoModel` | `agnes-video-2.5-flash` | |
| `outputDir` | `agnes-output` | Absolute, or relative to the `dsh` process working directory. |
| `pollTimeoutMs` | `300000` | How long `agnes_video` waits inside a single tool call. |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `6000` | Do not lower it: the free tier allows 20 requests/minute. |

The key is resolved in this order: `apiKey` → the DSH credential named by `apiKeyRef` →
`process.env[apiKeyRef]`.

### Tools

| Tool | Required | Optional |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agnes_image` | `prompt` | `ratio` (1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 16:9, 9:16, 3:2, 2:3, 21:9), `size` (1K/2K/3K/4K), `save_path` |
| `agnes_edit_image` | `prompt`, `images` | `ratio`, `size`, `save_path` — `images` accepts local absolute paths, public URLs, or data URIs |
| `agnes_video` | `prompt` | `seconds` (`"4"`–`"12"`, default `"5"`), `aspect_ratio`, `mode` (`text`/`keyframe`/`reference`), `first_frame`, `last_frame`, `images` (≤5), `save_path` |
| `agnes_video_status` | `video_id` | `save_path` |
| `agnes_models` | — | — |

Files land in `outputDir` as `20261018-015926-jvic-agnes-video.mp4`.
Generated images are also attached to the reply when the host supports attachments.

### API quirks the code already handles

1. **`size` is a tier, not a pixel size.** Agnes takes `1K/2K/3K/4K` plus `ratio` — not `1024x768`.
2. **Images must come back as base64.** On the international endpoint the returned image URL
   lives on `storage.googleapis.com`, which is unreachable from mainland China. The plugin always
   asks for base64 instead.
3. **The video queue is often full** — `503 video_queue_full`. Retried with backoff (up to 6
   attempts, 8 s → 30 s).
4. **A status query within ~20 s of submission reports 404 "task not found".** The poll loop
   tolerates it.
5. **The free tier allows 20 requests/minute**; exceeding it returns 429. Hence the 6 s interval.
6. **Video size is always `"720P"`**; the real pixel size follows `aspect_ratio`
   (16:9 → 1280x704).

### Development

```bash
npm install && npm test        # loads the plugin with a mock context and checks every tool
```

Add `node_modules` to your profile and point `dsh-agnes-tools` at your checkout to iterate.

### License

MIT

---

## 中文

把 **Agnes AI** 的生图 / 生视频接成 DeepSeek Harness 的原生工具，一共 5 个，
纯工具型：没有悬浮面板、没有设置页，除 DSH 自带的 Schemastery 外没有运行时依赖。

### 和已有的 Agnes 插件有什么不一样

Agnes 生图生视频的插件市面上已经有 5 个，所以这里只说真实差异：

- **长视频任务可以续查。** `agnes_video` 会一次调用内提交 + 轮询 + 下载；但等待超时后它
  返回 `video_id` 而不是把任务丢掉，之后用 `agnes_video_status` 接着查、完成后自动下载 mp4。
  视频队列经常满（`503 video_queue_full`），这条差异决定了你是白等一场还是拿到成片。
- **`agnes_models`** 列出当前 Key 真能访问的模型，一次调用区分「Key 不对」还是「模型名不对」。
- **为免费额度调过参。** `503`/`429` 退避重试、6 秒轮询卡在 20 RPM 以内、
  容忍提交后约 20 秒内状态查询误报 404。
- **纯工具、零运行时依赖。** 如果你就在对话里干活、不需要悬浮面板，这个更干净。

### 安装

插件市场上架后可直接安装，装完**重启 `dsh web`**。

<details>
<summary>手动安装（Windows 上已实测）</summary>

在 web profile 里登记依赖和 bundle：

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-agnes-tools": "file:/你的路径/dsh-agnes-tools"   // 或 "github:zuihouye/dsh-agnes-tools"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-agnes-tools"]
    }
  }
}
```

```bash
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web" && pnpm install
```

然后重启 `dsh web`。host 侧插件在启动时装载，没有热加载。

> 两个坑：① `dsh plugin --profile web install` 可能回一句 “Already up to date” 却什么也没装，
> 直接进 profile 目录跑 `pnpm install` 更可靠；② hoisted linker 下 `file:` 依赖是**复制**不是软链，
> 改完源码要重跑 `pnpm install`。

</details>

### 配置

`cordis.patch.yml` 里写的是默认值，可在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 或插件设置里覆盖。

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `apiKeyRef` | `AGNES_API_KEY` | DSH 凭据里的引用名，推荐 |
| `apiKey` | 空 | 直接写 Key，优先级高于 `apiKeyRef`，不建议 |
| `baseURL` | `https://api.agnes-ai.cn/v1` | 国内节点；国际站是 `https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1` |
| `imageModel` | `agnes-image-2.5-flash` | |
| `videoModel` | `agnes-video-2.5-flash` | |
| `outputDir` | `agnes-output` | 绝对路径，或相对 dsh 进程的 cwd |
| `pollTimeoutMs` | `300000` | 单次工具调用内最长等待 |
| `pollIntervalMs` | `6000` | 别调小：免费 Key 只有 20 RPM |

Key 的解析顺序：`apiKey` → `apiKeyRef` 指向的 DSH 凭据 → `process.env[apiKeyRef]`。

### 工具

| 工具 | 必填 | 选填 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agnes_image` | `prompt` | `ratio`（1:1 / 4:3 / 3:4 / 16:9 / 9:16 / 3:2 / 2:3 / 21:9）、`size`（1K/2K/3K/4K）、`save_path` |
| `agnes_edit_image` | `prompt`、`images` | `ratio`、`size`、`save_path`；`images` 支持本地绝对路径、公网 URL、data URI，可多张 |
| `agnes_video` | `prompt` | `seconds`（`"4"`–`"12"`，默认 `"5"`）、`aspect_ratio`、`mode`（`text`/`keyframe`/`reference`）、`first_frame`、`last_frame`、`images`（≤5）、`save_path` |
| `agnes_video_status` | `video_id` | `save_path` |
| `agnes_models` | — | — |

产物落在 `outputDir`，文件名形如 `20261018-015926-jvic-agnes-video.mp4`；生成的图片在宿主支持时会一并作为附件回复。

### 代码里已经处理掉的 API 怪癖

1. **`size` 是档位不是像素**：Agnes 收 `1K/2K/3K/4K` + `ratio`，不是 `1024x768`。
2. **图片必须按 base64 取回**：国际站返回的图片 URL 在 `storage.googleapis.com`（国内不通），
   插件一律请求 base64，不依赖那个域名。
3. **视频队列经常满**（`503 video_queue_full`）：内置退避重试，最多 6 次，8 秒 → 30 秒递增。
4. **提交后约 20 秒内查询会误报 404**「任务不存在」：轮询循环里已容忍。
5. **免费 Key 20 RPM**，超了报 429，所以轮询间隔设成 6 秒。
6. **视频尺寸固定 `"720P"`**，实际像素由 `aspect_ratio` 决定（16:9 → 1280x704）。

### 开发

```bash
npm install && npm test        # 用 mock context 加载插件，逐个校验注册出来的工具
```

### 许可证

MIT

plugins.description: 保证 /tmp 清理守护进程常驻：进程内看门狗自动复活 + 兜底清理，附设置页（状态/配置/清理/演练）
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-tmp-cleaner

**[中文](README.md) | [English](README.en.md)**

DSH 插件：保证 `/tmp` 清理守护进程一直活着，并在「设置」里提供一个「临时清理」页。

- 启动时确保 `tmp-clean watch` 在跑；被 Android 杀掉后 **≤2 分钟自动复活**（进程内看门狗），
  即使守护进程一直被系统杀，到期的清理由 dsh 进程自己兜底执行；
- 设置页可看状态、改配置、立即清理 / 演练，所有请求走 `/tmp-clean/api/*`；
- 清理工具本体是零依赖 Python 3 脚本，命令行与设置页**共用同一份配置**。

## 仓库内容

| 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `lib/index.js` | 宿主半边：看门狗、`/tmp-clean/api/*` 路由 |
| `lib/client.js` | 浏览器半边：`settings.section` 里的「临时清理」页 |
| `bin/tmp-clean` | 清理工具本体（Python 3，零第三方依赖） |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 插件行声明（`dsh.bundle`） |
| `test/*.mjs` | 离线测试（假 ctx / 假 loader） |

工具默认从 `/root/dsh-bin/tmp-clean` 调用（`lib/index.js` 的 `TOOL` 常量）；
装到别处时改这个常量，或把 `bin/tmp-clean` 复制/链接到该路径。

## 宿主半边（lib/index.js）

1. web 启动（或 HMR 重载本插件）时调用 `apply()`：
   - 若 `watch.pid` 对应的进程**确实是 tmp-clean**（核对 `/proc/<pid>/cmdline`，防 PID 复用误判）→ 不动；
     否则 detached 拉起 `tmp-clean watch`；
   - 异常只写 stderr，不影响 web 启动。
2. **进程内看门狗**（每 2 分钟）：
   - Android 的 phantom process killer 会时不时杀掉 detached 子进程。以前只有重启 web 才会重新拉起，
     表现就是设置页一直「守护进程：未运行」。现在掉线后 ≤2 分钟自动复活；
   - 重拉本身有 5 分钟冷却，避免连环刷进程；
   - 若守护进程持续缺席 ≥3 分钟，且按 `interval_hours` 已到期，则由 **dsh 进程自己**执行
     `tmp-clean run` 兜底清理。
3. 注册路由（经 `ctx.inject(['webServer'], …)`）：
   - `GET  /tmp-clean/api/status` → `tmp-clean status --json --fast` + 日志尾（默认不扫盘，页面秒开）
   - `GET  /tmp-clean/api/status?scan=1` → 完整扫描 `/tmp` 实际占用（7–20 秒，仅手动触发）
   - `POST /tmp-clean/api/revive` → 手动拉起守护进程（带冷却）
   - `POST /tmp-clean/api/config` → `tmp-clean config set …`
   - `POST /tmp-clean/api/run` → `tmp-clean run [--dry-run]`

## 浏览器半边（lib/client.js）

以 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 手写 bundle 形式发布，
注册到 `settings.section` 槽位（id `tmp-cleaner`，order 60，标签「临时清理」）：

- 状态默认走快路径；「扫描大小」按钮才触发完整扫盘；
- 读取失败时给出原因和「重试」按钮（web 刚重启后常见，不必刷新整页）；
- 守护进程未运行时显示「看门狗 2 分钟内自动拉起」，不再是无解释的「未运行」。

## 配置

`/root/.tmp-clean/config.json`（命令行与设置页共用）：

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | true | 是否启用自动清理 |
| `interval_hours` | 24 | 清理周期（小时） |
| `max_size_gb` | 20 | 超过该占用就清 |
| `target_size_gb` | 10 | 清到该占用为止 |
| `min_age_hours` | 2 | 只删这么旧的目录 |
| `poll_minutes` | 15 | 守护进程轮询间隔 |
| `dry_run` | false | 演练模式（不真删） |

## 测试

```bash
node test/host-test.mjs     # 假 ctx：4 条路由 + 快/慢状态 + revive + CLI 读写往返
node test/client-test.mjs   # 假 loader：materialize bundle + 注册/渲染断言
node test/probe-web.mjs     # 对运行中的 web 探测（需有效本地 cookie）
```

## 安装 / 卸载

- 安装：把仓库放进 `/root/dsh-tmp-cleaner`，在 profile 的 `dependencies` 加
  `"dsh-tmp-cleaner": "link:/root/dsh-tmp-cleaner"`、`dsh.profile.bundles` 加 `dsh-tmp-cleaner`，
  建 `node_modules/dsh-tmp-cleaner` 链接，把 `bin/tmp-clean` 放到 `/root/dsh-bin/`，**重启一次 web**。
- 卸载：反做上述步骤，并 `kill $(cat /root/.tmp-clean/watch.pid)`。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：AI 短剧工作区（立项/总纲/人物/剧本/分镜/导出）+「短剧模式」Agent 预设（34 个 drama_* 工具、9 个随包技能）· AI short-drama workspace plugin for DSH
plugins.readme_text:
# AI 短剧工作区 · `dsh-plugin-ai-drama`

[![test](https://github.com/HengryLiang/dsh-plugin-ai-drama/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/HengryLiang/dsh-plugin-ai-drama/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-6f42c1)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

> DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件：把 AI 短剧的 **立项 → 总纲 → 人物 → 世界观 → 剧本 → 分镜 → 导出** 收进侧栏工作区，
> 并附带「短剧模式」Agent 预设——**34 个 `drama_*` 工具**、**9 个随包技能**、`/drama` 斜杠命令，
> 以及与 LibTV / NeoWoW 画布 CLI 对接的生成编排适配层。

> English: An AI short-drama workspace plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
> It ships a sidebar + main-panel workspace for the full short-drama pipeline, a dedicated `drama` agent preset
> with 34 agent tools and 9 bundled skills, a `/drama` slash command, and an adapter layer that drives external
> canvas CLIs (LibTV / NeoWoW) for image / video / voice generation. UI and docs are in Chinese.

---

## 它解决什么问题

写一部短剧，真正麻烦的不是「让模型写一段」，而是**让几十集内容彼此一致、可查、可交付**：
人物设定散在聊天记录里、伏笔写完就忘、分镜表和剧本对不上、改一集要翻十处、导出还要手工拼。

这个插件把短剧创作当成一个有状态的项目来做：

- **单一事实源**：结构化数据落在 `.aidrama/*.json`，`.md` 由它渲染，避免「两边同时改」的双写冲突；
- **落盘可恢复**：所有写入走「临时文件 → rename」原子替换，覆盖前留 `history/` 快照；
- **确定性检查**：一致性检查（人物/时间线/场景/道具等 7 类规则）不依赖模型，随时可跑；
- **生成物先入草稿区**：AI 产出先进草稿，用户采纳后才进正式稿；
- **生成编排不内建生成能力**：出图/出视频/出配音交给外部画布 CLI，插件只做适配、编排、回流与预算护栏。

## 能力一览

| 模块 | 能力 |
|---|---|
| 工作区 | 侧栏「AI 短剧」入口 + 中央面板（14 个页签），不遮蔽内置工作区浏览器，可与其它工作区插件共存 |
| 项目 | 新建 / 打开 / 重命名 / 删除；固定中文目录结构；全文检索；目录树子节点展开折叠并持久化 |
| 内容 | 剧集契约、分集总纲、人物设定卡、世界观、分集剧本、分镜表、本剧记忆（伏笔/已用桥段/时间线/待回收） |
| AI 能力 | 34 个 `drama_*` Agent 工具（仅在「短剧模式」会话注册）；检索增强；一致性检查；草稿区与采纳/丢弃 |
| 预设 | 「短剧模式」Agent 预设：短剧编剧/制片/分镜导演/合规顾问人格，**移除 shell 类工具**（工具白名单） |
| 技能 | 9 个随包技能：立项、总纲、人物、剧本、分镜、导演/镜头语言、润色、审读、导出 |
| 命令 | `/drama`（项目 / 进度 / 检查 / 草稿 / 导出 / 定稿 / 大纲 / 人物 / 世界观 / 剧本 / 分镜 / 润色） |
| 交付 | 导出 Markdown 全本 / JSON 结构化包 / CSV 拍摄用分镜表（UTF-8 with BOM）；定稿快照与回滚 |
| 生成（可选） | LibTV（主选）/ NeoWoW（备选）CLI 适配：规划 → 提交 → 收敛三段式；预算台账与闸门；产物回流登记 sha256 |

## 安装

要求：

- **DeepSeek Harness ≥ `0.2.0-rc.2`**（`engines.dsh` 会校验；桌面端与 npm 版 `dsh` 均可）
- **Node.js `^22.19.0 || ^24.0.0`**
- Web 界面（插件含客户端半，需要 `dsh web` / 桌面端的 Web 面）

插件是**纯 JavaScript、无构建步骤**（不需要 `prepare` / `allowBuilds`），三种安装方式任选。

### 方式一：直接从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:HengryLiang/dsh-plugin-ai-drama#v0.6.3
```

`<profile>` 换成你的 profile 名（`dsh web` 对应 `web`，桌面端通常是 `desktop`）。首次使用 `dsh plugin` 会自动创建 profile。

### 方式二：从 GitHub Release 的预打包 tarball 安装

```sh
curl -L -o dsh-plugin-ai-drama.tgz \
  https://github.com/HengryLiang/dsh-plugin-ai-drama/releases/latest/download/dsh-plugin-ai-drama.tgz
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-plugin-ai-drama.tgz
```

### 方式三：本地开发目录

```sh
git clone https://github.com/HengryLiang/dsh-plugin-ai-drama.git
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-plugin-ai-drama
```

### 验证安装

```sh
dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config    # 应出现 "# == dsh-plugin-ai-drama" 层
```

重启 DSH（或桌面端）后，侧栏出现 **「AI 短剧」** 图标；新建会话时预设选择器里出现 **「短剧模式」**。

> 卸载：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-plugin-ai-drama`。卸载**不会删除**你工作区里的 `AI短剧/` 数据。

## 快速开始

1. 重启后新建一个会话，在预设选择器里选 **「短剧模式」**；
2. 点侧栏「AI 短剧」→ 新建项目，输入剧名（会生成固定目录结构）；
3. 用对话驱动，或直接敲斜杠命令：

```text
/drama 大纲 都市悬疑，12 集，每集 90 秒，强钩子
/drama 人物 补全主角与反派，给出形象提示词
/drama 进度                  # 看当前阶段与关键事实
/drama 检查                  # 跑一致性检查，直接返回问题清单
/drama 草稿                  # 查看待处理的 AI 草稿
/drama 导出 csv              # 导出拍摄用分镜表
/drama 定稿 3                # 冻结第 3 集剧本与分镜为快照，可回滚
```

4. 在面板里可以逐页编辑：总纲 / 人物 / 世界观 / 剧本 / 分镜 / 记忆 / 草稿 / 定稿 / 账本 / 导出等。

## 「短剧模式」预设

预设以 Cordis YAML 声明（`presets/drama.patch.yml`），基于 DSH 随包标准预设改写：

- persona 换成短剧编剧 / 制片 / 分镜导演 / 合规顾问；
- **去掉 shell 命令类工具**（工具白名单）；
- 收敛子代理编排组，工具面聚焦创作；
- 追加隔离服务插件 `dsh-plugin-ai-drama/preset`：在该预设作用域内标记 `dramaMode`，
  主插件据此**只对处于短剧模式的 Agent** 注册 `drama_*` 工具，预设计未启用时工具不出现，切走自动回收。

预设同时通过 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` 的 `bundledSkillDir` 随包挂载 `skills/`，
所以「短剧模式」会话里 9 个技能自动可用。

## `drama_*` 工具（34 个）

| 分组 | 工具 |
|---|---|
| 项目 | `drama_list_projects` / `drama_create_project` / `drama_get_project` |
| 写入 | `drama_save_contract` / `drama_save_outline` / `drama_save_characters` / `drama_save_world` / `drama_read_episode` |
| 检索与上下文 | `drama_search_context` / `drama_get_progress` / `drama_save_memory` |
| 台词与素材 | `drama_get_dialogue` / `drama_export_voice_script` / `drama_list_assets` / `drama_add_asset` |
| 定稿与账本 | `drama_finalize_episode` / `drama_list_finalized` / `drama_get_ledger` |
| 导入与草稿 | `drama_import_script` / `drama_save_draft` / `drama_list_drafts` / `drama_resolve_draft` |
| 质检与导出 | `drama_check_consistency` / `drama_export` |
| 生成编排（阶段二） | 规划 / 提交 / 收敛 / 预算 / 绑定相关工具（`lib/tools.js`） |

工具全部是**确定性实现**（读写文件、结构化校验、检索、渲染），生成类操作交给 Agent 调用模型，
插件只负责把结果安全落盘。

## 随包技能（9 个）

`drama-setup`（立项）、`drama-outline`（总纲）、`drama-characters`（人物）、`drama-episode`（剧本）、
`drama-storyboard`（分镜）、`drama-director`（导演 / 镜头语言）、`drama-polish`（润色）、
`drama-review`（审读）、`drama-export`（导出）。

## 斜杠命令 `/drama`

| 输入 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| `/drama` | 用法 + 当前工作区项目与进度 |
| `/drama 项目` | 列出短剧项目 |
| `/drama 进度 [剧名]` | 阶段与关键事实 |
| `/drama 检查 [剧名]` | 一致性检查，直接返回问题清单 |
| `/drama 草稿 [剧名]` | 待处理草稿 |
| `/drama 导出 <markdown\|json\|csv> [剧名]` | 导出交付物 |
| `/drama 定稿 <集数> [剧名]` | 定稿某一集 |
| `/drama 大纲\|人物\|世界观\|剧本\|分镜\|润色 [要求]` | 交给 Agent 生成（会产生一次模型回复） |

两条纪律：**只在「短剧模式」会话生效**（其它会话返回明确错误）；**确定性操作不产生模型轮次**。

## 数据落盘

在会话工作区下：

```text
<工作区>/AI短剧/
  <短剧名>/
    剧集契约.md                 ← 由 .aidrama/contract.json 渲染
    总纲/分集大纲.md            ← 由 .aidrama/outline.json 渲染
    人物/人物设定卡.md          ← 由 .aidrama/characters.json 渲染
    分集剧本/第001集.md         ← 剧本正文（可直接编辑）
    分镜/第001集.分镜.md        ← 由 .aidrama/storyboard/ 渲染
    构想/ 世界观/ 台词与音效/ 素材/ 草稿区/ 定稿/ 账本/ 本剧记忆/ 导出/
    .aidrama/                   ← 机读源数据 + history/ 历史快照
  共享资料/                     ← 跨项目共享资料
```

结构化数据以 `.aidrama/*.json` 为唯一事实源；可见的 `.md` 由它渲染，**不存在双写**。
所有写入原子替换，覆盖前留 `history/` 快照（保留最近 20 份）。

## 生成能力对接（可选）

插件**不内建**图片 / 视频 / 配音生成，而是适配外部画布 CLI：

| | LibTV（主选） | NeoWoW（备选） |
|---|---|---|
| 形态 | 本地 CLI `libtv` 子进程 | 本地 CLI `neowow` 子进程 |
| 登录 | CLI 内完成 | API Key |
| 能力 | 画布 / 节点 / 上传 / 生成 / 下载 | 画布 / 节点 / 生成 / 轮询 |

统一接口 `available(ctx)` / `catalog(kind)` / `estimate(input)`，业务代码不认具体平台；
主选不可用时自动降级到备选。

生成编排拆成三段（避免长任务把一次请求挂住）：

1. **规划** `planEpisode()`：由分镜确定性构造逐镜提示词，不产生副作用；
2. **提交** `submitBatch()`：可部分失败，单镜失败不影响其余；
3. **收敛** `collectBatch()`：可反复调用，直到产物全部回流到 `素材/生成/` 并登记 sha256、来源、任务 id。

护栏：

- **预算台账** `.aidrama/budget.json` + 闸门，同一任务只计费一次；
- **上游冲突保护**：绑定检查 + 写入前指纹 + 写入后漂移判定；
- **双主防护**：以项目分镜为唯一事实源，按镜号对账画布节点，只报告差异、不自动改画布；
- **不假装**：账号状态来自 CLI 实测，产物状态必须见到真实文件。

## 架构

```text
dsh-plugin-ai-drama/
  package.json            # dsh.manifestVersion / dsh.bundle.patch[2] / dsh.client
  cordis.patch.yml        # 把主插件插入组合树
  index.js                # 宿主半：68 个 POST /api/ai-drama/<method> 路由 + 工具白名单挂载 + /drama
  preset.js               # 预设伴生入口：provide('dramaMode') + 挂载随包技能
  presets/drama.patch.yml # 「短剧模式」Agent 预设声明
  lib/store.js            # 项目仓储：原子写入、快照、结构化文档、检索、条目管理
  lib/drafts.js           # 草稿区：生成物先入库，采纳后进正式稿
  lib/consistency.js      # 一致性检查（确定性规则）
  lib/retrieval.js        # 本地词法检索（中文单字 + 二元组 + BM25 风格打分）
  lib/tools.js            # drama_* Agent 工具
  lib/backends/           # LibTV / NeoWoW CLI 适配层
  lib/generation.js       # 任务台账 / 预算台账与闸门 / 产物回流
  lib/guard.js            # 上游冲突保护与双主防护
  lib/orchestrator.js     # 生成编排：规划 → 提交 → 收敛
  lib/exporter.js         # 导出 Markdown / JSON / CSV
  skills/drama-*/SKILL.md # 9 个随包技能
  client.js               # 客户端半：侧栏入口 + 14 页签面板
  test/                   # 21 个测试套件，纯 Node 运行，无外部依赖
```

宿主半提供 `POST /api/ai-drama/<method>` 精确路由（请求头 `x-ai-drama-request: 1`），
客户端半只用浏览器模块表提供的 React，不引入额外运行时依赖。

## 开发与测试

```sh
node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check preset.js
npm test          # 21 个套件
```

测试全部是纯 Node 脚本，使用假 CLI / 假 React，**不需要 API Key、不消耗任何生成积分**。
其中「旧数据不变性」类断言在没有本地样例数据时会自动 SKIP，不影响公共 CI。

CI：GitHub Actions 上跑 Node 22 / 24 × Windows / Ubuntu 组合（见 `.github/workflows/ci.yml`）。

## 兼容性

- DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 及以上（`0.2.x` 线）；
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || ^24.0.0`；
- 宿主半跨平台；主要开发/验证环境为 Windows 11 + Node 24（

plugins.description: DSH plugin: sync model-catalog reasoning levels (reasoningEfforts) from what the provider advertises on /v1/models — sync_reasoning_levels tool plus a one-click button in the Models settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-effort-sync

把 **DSH 模型目录里的推理等级**与**供应商实际声明的能力**对齐。

> 宣传页：**https://dc1024.github.io/dsh-effort-sync/**（源码在 `docs/`）

两个入口，共用同一段逻辑：

- **设置界面 → 模型** 页尾部的「**同步推理等级**」按钮 —— 点一下就把供应商公布的等级补齐（本文档新增）。
- **工具 `sync_reasoning_levels`** —— 给 agent 用，默认 dry-run。

## 为什么需要它

DSH 自己做不到这件事，原因是契约缺一个槽位：

- **发现契约没有推理字段**：`LlmDiscoveredModel = { id, name?, contextWindow?, maxTokens?, inputModalities? }`
  —— 所以即使供应商在 `/v1/models` 里报了能力，DSH 也搬不进来。
- **推理能力只有一条入口**：`LlmResolvedModelInfo.reasoning`，而它来自适配器自报或目录声明
  （`reasoningEfforts`）。
- 结果：像 **magpie** 这样已经提供 `supported_reasoning_levels` 的网关，在界面上加完模型后，模型选择器里依然没有思考强度可选。

本插件读上游、写目录，补上这一段。写回走的是 `configEditor` —— **和设置界面同一条正规路径**。

## 界面按钮

座位是官方声明的加性扩展点 `settings.models.footer`（由 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-models`
声明），**不覆盖任何自带 UI**。按钮的工作流：

1. 读取每个往 `providers` 里声明的供应商（含手写 patch 层里的）；
2. 用 `credentials.resolve(apiKeyEnv)` 取密钥，请求 `<baseURL>/models`；
3. 把两边都有、而目录里还缺的等级写回 `reasoningEfforts`；
4. 在按钮下方直接列出**写了哪些模型、从什么变到什么**、以及哪些值被跳过。

一个供应商读不通只会被单独报告，不会挡住其它供应商的写入。

> 客户端插件（`dsh.client`）**需要重启 DSH 才会挂载**；host 半边的改动是热加载的。配置写入本身即时生效。

## 工具用法

```
用 sync_reasoning_levels 看看会改什么         # dryRun 默认 true，只报告差异
用 sync_reasoning_levels 应用（dryRun=false）  # 真正写回配置
```

参数：

| 参数 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `provider` | 全部 | 要同步的 provider key（如 `magpie`）；不传则同步所有声明的供应商 |
| `dryRun` | `true` | 只报告差异，不写（**界面按钮相反：点击即写**） |
| `noneMapsToOff` | `false` | 是否把上游的 `none` 档映射成 DSH 的 `off`（**按上游而异，默认不猜**） |
| `only` | 全部 | 只同步指定的模型 id |
| `replace` | `false` | 用上游列表**替换**声明（默认是加性合并；替换有掉档风险，见下） |

## 安全设计

1. **默认不写**：工具 `dryRun` 默认 true；界面按钮是显式点击，写完把差异回报给你。
2. **只写 DSH 认识的等级**：词表固定 `off / minimal / low / medium / high / xhigh / max`；上游多出来的值（如 `none`）只报告、不猜。
3. **保留既有 wire 拼写**：已存在的映射（如 `max: ultra`）不会被覆盖 —— 与设置界面同一规则。
4. **不动上游没广告的模型**：查不到的模型原样跳过，并在报告里说明。
5. **加性优先**：中转网关公布的档位常是上游能力的**保守子集**（实测 magpie 对某模型只报 low/high/max，而上游六档全收），所以默认只增不减；`replace` 需显式开启。
6. **不碰凭据**：只经 `credentials.resolve(apiKeyEnv)` 取值，不落盘、不打印。
7. **不整块改写供应商**：只写 `models` 这一项，并且是从**有效配置**（含下层）+ 本层已有内容重建的，不会把下层手写的 `apiKeyEnv`/`baseURL` 变成空值，也不会丢模型。

## 两个已知边界

- **`reasoning: false` 不代劳**：若上游对某模型标 `reasoning: false`，插件**不会**替你写 `reasoningEfforts: false`
  （那会让选择器消失，属于行为变更）。它只在报告里提示你手工决定。
- **`none` 档不猜**：见 `noneMapsToOff`。

## 自测

`node rehearsal.mjs` 用假 ctx + 假上游跑全流程（真实 HTTP 走的是本插件自己的路由），断言覆盖：

- dry-run 只算差异、**零写入**；
- 应用后写入的模型表**结构与拼写**（保留 `max: ultra`、新档用同一性拼写、不动无关模型）；
- 幂等（第二次点击无改动、无冗余写入）；
- 单个供应商读不通 / 缺密钥 / 无模型 / 未知 provider / 非 POST 请求的错误路径。

宣传页另有一条渲染自检（防止首屏空白与横向溢出这两类老坑）：

```bash
node tools/verify-site-chrome.mjs   # 无头 Chromium 直接经 CDP 驱动，输出截图与量测
```

它用 DevTools 协议量 `scrollWidth` / 元素可见性 / 溢出元素，桌面与移动各出一张全页截图，报告写在 `.verify/`。

## 安装

```bash
pnpm pack        # 产出 dsh-effort-sync-<version>.tgz
```

然后在 DSH：**设置 → 插件** → 安装 tarball（或 `plugin_manager install_bundle <tarball>`），**重启 DSH**。

> 升级务必 bump 版本号：DSH 按 generation 路径缓存已加载的 ESM。

## 改动记录

| 版本 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| 0.2.0 | 加界面按钮（client 半 + `settings.models.footer`）、`POST /dsh-effort-sync/sync`、逐供应商报告与容错、`replace` 选项、离线 rehearsal 与 `tools/pack.mjs` |
| 0.1.2 | 加性合并（只增不减）、多供应商同步、`tools/` 探针 |
| 0.1.1 | 保留既有 wire 拼写、跳过未知等级 |
| 0.1.0 | 首个版本：`sync_reasoning_levels` 工具，默认 dry-run |

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text: # dsh-dot **English** | [中文](#中文说明) Turn [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) into a **Dots / Grok-Bot-style always-on agent**: it has its own computer, you reach it over WeChat / Feishu / QQ / Telegram, it works on a schedule or when a page you watch changes, and it stops itself when the day's budget is spent. dsh-dot is mostly composition plus a few hundred lines of glue: | Layer | Plugin | Role | |---|---|---| | Its own computer | [dsh-computer](https://github.com/Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer) | microVM with shell, browser, live view, approval gates, audit log | | Reachable over IM | [dsh-bridge](https://github.com/wenbin-wb/dsh-bridge) | WeChat / Feishu / QQ / Telegram, card approvals, files | | Scheduled work | official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle` | daily / weekly / cron, survives restarts, wakes cold sessions | | Hard spending limit | [dsh-budget](https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-budget) | session / daily / monthly caps, `block` policy | | Glue | **dsh-dot** (this repo) | identity file, model-free page watching, silence protocol, budget → pause + IM notice, midnight reset | ### Install ```bash # dsh desktop (quit the app first) "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add \ github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer @wenbin_wb/dsh-bridge dsh-budget \ @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle ``` All five go in one command: dsh only layers bundles that are direct dependencies of the profile. Then set `overLimit: block` and a daily cap in **Settings → Plugins → Budget**, and connect an IM account in **Settings → Remote access** (dsh-bridge). --- ## 中文说明 dsh-dot 让 dsh 变成一个常驻 agent：**有自己的电脑、IM 上找得到、会定时和在页面变化时主动做事、花钱和危险操作有硬约束**。 北极星场景：在微信或飞书里说一句"每天早上看看 X 有没有更新，有就告诉我"。第二天到点，它在自己的电脑里打开网页检查；有更新就推到 IM，没更新就不打扰；遇到登录页推审批卡片，附实时画面链接；当天花费超限就自动暂停并通知你。 ### 一、安装 先退出 dsh 桌面版，再用**一条命令**装齐五个包。dsh 只把 profile 的直接依赖加进层栈，所以必须一起装： ```bash "/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime/cli/bin/dsh" plugin --profile desktop add \ github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-dot github:Kevinwu901113/dsh-computer @wenbin_wb/dsh-bridge dsh-budget \ @deepseek-ai/dsh-experimental-schedule-bundle open -a "DeepSeek Harness" ``` 命令行版把 `--profile desktop` 换成 `--profile web`，用 `dsh web` 启动。 ### 二、第一次设置 1. **预算**：设置 → 插件 → Budget，把超限策略设为 `block`，填一个日预算。不设的话 dsh-budget 默认只提醒、不拦截。 2. **IM**：设置 → 远程访问（dsh-bridge），连接微信、飞书、QQ 或 Telegram。建议开发送者白名单，只听你的。 3. **dot 的身份**：编辑 `~/dot/AGENTS.md`，写它叫什么、长期负责什么、你的偏好。在 `~/dot` 里开的会话会自动读这个文件。 4. **主会话**：在 IM 里和 dot 说一句话，或者在 dsh 里从 `~/dot` 新建会话。dot 会把定时提醒以外的主动消息（页面变化）投递到 IM 当前绑定的会话；没有绑定 IM 时，投递到 `~/dot` 里最近的会话。建议在 IM 里用 `/sessions` 切到 `~/dot` 的会话。 5. **公网实时画面（可选）**：按 dsh-computer README 用 `tailscale serve` 暴露实时画面，审批卡片里的链接在手机上才能打开。 ### 三、怎么用 | 你说 | 发生什么 | |---|---| | "每天早上 8 点看看 X 有没有更新" | agent 用官方 `schedule_create` 建任务；到点在虚拟机里检查 | | "盯着这个页面" | agent 把它写进 `~/dot/watch.json`；dot 定期抓取比较，不调模型；变了才叫醒 agent | | 发送 `/dot` | 查看 dot 状态：主会话、虚拟机、IM、预算、免打扰、关注项、积压事项 | | 发送 `/dot check` | 立即检查一遍关注项 | **静默协议**：被定时任务或页面变化叫醒时，检查后没有值得说的，agent 只回复 `DOT_SILENT`，这条不会发到 IM。 **预算**：dsh-budget 拦截后，dot 不再叫醒 agent，并在 IM 里通知你（模型不可用时直接发，不经过模型）；拦截期间的事项会攒着，解除后一并处理。日预算的拦截会在本地零点自动解除，第二天的定时任务照常运行。 **免打扰**：默认 23:00–08:00。期间检测到的变化先攒着，结束后再处理（官方定时任务不受影响）。 ### 四、配置 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖 `dsh-dot` 行的 config，或用环境变量： | 配置项 / 环境变量 | 默认值 | 作用 | |---|---|---| | `home` / `DSH_DOT_HOME` | `~/dot` | `AGENTS.md` 和 `watch.json` 所在目录 | | `mainSession` | 自动 | 固定一个主会话 id | | `quietHours` | `23:00-08:00` | 免打扰时段，空字符串关闭 | | `autoUnblockDaily` | `true` | 本地零点自动解除日预算拦截 | | `notifyWebhook` / `DSH_DOT_NOTIFY_WEBHOOK` | 空 | IM 不可用时的备用通知：飞书机器人、企业微信机器人、Server酱（`https://sctapi.ftqq.com/.send`）或任意接收 JSON `{title, text}` 的地址 | | `precheckSeconds` / `budgetPollSeconds` | `60` / `15` | 扫描关注列表、查询预算的间隔 | `watch.json` 格式见 `~/dot/AGENTS.md`。 ### 五、工作原理与限制 - **和 dsh-bridge 的衔接**：dsh-bridge 会把绑定会话里的所有助手回复转发到 IM，但没有对外接口。dot 在运行时包装了它会话桥基类的两个方法，实现静默、读取绑定会话、不经模型直接发消息。会先检测类的结构，对不上就关闭这部分并提示，退回 webhook。计划给 dsh-bridge 提 PR，把这三个能力做成正式接口。 - **必须有 dsh-computer**：没有虚拟机隔离，"放心不管"就不成立，所以 dot 依赖它，缺了就不启动。dot 的唤醒、预算事件都写进 dsh-computer 的审计日志 `~/.dsh/dsh-computer-audit.jsonl`（`kind: "dot"`）。 - **页面检查在本机发起**：用一个普通 GET 请求，不经过虚拟机。需要登录或 JS 渲染的页面看到的是空壳，这类页面请用定时任务让 agent 在虚拟机里看。 - **不做**：长期记忆、多个 dot、自我进化、自己的 IM 桥接或心跳框架。 - **需要电脑开着**：桌面版关窗口后仍在后台运行，但电脑休眠或退出 App 就停了；24 小时在线请部署到服务器。 ### 六、验证情况 在 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 上已验证（云端，Docker 后端，模拟模型）：五个包同装无冲突；`~/dot/AGENTS.md` 被模型读到；`schedule_create` 建的任务到点投递进 dot 会话；页面变化被检测到并叫醒主会话；预算拦截后 dot 发通知、暂停唤醒、攒着事项；零点自动解除并补发事项；静默、会话绑定、直接发消息在真实 dsh-bridge 类上通过单元测试。 待在真实 IM 上验证：飞书或微信里的审批卡片和回传；公网实时画面链接在手机上能否打开。 MIT License.
