# Rustvy (`dsh-rustvy`)

Русский | [English](README.en.md)

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-rustvy)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-rustvy)
[![загрузки](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-rustvy)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-rustvy)
[![лицензия](https://img.shields.io/badge/лицензия-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/тема-dsh--plugin-blueviolet)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Значки производителей в списке моделей DeepSeek Harness и список моделей, который
остаётся настолько же актуальным, насколько актуален сам провайдер. Один плагин,
одно зеркало, без перезапусков.

## Что он делает

У плагина две задачи, и обе работают от одного зеркала публичного каталога
провайдера.

**Значки.** Один монохромный значок производителя перед каждой строкой модели в
списке выбора — нарисованный так же, как его рисует собственная панель провайдера:
CSS-маска, заливаемая `currentColor`, поэтому один файл на производителя
обслуживает обе темы оформления и все состояния строки — наведение, выбор,
отключение — без цветовых вариантов.

| Где | Что появляется |
|---|---|
| Меню моделей в композере | монохромный значок 16 px перед каждой строкой модели |
| Кнопка модели в композере | значок выбранной модели перед её названием (14 px) |
| Всплывающее окно команды `/model` | тот же значок на каждой строке |
| Скины, перерисовывающие список (`dsh-claude-style`) | тот же значок; собственная плашка скина в этой строке прячется, чтобы две плашки не встретились |

**Список моделей.** Профиль подключается к стороннему провайдеру через вручную
объявленный маршрут `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`, и именно список `models` этого
маршрута определяет, что вообще можно выбрать в интерфейсе: harness предлагает
модель только тогда, когда её отдаёт маршрут. Список, написанный вручную, устаревает
в тот день, когда провайдер выпускает новую модель — новая невидима, а снятая с
публикации остаётся выбираемой и падает уже на запросе. Плагин читает, что отдаёт
собственный эндпоинт маршрута, превращает это в точный формат записей адаптера,
показывает расхождение с установленным списком и по команде записывает его обратно
через `ctx.configEditor`.

## Зачем это нужно

Потому что обе поломки маршрута, который поддерживают вручную, — тихие. Модель,
которую провайдер добавил, не появляется, и никто не говорит почему: ошибки нет,
есть только отсутствие. Модель, которую провайдер снял, по-прежнему видна, и её
выбор даёт сетевую ошибку, которая выглядит как проблема со связью, а не как
устаревшая строка в YAML-файле.

И то и другое лечится чтением данных у провайдера вместо их переписывания. Список,
который записывает этот плагин, несёт настоящие размер окна контекста, лимит
вывода, входные модальности и уровни рассуждения, поэтому модель, получившая
поддержку изображений или новый уровень мышления, описана верно в тот же день, а не
наследует запасное значение, которое кто-то когда-то угадал.

А поскольку значки берутся из того же зеркала, совершенно новая модель приходит уже
с кешированным значком своего производителя: зеркало перечитывает каталог в тот
момент, когда эндпоинт называет модель, которой оно раньше не видело, — то есть
ровно тогда, когда выходит релиз.

Ничего из этого не привязано к одному провайдеру. Сайт-источник, маршрут и строка
профиля — настройки; `https://rustvy.xyz` и `rustvy` являются значениями по
умолчанию.

## Установка

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-rustvy
```

Либо прямо с GitHub, если нужна самая свежая ревизия, а не опубликованная версия:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:koliy82/dsh-rustvy
```

Голый `koliy82/dsh-rustvy` без схемы не принимается: разбор источника установки
знает имя в реестре, git-спецификацию, tarball и абсолютный локальный путь, а
git-спецификации нужна схема либо сокращение `github:`.

Подтверждение сборки не запрашивается ни в том ни в другом случае: у пакета нет ни
install-скрипта, ни зависимостей, поэтому pnpm нечего собирать.

Из локальной копии этого репозитория:

```powershell
pwsh -File .\install.ps1
```

`install.ps1` копирует пакет в `<профиль>\node_modules\dsh-rustvy` как настоящий
каталог и дописывает имя в `dsh.profile.bundles` манифеста профиля. Работающий
harness подхватывает строку по изменению манифеста.

После этого один раз перезапустите harness или обновите страницу: значки и страница
настроек появляются на лету, а строка загрузчика читается на композиции.

### Маршрут, в который пишется список моделей

Значки работают без всего остального. Половине со списком моделей нужен маршрут
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`, в который можно писать. Добавьте в
`cordis.patch.yml` профиля — или отредактируйте в **Настройки → Плагины →
Конфигурация плагинов**:

```yaml
- id: llm-pi-ai
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai"
  config:
    providers:
      rustvy:
        displayName: rustvy
        apiKeyEnv: RUSTVY_API_KEY
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: https://rustvy.xyz/v1
        models:
          - id: placeholder
            name: placeholder
```

Список `models` обязан только разбираться: этот плагин его заменяет. Все остальные
поля при перегенерации переносятся без изменений, потому что переключатель
совместимости протокола или ссылка на учётные данные — это знание о вашем
развёртывании, которого нет ни в одном каталоге.

`apiKeyEnv` задаёт, откуда маршрут берёт ключ; он разрешается на каждый запрос через
механизм учётных данных harness — сначала унаследованное окружение процесса, затем
`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`, затем `.env` в каталоге запуска или в `$DSH_HOME`.
Сам ключ в конфигурационные файлы не попадает. Плагин при чтении списка моделей
подставляет ключ только тогда, когда окружение процесса уже содержит переменную с
таким именем; эндпоинт, под который он написан, отвечает и без ключа.

Чтобы сделать модель основной:

```yaml
- id: agent-default-model
  name: "@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model"
  config:
    provider: rustvy
    model: claude-opus-5-5
    reasoningEffort: high
```

### Как пользоваться

Откройте **Настройки → Rustvy**. Страница показывает, что держит зеркало, что отдаёт
провайдер и каково точное расхождение между ними. Кнопка **«Обновить каталог и
иконки»** освежает обе половины, **«Записать список моделей»** записывает
сгенерированный список. Без одного из этих нажатий не пишется ничего, если вы сами
не попросили об этом в настройках.

## Настройки

**Настройки → Rustvy**

Значки:

| Параметр | По умолчанию | Смысл |
|---|---|---|
| Показывать иконки моделей | вкл | общий выключатель значков; в выключенном виде убирает все значки и не трогает список моделей |
| Иконка в кнопке выбранной модели | вкл | значок и в кнопке модели композера, а не только в строках меню |
| Прятать логотипы других скинов | вкл | прятать собственную плашку скина в строке, где значок нарисован этим плагином |
| Размер значка, px | 16 | от 10 до 32 |

Список моделей:

| Параметр | По умолчанию | Смысл |
|---|---|---|
| Держать список моделей маршрута актуальным | вкл | общий выключатель; в выключенном виде YAML маршрута не трогается |
| Записывать список | при нажатии «Обновить» | `только отдельной кнопкой` — самостоятельно не пишет никогда · `при нажатии «Обновить»` — пишет по кнопке обновления · `сам, при каждом обновлении` — пишет и при фоновом суточном обновлении |
| Название модели | как на сайте провайдера | отображаемое имя провайдера либо сырой идентификатор |
| Предлагать уровень «без рассуждений» | вкл | добавлять уровень `off` рассуждающей модели, которая его не объявила |
| Оставлять модели, которые провайдер больше не отдаёт | выкл | сохранять установленную модель, которую эндпоинт больше не отдаёт, — на случай временно ошибочного списка, а не действительно снятой модели |
| Маршрут провайдера | `rustvy` | какой ключ внутри `providers` записывать |
| Строка профиля | `llm-pi-ai` | какая строка загрузчика его содержит |
| Сайт провайдера | `https://rustvy.xyz` | откуда читать каталог и логотипы |

plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 一键快捷输入（DSH Quick Send）

> 在消息输入框旁边放一排**可自定义的快捷指令按钮**，点一下就把预设文字直接发进当前对话 —— 省掉重复打字的时间。

标准 DSH bundle 插件：`dsh plugin` 一键安装，纯 JavaScript 无构建步骤，无需任何会话令牌。

---

## 它解决什么问题

和模型对话时，总有些话要反复打：

- 「继续」
- 「请总结当前进展」
- 「按方案 A 改，别动其它文件」
- 一大段固定的审查要求 / 代码规范

每次都手打一遍很费时间。这个插件把这些固定说法变成按钮，**点一下就发送**。

---

## 特性

### 一个按钮组，不遮挡任何内容

| 组成 | 位置 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 🔘 **快捷按钮** | 输入框**下方**那一行，默认在上下文进度**右侧** | 每个按钮一条指令，点一下即发送 |
| ⚙ **齿轮** | 紧挨快捷按钮，同一组内 | 点开是配置面板 |

整组走**正常流式布局**（不是浮层），所以**不会盖住对话正文**。

### 右键拖动换位置

**右键**按钮组即可进入移动模式（出现提示条 + 高亮边框）：

- 按住左右拖动，松开后**吸附到上下文进度的左侧或右侧**；
- 按 `Esc` 取消，不改变位置；
- 选择会记住（`localStorage` 键 `dsh-quick-send.placement.v1`），刷新后保持。

### 每条快捷指令都能单独定制

| 可调项 | 范围 / 选项 |
|---|---|
| **按钮名称** | 任意文字，显示在按钮上 |
| **发送文字** | 任意多行文本，即点击后真正发出去的内容 |
| **大小** | 字号 10 – 22px |
| **透明度** | 20% – 100%，可让不常用的按钮低调一些 |
| **模块化形状** | 方形 / 圆角 / 胶囊 / 圆形 |
| **顺序** | 上移 / 下移，可增删任意条数 |

编辑器里每条指令右侧的 **▶** 可以**直接试发**，不用切回输入框。

### 面板不会撑坏页面

配置面板渲染在框架级浮层 `shell.overlay` —— 它在所有列之上、**所有滚动容器之外**，因此：

- 不会被对话滚动区**裁剪**；
- **不会把页面撑高溢出**（之前的版本在输入框下方展开大表单就会溢出）；
- 输入框在屏幕下方，**默认向上展开**，空间不足时自动调整；
- 浮层本身点击穿透，只有面板自己接收指针事件。

### 不干扰你的草稿

发送走的是与官方输入框**同一条**客户端 API：

```js
ctx.sessions.binding(sessionId).session.prompt([{ type: 'text', text }], 'queue')
```

以 **queue** 模式投递文本，**不会写入草稿框** —— 所以你正在编辑的内容原封不动。

### 中英双语 · 主题跟随

内置英文与简体中文文案，跟随宿主语言切换；样式只使用宿主主题令牌（`--dsw-alias-*`、`--dsw-radius-*`），自动适配明暗主题。

### 配置持久化

快捷指令保存在浏览器 `localStorage`（键 `dsh-quick-send.shortcuts.v1`），
**无需 Host 桥接**，重启后依然在。默认自带两条示例（「继续」「总结」）。

---

## 安装

### 方式一：从 npm 安装（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add dsh-quick-send
```

> 把 `<你的profile>` 换成你的 profile 名，例如 `web` 或 `desktop`。

装完**重启 DSH**（或重载 Web 页面）即可看到按钮。

### 方式二：从 GitHub 仓库安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add github:1250589385/DSH-Quick-Send
```

⚠️ 两种方式是**同一个包名**，请勿混用；已经用 `github:` 装过想换 npm 名的，先执行
`dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> remove dsh-quick-send`。

### 方式三：本地目录安装（开发用）

把本仓库放到任意工作目录，然后：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的profile> add /绝对路径/DSH-Quick-Send
```

---

## 使用

1. **配置**：点输入框**右上角的 ⚙** → 打开面板
2. **增删**：面板顶部「添加」新增一条，「✕」删除某条
3. **编辑**：改名称、改发送文字、调字号 / 透明度 / 形状
4. **排序**：用 ↑ ↓ 调整按钮在下方那一行的先后
5. **发送**：点**输入框下方**的按钮即发送；或在面板里点该条的 ▶ 试发

发送成功/失败都会在触发器旁显示一行提示（例如「已发送：继续」，
或会话已关闭、内容为空的失败原因）。

---

## 兼容性

| 项目 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| DSH | 带 `conversation.input.overlay` / `conversation.composer.dock` / `shell.overlay` 三个 slot 的版本（0.2.x 实测通过） |
| 平台 | DSH Web UI（`"platform": "web"`） |
| Node | 仅安装期需要，运行时无 Node 依赖 |
| 构建 | **无** —— 直接加载源码，不需要打包 |
| 依赖 | 无第三方运行时依赖 |

---

## 工作原理（给开发者）

插件分两半：

- **Host 半边**（`index.js`）：仅 `export function apply() {}`，不注册任何 Host 能力，
  只让 bundle 解析出一个 Loader 行。
- **Client 半边**（`client.js`）：纯 JS，通过 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({...})`
  注册一个惰性工厂，内部用两个 slot 注入：

| Slot | 注册 id | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `conversation.composer.dock` | `quick-send-dock` | 快捷按钮 + 齿轮组成的整组，含移动模式与状态行 |
| `shell.overlay` | `quick-send-panel` | 框架级浮层中的配置面板 |

**为什么能排在上下文进度右侧**：宿主把 dock 渲染为
`[renderSlot("conversation.composer.dock")][ContextMeter]` 的居中 flex 行，
所以槽内容天然在 ContextMeter 左侧。本插件给按钮组加 `order: 1` 移到右侧，
再用 `margin-left: auto` 贴住行尾，使其与上下文进度相邻而不是漂在中间；
移动模式把 `order` 在 `0` / `1` 之间切换。

配置状态放在一个模块级 store（`useSyncExternalStore` 订阅），
由 `dock` 与 `panel` 共享，因此任一处修改在另一处立即生效。
面板位置通过齿轮的 `getBoundingClientRect()` 用 `requestAnimationFrame`
跟随（只在坐标真正变化时才 setState，空闲时零开销）。

**资源释放**：样式以 React `<style>` 元素渲染在组件树内，卸载即移除；
Escape / 外部点击监听器在 `useEffect` 中注册并返回清理函数，随面板卸载一并注销。

---

## 仓库结构

```
DSH-Quick-Send/
├── package.json          # 包清单：exports、files、dsh.bundle / dsh.client
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 插入 quick-send Host 行
├── index.js              # Host 半边（空 apply）
├── client.js             # 客户端半边：按钮组、齿轮、浮层编辑器、发送、拖动换位
├── locale/
│   ├── en.json           # 插件列表标题与描述（英文）
│   └── zh.json           # 插件列表标题与描述（中文）
├── icon.svg              # 插件列表图标（原创）
├── README.md             # 本文件
├── CHANGELOG.md          # 版本变更
├── PROVENANCE.md         # 素材来源与许可范围
├── LICENSE               # MIT
└── .gitignore
```

---

## 许可

代码与文案按 **MIT** 授权，见 [`LICENSE`](LICENSE)。
图标为原创作品，一并按 MIT 授权。详见 [`PROVENANCE.md`](PROVENANCE.md)。

---

## 致谢与反馈

欢迎提 issue / PR：<https://github.com/1250589385/DSH-Quick-Send/issues>

反馈问题时请注明 **插件版本、DSH 版本、系统与复现步骤**，并**勿粘贴密钥或未脱敏日志**。

plugins.description: Structured web search, page fetch and one-call research for DeepSeek Harness, powered by the official DeepSeek Search/Fetch API.
plugins.readme_text:
# @vfvrpq/dsh-search

DeepSeek 官方 Search / Fetch 接口的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：三个工具、一个配置项、零运行时依赖。

给 agent 的是**结构化**网页结果——rerank 分、权威度、发布时间、模型友好长摘要——而不是一坨 HTML。
比内置 `web_search` / `web_fetch` 多出来的东西：搜索语法、条数与正文可控、成本可推算。

## 装

```sh
# 从 npm（已发布版本）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @vfvrpq/dsh-search@0.1.0

# 或从源码包（插件 import 了 @deepseek-ai/*，必须走 tgz，目录软链会让宿主包解析不到）
pnpm pack
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /绝对路径/vfvrpq-dsh-search-0.1.0.tgz
```

装完工具即出现在工具表里，**不用重启**（升级才需要重启）。

## 三个工具

| 工具 | 干什么 | 计费请求数 |
|---|---|---|
| `deepseek_search` | 搜索，返回标题/URL/snippet/summary/可选正文/日期/权威度/rerank 分 | 1 |
| `deepseek_fetch` | 单页转 Markdown（标题 + 正文） | 1 |
| `deepseek_research` | 搜索 + 抓前 N 页正文，一次给结论 | 1 + N |

`deepseek_search` 支持的操作符，写在 `query` 里或用参数：`site:`、`-site:`、`-词`、`-"短语"`、`"精确"`、`lang:`、`after:`、`before:`。

```text
deepseek_search  query="llama.cpp 安装" site="github.com" after=2025 count=5
deepseek_fetch   url="https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/guides/search"
deepseek_research query="DeepSeek V4 上下文长度" count=5 top=2
```

判读口径：`rerankScore >= 1.5` 为优质（渲染里标 ★），`authority >= 3` 为高权威。
`summary` 是二手摘要，版本号/日期/价格/API 字段一律 `deepseek_fetch` 原文核实；引用给原始 URL。

## 配置

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `apiKey` | `""` | 空则运行时按下面四层解析，**不要把 key 写进 profile** |
| `baseUrl` | `https://api.deepseek.com` | 仅兼容代理时才改 |
| `defaultCount` | `5` | 调用没给 `count` 时的条数 |
| `maxContentChars` | `8000` | `deepseek_search` 每条正文上限 |
| `fetchMaxChars` | `20000` | `deepseek_fetch` 正文上限 |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | 单请求超时 |
| `maxRetries` | `2` | 408 / 429 / 5xx 重试次数 |
| `promptEnabled` | `true` | 是否向系统提示贡献用法章节 |
| `promptOrder` | `55` | 该章节排序 |

key 解析顺序（**key 不落 profile**）：

1. 插件配置 `apiKey`
2. `$DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`
3. `~/.secrets/keys.env` 里的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=...`
4. `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: sk-...`

## 成本

- 5 元 / 1000 次成功请求 ≈ **0.005 元 / 次**；Search 与 Fetch 同价。
- 只有 HTTP 200 且产生结果才计费；空结果、失败、超时不计费。
- `count` 不影响单价——一次取够，别拆成多次小请求。
- 限速：Search 与 Fetch **各自** 5 QPS（账号级）；超过抛 429，插件按退避重试。

## 结构

```
lib/index.js     入口：只接线（校验配置、持有 client、注册工具、贡献提示章节）
lib/config.js    Config schema + 代码侧默认值 + 加载期校验
lib/keys.js      四层 key 解析
lib/query.js     query 拼装与 site: 展开
lib/client.js    HTTP：超时 / 重试 / 错误翻译
lib/format.js    结果归一化与渲染
lib/prompt.js    系统提示章节
lib/tools/       一能力一文件（search / fetch / research / shared）
```

## 开发

```sh
node --test test/*.test.js     # 单测：mock fetch，不联网、不花钱
node scripts/live-selftest.js  # 真机自测：1 次搜索 + 1 次抓取（约 0.01 元）
```

## 已知边界

- 抓不了需要登录态、点击交互、或返回非 HTML 的页面 → 用浏览器自动化插件。
- SPA 文档站可能对不存在的路径返回 200 + 站点壳内容而不是 404；正文里出现首页标语即说明是 fallback。
- Fetch 返回的 Markdown 会把 `\/`、`\.`、`\#` 等标点反斜杠转义，属上游产物，按需 unescape。

## License

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: Full-screen SAO-inspired startup animation for DeepSeek Harness with adjustable beam, dial, language and character settings. Original high-fidelity rendering by default; optional compatibility mode for low-end GPUs and a tunnel-only intro.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH SAO Link Start

[中文](#中文说明) · [English](#english)

An unofficial, procedural recreation of an SAO-style login sequence for
DeepSeek Harness. It plays as a full-screen overlay when the Harness UI starts,
then removes itself automatically.

The plugin contains no anime footage, images, fonts, or game assets. Its tunnel,
HUD dials, panels, and sound cues are generated with Canvas, CSS, SVG, and Web
Audio.

| Beam tunnel | Character confirmation |
| --- | --- |
| ![Perspective beam tunnel](media/beam-tunnel.png) | ![Character confirmation dialog](media/character-dialog.png) |

## English

### Features

- Perspective capsule-beam tunnel with near-camera clipping to prevent flashes.
- Five animated cyan HUD dials followed by language, login, and character
  registration panels.
- A dedicated **Settings → SAO Link Start** page.
- Adjustable beam speed, beam length, beam density, and HUD dial size.
- Editable language and character labels; defaults are `Japanese` and
  `Kirito(M)`.
- Click or press `Escape` to skip. Press `Ctrl+Alt+L` to replay while the
  Harness page has keyboard focus.
- Respects reduced-motion preferences.
- The original rendering path is the default; an optional **Compatibility mode**
  (off by default) gives low-end GPUs a compositor-friendly fallback; see
  [Compatibility mode](#compatibility-mode).
- An optional **Tunnel only** intro (off by default) that plays just the beam
  fly-through and skips the rest; see [Tunnel only](#tunnel-only).

### Install

Replace `desktop` with the profile you use:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:liyansong0015/dsh-sao-link-start
```

Restart Harness after installation. Open the account menu, choose **Settings**,
then select **SAO Link Start** in the left navigation.

### Configuration

| Field | Range/default | Effect |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Beam speed | `0.4–2.5`, default `1` | Fly-through speed |
| Beam length | `0.4–2.5`, default `1` | Capsule trail length |
| Beam density | `0.4–2`, default `1` | Number of visible beams |
| Dial size | `0.35–1.2`, default `0.65` | Scale of the five HUD dials |
| Language name | default `Japanese` | Label beside the Language pill |
| Character name | default `Kirito(M)` | Name in the registration dialog |
| Compatibility mode | off by default | Low-end GPU fallback that avoids per-frame layout; see below |
| Tunnel only | off by default | Play just the beam fly-through; see below |

Save settings and restart Harness to preview the new values.

### Compatibility mode

**Settings → SAO Link Start → Compatibility mode** is **off by default**: the
default state uses the original 1.3.x rendering, i.e. the high-fidelity
performance path (2x device pixel ratio, exact per-frame layout). Both states
look identical.

Check the box only when the overlay stutters (typically on integrated or older
GPUs). The fallback then keeps the overlay out of the layout pipeline:

- the five HUD dials animate with a compositor-only `transform: scale()` on a
  fixed 200×200 box instead of rewriting `width`/`height`/`font-size` every frame;
- per-dial style writes are cached, so `filter`, `z-index`, and the chip text are
  only written when they actually change;
- the beam canvas caps the device pixel ratio at 1.5 and falls back to 1x with
  fewer capsule details when frame times stay long;
- the `AudioContext` is created on the first user gesture, and sound cues that
  would already be in the past are skipped instead of replayed late.

The choice is stored in the page's `localStorage`
(`dsh:sao-link-start:compatibility-mode`) and applies on the next replay
(`Ctrl+Alt+L`) or the next Harness start; toggling it does not require a restart.

Measured with a replay-isolated headless Chromium run of one overlay
(`Ctrl+Alt+L`, same environment), original → compatibility: layout count
37 → 9, layout time 0.087 s → 0.028 s, style-recalculation time
0.979 s → 0.252 s.

### Tunnel only

**Settings → SAO Link Start → Tunnel only** is **off by default**. Check it to
play just the perspective beam fly-through and skip everything after it:

- the five-sense HUD dials, the language pill, the login panel and the character
  registration dialog are not rendered at all;
- the overlay fades out at ~3.7 s and unmounts at ~4.3 s instead of 14.4 s;
- only the opening whoosh and a short exit whoosh play — no dial/panel cues;
- the beam/dial/language settings above only affect the full sequence.

The preference is stored in `localStorage`
(`dsh:sao-link-start:tunnel-only`) and applies on the next replay
(`Ctrl+Alt+L`) or the next Harness start. Compatibility mode and Tunnel only are
independent: if the full sequence stutters, use Compatibility mode.

### Permissions and network use

The plugin adds a startup overlay and a settings section. It does not request
credentials, read conversations or workspace files, or make network requests.

## 中文说明

这是一个非官方的 DeepSeek Harness 启动动画插件，以程序绘制方式重现
SAO 风格的登录流程。Harness 界面启动时会显示全屏动画，播放结束后自动卸载。

插件不包含动画原片、图片、字体或游戏素材。光束隧道、HUD 圆盘、界面和音效均由
Canvas、CSS、SVG 与 Web Audio 实时生成。

### 功能

- 带近相机裁剪的透视胶囊光束隧道，避免光束穿过镜头时闪屏。
- 五个青色 HUD 圆盘，以及语言、登录、角色确认界面。
- 独立的 **设置 → SAO 连结开始动画** 页面。
- 可调光束速度、光束长度、光束数量与圆盘大小。
- 可编辑语言名称和人物名称，默认分别为 `Japanese` 与 `Kirito(M)`。
- 点击画面或按 `Escape` 跳过；Harness 页面获得键盘焦点时，可按
  `Ctrl+Alt+L` 重播。
- 支持系统的减少动态效果偏好。
- 默认使用原版渲染（即性能模式）；另提供可选的**兼容模式**（默认关闭），
  给核显/低配机器一个更省主线程的回退路径；见[兼容模式](#兼容模式)。
- 可选**仅光束穿行**片头（默认关闭）：只播放光束穿行，跳过后面所有动画；
  见[仅光束穿行](#仅光束穿行)。

### 安装

把 `desktop` 换成你实际使用的配置名称：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:liyansong0015/dsh-sao-link-start
```

安装后重启 Harness。从账号菜单打开**设置**，在左侧选择
**SAO 连结开始动画**即可调节参数。

### 兼容模式

**设置 → SAO 连结开始动画 → 兼容模式**，**默认关闭**：默认状态就是原版渲染，
也就是性能模式（2x DPR、逐帧精确布局），两种状态画面完全一致。

只有在动画卡顿时（常见于核显/较旧的 GPU）才需要勾选。开启后改用合成器友好的
精简路径：

- 五块 HUD 圆盘改为对固定 200×200 盒子做合成器 `transform: scale()`，
  不再每帧重写 `width`/`height`/`font-size`；
- 每个圆盘的样式写入会做缓存，`filter`、`z-index` 与 chip 文本只在真正变化时写入；
- 光束 canvas 的 device pixel ratio 上限为 1.5，帧时间持续偏长时自动降到 1x
  并减少胶囊细节；
- `AudioContext` 延迟到首个用户手势才创建，已经错过的音效不再补播。

选择保存在页面 `localStorage`（`dsh:sao-link-start:compatibility-mode`），
在下次重播（`Ctrl+Alt+L`）或下次启动 Harness 时生效——单纯切换开关不需要重启。

实测（重放隔离的无头 Chromium，一次完整动画，同一环境，原版 → 兼容模式）：
布局次数 37 → 9，布局耗时 0.087 s → 0.028 s，样式重算耗时 0.979 s → 0.252 s。

### 仅光束穿行

**设置 → SAO 连结开始动画 → 仅光束穿行**，**默认关闭**。勾选后只播放最前面的
透视光束穿行，后面全部跳过：

- 五感 HUD 圆盘、语言标签、登录面板、角色注册界面对话框完全不渲染；
- 遮罩约 3.7 秒开始淡出、约 4.3 秒卸载（完整序列是 14.4 秒）；
- 只保留开场音效和一段收尾音效，没有圆盘/面板提示音；
- 上面的光束/圆盘/语言参数只影响完整序列。

选择保存在 `localStorage`（`dsh:sao-link-start:tunnel-only`），
在下次重播（`Ctrl+Alt+L`）或下次启动 Harness 时生效。兼容模式与仅光束穿行是
两个独立开关：完整序列卡顿时再开兼容模式。

### 权限与联网

插件只注册启动遮罩和设置栏目，不读取对话或工作区文件，不请求凭据，也不会发起
网络请求。

## Attribution

The beam concept and palette were adapted from
[unixzii/SAOLinkStart](https://github.com/unixzii/SAOLinkStart), released under
The Unlicense. This project is also released under The Unlicense.

Sword Art Online and related names are trademarks of their respective owners.
This fan project is not affiliated with or endorsed by the rights holders.

plugins.description: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Claude Code 风格终端界面，支持 Windows、macOS 与 Linux，兼容透明终端、VS Code 主题和自定义配色。
plugins.readme_text:
> **Release compatibility:** The current tested Host is official `0.2.0-rc.2`. SeekTTY `1.3.0` is paired with that Host. See the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md) for changes and installation, and the [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md) for exact package evidence.

SeekTTY

A terminal workspace for DeepSeek Harness.

Overview · Quick start · Clarify and Plan · Features · Compatibility

English · 中文

--- ## Overview Run `deepseek` from a project directory to use the native Agent, Session, model, permission, Settings, Profile, plugin, and persistence services of [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) in one terminal workspace. SeekTTY is the terminal surface; Harness remains the owner of runtime state. Models, Providers, Agent Presets, permissions, commands, tools, Settings, Skills, MCP servers, and marketplace sources are discovered from the running Harness. Capabilities added by upstream or third-party Bundles therefore appear without being hard-coded into SeekTTY. For requirements that still need definition, the optional [Clarify Host plugin](https://github.com/Hilbert-beinghappy/dsh-plugin-clarify) adds a guided `/clarify` workflow. It asks focused questions, updates a reviewable Draft after each answer, and returns the accepted Draft to the composer. Harness-native `/plan` can then turn the submitted requirement into an implementation plan. ## Development checkout Build and install a local SeekTTY package from the repository root: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile pnpm run build pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false ./seektty-1.3.0.tgz dsh --profile tui ``` Use the local tarball for source development and testing. For the released package, use the exact npm version below. ## Quick start Install the published SeekTTY release on its verified official DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2`: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.0-rc.2 dsh plugin --profile tui add --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 dsh --profile tui ``` These commands install the prebuilt Bundle through native `dsh plugin` reconciliation. The per-command pnpm option avoids the pnpm 11 Global Virtual Store layout that the Cordis loader in the currently tested dsh releases cannot reliably load. SeekTTY never changes global pnpm configuration. Clarify and Auxiliary Runtime are optional, not default dependencies; their historical joint acceptance is listed under [Compatibility](#compatibility-and-verification). The exact `seektty@1.3.0` npm package is documented in the [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### Bare `deepseek` launcher After installing `dsh`, install the same SeekTTY release globally and pin Profile reconciliation to its exact npm version: ```sh pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false seektty@1.3.0 export SEEKTTY_SPEC=seektty@1.3.0 deepseek ``` PowerShell uses the same exact npm spec: ```powershell pnpm add --global --config.enable-global-virtual-store=false 'seektty@1.3.0' $env:SEEKTTY_SPEC='seektty@1.3.0' deepseek ``` `deepseek` requires `dsh` on `PATH`, or `DSH_BIN` pointing to its executable. Common launch forms include: ```sh deepseek "check this project" deepseek --cwd ../project deepseek --resume deepseek --resume deepseek --profile team-tui deepseek --version deepseek --update ``` `deepseek --update` is self-first: it checks SeekTTY before dsh, installs at most one compatible component per run, and never installs an untested gap or future Host. `DSH_BIN`, local installs, and `SEEKTTY_SPEC` overrides are left unchanged. Update failures do not block startup. Set `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=check` for a post-session notice or `SEEKTTY_UPDATE=0` to disable checks. SeekTTY `1.3.0` supports official dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` and brings more native workflows into the terminal. See the bilingual [release notes](docs/release-v1.3.0.md), [complete PR audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md), and [verification record](docs/release-v1.3.0-verification.md). ### What's new in 1.3.0 - Access native Session actions, plans and artifacts, MCP resources, Team information, schedules, timed/continued questions, and account/model information from the terminal. - Browse Host workspace files with text/binary views and available file watching. Plugins can add terminal Session actions and guarded draft input activities with undo. - Install optional Creator, Browser, or Computer companion Bundles when you need them. With the official voice-input Bundle enabled, `/speech wav` provides reviewed WAV transcription; it does not record from the microphone. - Fix current-Host preset/forms/tool-result handling, stale targets, approval display, watcher cleanup, and bounded shutdown. Keep native Harness ownership and the existing terminal workflows. The release notes also fill gaps in the `1.2.6` summary: Agent Tree navigation, semantic transcript copying, target-specific context menus, Provider configuration, VS Code theme discovery, independent appearance controls, native scrollback, and long-session rendering fixes. Those features were already shipped; the [audit](docs/release-v1.3.0-pr-audit.md) identifies their original PRs and versions. ## Interface | DeepSeek light | DeepSeek dark | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek light start screen](assets/seektty-tui.png) | ![SeekTTY DeepSeek dark start screen](assets/seektty-tui-dark.png) | | TypeScript in the light interface | Tools, file reads, and Diff in the dark interface | | --- | --- | | ![SeekTTY light TypeScript syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-light.png) | ![SeekTTY dark tool and Diff syntax highlighting](assets/seektty-code-dark.png) | Full mode uses a fixed alternate-screen viewport and keeps the composer and status at the bottom. Its mouse support browses history, selects text, and clicks existing controls inside SeekTTY. F3 or `/mouse native` switches while idle to terminal-native mode: SeekTTY leaves the alternate screen, writes the complete loaded conversation to ordinary terminal scrollback, disables mouse reporting, and lets the terminal or tmux own scrolling, search, and selection. Backfill is sequential and reports progress; Esc stops it without stopping the Session, while Ctrl+L refreshes only the active tail. `/transcript` opens transcript browsing and `/transcript replay` explicitly writes the available conversation again. Images use a textual attachment row in native mode. Already-written history is not recolored or reflowed by SeekTTY; the terminal owns that history. An empty session now opens with a responsive Fastfetch-style welcome page rather than sendable task suggestions. The default uses a packaged, original-color DeepSeek pixel whale plus runtime facts from the current Profile; it does **not** execute Fastfetch. The first-time API-key prompt remains higher priority and finishes before option

plugins.description: DSH GUI control: one-click hard refresh of the web UI and restart of the Harness host (sidebar entries + settings status panel). · DeepSeek Harness 界面控制插件
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-gui-control

给 DSH 的 Web GUI 加两个控制动作：**强刷界面** 与 **重启 Harness**，三处入口共用同一套实现。

- **会话头右上角**：两个 24px 图标按钮，排在官方那三个按钮（在应用中打开 / 会话日志「更多」/ 右栏展开）
  左侧，中间多留 8px 空隙。图标态没有文字，语义在 `aria-label` / `title` 上；重启武装时图标转红并在
  下方浮出提示气泡（绝对定位，不推动这一排）。
- **侧边栏底部**：两个一键入口（展开态是「图标 + 文字」整行，收起态是 32px 图标按钮）。
- **设置 → 界面控制**：运行状态（插件版本 / Host pid / 已运行时长 / 平台 / Profile）、两个动作和说明。

三处入口调用的是同一对函数（`hardReload()` / `restartHarness()`），不存在第二套实现。

## 两个动作分别解决什么

| | 强刷界面 | 重启 Harness |
|---|---|---|
| 做什么 | 清空 `CacheStorage`、注销 Service Worker，然后整页重载，重新拉取并执行每个客户端插件 bundle | 通过 DSH Desktop 的 preload 桥（`window.dshDesktop.restartHarness` → 主进程 IPC `harness:restart`）重启 Host 进程，然后重新加载页面 |
| 什么时候用 | 改了客户端插件（`lib/client.js`）没生效；界面卡在旧的插件列表；样式错乱 | 改了 Host 侧（node 半侧）代码；安装/升级了插件；需要重新加载 Profile |
| 影响 | 只重载这一页，Host 进程不动 | Host 重启，**正在运行的任务会被中断** |
| 可用范围 | 任意载体（桌面端 / 浏览器） | 仅 DSH Desktop 桌面窗口（浏览器里按钮禁用并说明原因） |

重启是破坏性动作，所以做成**两步确认**：第一次点击只「武装」（设置页/侧边栏里按钮变成「确认重启？」并转红，会话头里图标转红并浮出提示），4 秒内再点一次才真的执行，超时自动取消。不用原生 `confirm()`——它会阻塞渲染进程。

## 为什么强刷不是 Ctrl+F5 的严格等价物

页面脚本无法改变文档自身的 cache 模式，所以浏览器层面的「硬刷新」标志拿不到。但本 GUI 会陈旧的三处来源都被覆盖了：

1. `CacheStorage` 里的缓存条目（逐个删除）；
2. 残留的 Service Worker（逐个 `unregister()`）；
3. 客户端模块 factory 的进程内记忆（整页重载即清空）。

插件 bundle 的 URL 自带 `rev=`，Host 侧按 revision 缓存字节，因此重载后拿到的一定是最新产物——这也意味着通常「重载」就够，清缓存是保险。

## 安装

三种方式效果相同（都会写进 `profiles/<profile>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`）：

### 1. 从 GitHub 仓库装（推荐）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ccccwwwxx/dsh-gui-control
```

`lib/client.js` 已随仓库提交，安装时无需构建。

### 2. 从 Release 预构建包装（免构建、免 `allowBuilds` 授权）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/ccccwwwxx/dsh-gui-control/releases/latest/download/dsh-gui-control.tgz
```

### 3. GUI / 本地目录（开发时用）

**设置 → 插件 → 添加插件**，填本地目录的绝对路径；插件页的安装动作就是 `pluginManager.installBundle`：
先在 `.generations/staging` 里装好、逐层校验，再提升为一代（`dsh-gui-control+<version>+<hash>`）并写进 profile manifest。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-gui-control`。

### 安装之后

- **首次安装**：客户端半侧随 HMR 直接生效（会话头右上角与侧边栏底部立刻出现两个入口）；没出现就点一次「强刷」。
- **升级安装**：插件管理器会报告 `application: "restart-required"`——新一代 Host 代码要重启才加载，
  正好用插件的「重启」按钮（或菜单里的 Restart Harness）完成，然后页面会重新加载。

## 开发

```powershell
npm run build     # src/client/*.js -> lib/client.js（注入 lib/text.js 的文案）
npm run verify    # 15 项自验：产物新鲜度、bundle 契约、槽位注册、渲染、三处入口的动作、文案对齐
```

`lib/client.js` 是**构建产物**，不要手改：改 `src/client/*.js` 或 `lib/text.js`，然后 `npm run build`。
`npm run verify` 会把重新构建的结果与已提交的 `lib/client.js` 逐字节比对，忘了 build 会直接失败。

### 目录

```
cordis.patch.yml        Loader 条目（插入 dsh-gui-control）
lib/index.js            node 半侧：只读状态 RPC（版本 / pid / 运行时长）
lib/text.js             zh / en 文案，唯一维护处
lib/client.js           构建产物（window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...) 格式）
src/build-client.mjs    拼接 + 注入文案
src/client/00-shared.js 常量、RPC、强刷/重启动作、样式
src/client/10-footer.js 侧边栏两个入口
src/client/15-header.js 会话头右上角两个图标按钮（两步确认 + 提示气泡）
src/client/20-settings.js 设置页区块
src/client/90-apply.js  注册槽位
scripts/verify.mjs      自验
```

### 槽位契约

| 槽 | 类型 | 注册项 | owner 传入 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conversation.session.header.utilities` | list / session | `gui-control-header-refresh`(-40)、`gui-control-header-restart`(-39) | — |
| `sidebar.footer.action` | list / root | `gui-control-refresh`(71)、`gui-control-restart`(72) | `{ wide }` |
| `settings.section` | list / root | `gui-control`(96) | — |

会话头的 order 用负数是为了排在官方那三个按钮左侧（`open-in-app` 是 -10，会话日志「更多」默认 0）；
`restart` 带 `margin-right:8px`，在容器自带的 8px gap 之外再多留一点空隙。

样式只用主题变量（`--dsw-alias-*`）并带兜底值，类名固定 `dsh-gui-` 前缀，不依赖构建哈希。

## 已知边界

- **Host 侧没有、也不该有「重启自己」的口子**：那是桌面壳的进程监督职责。浏览器版没有重启能力，按钮会禁用并说明。
- **强刷不等价于浏览器的硬刷新标志**（见上）。
- **状态里的「Host 已运行时长」是模块加载时刻起算**，不是操作系统进程的创建时间；两者在正常启动下几乎相同。
- 重启会中断正在运行的任务与工具调用，这是 Host 重启的固有代价，不是插件的选择。

plugins.description: Background sidecar subagents for the DeepSeek Harness: unique names, separate cwd/git-worktree spaces, review-on-demand results.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-sidecar

Fire focused subagents in the background with unique names and separate spaces,
then review each result — task, answer and evidence trail, plus the full
transcript on demand — on your own schedule. **Separate plugin**: no shared state with `dsh-autocontinue`
(continuation/restarts) or the `dsh-update` updater.

## Commands and tools

```sh
/sidecar <task>                              # auto name (sidecar-1, -2, ...), parent cwd
/sidecar --name alpha <task>                 # unique name, pinned as the child session title
/sidecar --cwd /tmp/alpha-space <task>       # separate working directory
/sidecar --worktree --name wt-fix <task>     # isolated git worktree + branch sidecar/wt-fix
/sidecar list                                # running sidecars: name, id, age, cwd
/sidecar result <id>                         # read and consume a stored result now
/sidecar log <id>                            # full child transcript on demand
/sidecar cancel <id>                         # interrupt one
```

Multiple sidecars run concurrently up to the subagents service cap
(`maxActiveSubagents`, default 8). Each gets a unique name (requested names are
suffixed `-2`, `-3`, ... if taken), a distinct child session id, and its title
pinned to the name so the GUI list is unambiguous. They share the parent cwd by
default; use `--cwd` for a separate workspace or `--worktree` for a real
filesystem/branch isolation. Worktrees start from `HEAD` — uncommitted parent
changes are intentionally not visible there.

Model-facing tools (used when the parent chooses to review):

- `sidecar_result` — `{ id }` returns the stored review body and removes it
  from the queue.
- `sidecar_list` — lists stored results waiting for review.

## Delivery: notice, not a queued user message

The child is spawned through `ctx.subagents.startActivation()` with
`delivery: 'caller'`; its prompt forbids `send_message` and further delegation.

When it finishes, the plugin:

1. stores the full result at
   `~/.dsh/sidecar/results/<parent>/<child>.json`;
2. calls `agent.inject(notice)` — a **next-step notice with no wake**. This is
   not `followup`: it does not create a queued user message and does not start a
   turn. A running parent sees it at its next step; an idle parent sees it when
   it next runs. The notice says only that the result is stored and that
   `sidecar_result` will return it;
3. never injects the full result into the transcript. The parent reviews by
   calling `sidecar_result` (or the user runs `/sidecar result <id>`), which
   returns the result as a **tool result** and consumes the file.

The stored review is deliberately compact:

- the **complete task** the sidecar was given (so the parent knows what the
  result is for),
- the **final answer**,
- a **compact evidence trail**: every tool call and its result, in order
  (capped at 8 KB), and
- the **child session id** with a pointer to `sidecar_log`.

The child's complete session log — including workspace instructions, reasoning
and every step — stays on disk. `sidecar_log` (or `/sidecar log <id>`) returns
it on demand. Pushing the full raw log into the parent by default would bury the
useful task/answer under pages of workspace boilerplate, so it is opt-in.

If the parent closes before ever seeing the notice, the file persists; the next
time that parent agent is created (session reopened or resumed) the notice is
injected again. `sidecar_list` is the discovery path if the notice was already
consumed or missed.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kenjoe41/dsh-sidecar
# or pin a release
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kenjoe41/dsh-sidecar#v0.4.0
```

For a local checkout, link it instead; a linked install needs
`node_modules/@deepseek-ai/{dsh-llm,dsh-tools}` shims so the profile's peers
resolve. Reload or restart the profile after installing.

plugins.description: DSH 侧栏网页预览：在右侧栏直接打开本地开发服务器或任意网址，不用跳出去开外部浏览器。In-sidebar web preview for DeepSeek Harness.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-preview

在 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏里直接预览网页，不用跳出 DSH 去开外部浏览器。

Preview web pages inside the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar — no external browser window needed.

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-0.2.0--rc.1%2B-blue.svg)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-0284c7.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

> 装不上、报错、或者行为和文档对不上，直接发邮件到 **1992335297@qq.com**，比开 Issue 更快被看到。

---

![右侧栏网页预览](docs/preview.png)

> 图为界面示意，按插件 `lib/client.js` 的地址栏与 iframe 布局渲染，不是运行截图。可用 `node scripts/make-screenshots.mjs` 重新生成（源码在 `scripts/demo/preview.html`）。

## 它解决什么问题

写完前端要验证效果，标准流程是切到浏览器、开新标签、输地址、再切回来。真机上窗口一多就找不着北。DSH 的右侧栏本来就是文件预览的地盘，把网页也放进去，视线不用离开对话。

`dsh-web-preview` 给右侧栏加一个「网页预览」标签页：输入地址、回车，页面就在侧栏里跑起来。

## 用法

1. 点右侧栏 tab 条上的添加按钮，在引导页里选 **网页预览**。
2. 在地址栏输入 `localhost:5173` 或 `https://example.com`，回车。
3. 地址栏右侧三个按钮：重新加载、在外部浏览器打开、复制地址。

地址会自动补协议：`localhost:5173` 走 `http://`，裸域名走 `https://`。显式写了协议就按你写的来。

## 实现方式

走 DSH 官方的侧栏扩展点，不自绘面板、不覆盖既有 UI：

- 类型注册：`ctx.sidebarRightTabs.register({ id, kind, patterns, priority, title, guide })`
- 正文注册：`ctx.slots.register({ name: 'sidebar.right.pane.tab', key })`
- 导航：`ctx.sidebarRight.openResource('dsh-resource://web/<encodeURIComponent(url)>')`

每个预览地址是一个独立的资源 tab，同一地址重复打开会聚焦已有 tab，不会堆一堆重复页。tab 标题取目标站点的 host。

宿主侧只提供一个只读健康检查 `/api/web-preview/health`，不读文件、不落盘、没有对外网络请求。

## 安全边界

- iframe 只接受 `http` / `https`，其它协议直接拒绝。
- 拒绝把 DSH 自身的 origin 当作预览目标，避免把 DSH 页面嵌进自己造成同源脚本互扰。
- 不注入任何脚本到被预览的页面，不读取页面内容，不上报任何数据。
- 预览页运行在 iframe 的独立文档上下文里；父页面不获得它的 DOM。

## 已知限制

- 跨域页面无法被父页面读取 DOM，所以这一版只能「看」，不能「批注」。
- 拒绝承载体 X-Frame-Options / CSP `frame-ancestors` 的站点会白屏，这类站点请用地址栏右侧的 ↗ 打开到外部浏览器。
- 需要登录态的页面在侧栏里可能没有 cookie，取决于目标站点的 SameSite 策略。
- 尚未注册模型工具，目前由用户手动输入地址。

## 路线图

批注功能（指向页面元素、显示标签/尺寸/颜色/字体、点击就地下评论、批注回填输入框）二期实现。跨域 iframe 拿不到内部 DOM，二期改为宿主侧接管浏览器：Playwright 打开页面、CDP 推画面、坐标回传、`document.elementFromPoint` 取元素、注入批注覆盖层。

## 开发

```
lib/index.js         宿主侧：健康检查路由 + URL 规范化
lib/client.js        客户端侧：tab 类型注册、正文（地址栏 + iframe）
scripts/verify.mjs   自检
```

```bash
node scripts/verify.mjs
```

覆盖包元数据、patch 结构、客户端语法与依赖声明、同源防护、四类 URL 规范化用例、路由注册与健康检查、非法路由。共 14 项。

## 安装

### 一条命令

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:nubeslove/dsh-web-preview"
```

然后在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里追加 `"dsh-web-preview"`，重启 DSH。

实测 pnpm 11.9 从 GitHub 直接拉取，3.9 秒装完。插件是纯 JS，没有构建步骤，也没有任何运行时依赖。

### 本地开发

自己改代码时用 link 指向工作副本：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-web-preview"
```

路径含空格时手工处理：在 `profiles/desktop/package.json` 的 `dependencies` 加 `"dsh-web-preview": "link:E:/path/to/dsh-web-preview"`，在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 追加 `"dsh-web-preview"`，并在 `profiles/desktop/node_modules/` 下建指向本目录的 Junction，然后重启 DSH。

## 许可证

[MIT](LICENSE)

## 反馈与联系 / Feedback & Contact

遇到 bug、安装失败、行为和文档不一致，或者想要某个功能，都可以直接发邮件。

**邮箱：1992335297@qq.com**

邮件里带上这三样，定位会快很多：

- 插件版本（`package.json` 里的 `version`）
- DSH 版本（`dsh --version`）
- 报错的完整文字或截图

也可以在 [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/nubeslove/dsh-web-preview/issues) 提，但邮件更快。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Crew

A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok, without giving up the host's native subagent UI.
Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessions • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge

## Why DSH Crew DSH Crew is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, the work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress. What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much capability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today — so a change of model in DSH needs no change here.
### 🧵 Native Progress UI Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, running step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud statusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`. ### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation `flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can clamp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash run once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front.
### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DSH running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work. ### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Codex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the same CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text.
### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain depth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused with the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass. ### 📋 Jobs Board The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.
### 🔌 Custom Providers Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find out now, not mid-task. ### 📦 One-Click Install The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigravity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings file is backed up first.
## How it works ``` Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok (orchestrator, keeps its own model) └─ ds-flash / ds-pro ← native subagent shell (progress shows in the host's task UI) └─ MCP: dsh_run_worker(tier, effort, cwd, worker=) ├─ worker="agy"/"grok" → that external CLI runs the task (explicit opt-in) ├─ hub reachable → session inside DSH (visible in the Web UI, grouped by cwd) └─ otherwise → dsh-jsonrpc-agent runtime (worker.cordis.yml) └─ DeepSeek V4 Flash / Pro (DSH SDK, event stream → progress and token stats) ``` ## One run, two views Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them as its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions.

Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running tiers, elapsed time and tokens.

The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier and effort, live progress and token usage.

The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and tokens, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently.

## Install Install into a DSH profile from npm: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-crew@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-crew dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately. ### Configure DeepSeek credentials (standalone only) In hub mode — the installation above — workers run inside the DSH instance and use the DeepSeek credentials it is already configured with. Nothing else to set up. Only the standalone fallback needs a key of its own: dispatching from a host with no DSH instance running launches a worker runtime as a separate process. Obtain an API key from [platform.deepseek.com](https://platform.deepseek.com) and write it to `~/.config/dsh-crew/.env`: ``` DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=sk-... ``` ### Verify ```bash node scripts/smoke.mjs ``` The smoke test dispatches one cheap job through whichever path is available — the hub when a DSH instance is running, s

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 插件：上下文超过 45% 且静默 3 分钟时自动压缩会话历史
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-auto-compact

DeepSeek Harness 插件：**上下文占用超过 30%、且对话 3 分钟没有动静时，自动压缩会话历史。**

阈值、静默时长、巡检间隔、冷却时间都可配置。

> **EN** — A DSH host plugin that compacts a session automatically once its context
> usage passes a threshold (30% by default) **and** the conversation has been idle
> for a while (3 minutes by default). Zero runtime dependencies; it only decides
> *when*, and delegates the actual summarization to the official
> `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` backend via `/compact`.

## 它解决什么问题

DSH 自带的自动压缩只在“回合进行中、跑到模型上下文阈值（默认 80%）”时才触发。
长会话往往在回合结束时停在 60%~80% 之间，之后你放着不动，下一句话照样要带着
一坨旧历史进请求：首 token 慢、贵，还容易在再聊几轮后直接顶到上限。

这个插件补上“空闲期”这一段：只要某个会话**已经静默够久**，且**上下文占用已过线**，
它就在后台把旧历史压成一条 checkpoint，等你回来时上下文是干净的。

## 判定规则

每个巡检周期（默认 15s）对每个存活会话依次检查：

| 条件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `agent.status === "idle"` | 回合正在跑时**绝不**介入，不和进行中的对话抢状态 |
| 静默 ≥ `idleMs` | 会话日志事件、agent 状态变化、收件箱投递都会刷新“最后活跃时间” |
| 上下文 ≥ `thresholdRatio` | 取 token-meter 的上下文投影（与界面显示的百分比同源） |
| 距离上次尝试 ≥ `cooldownMs` | 成功、失败、跳过都计入冷却，避免反复打扰模型 |
| 不在压缩中 | 单个会话同时只允许一次自动压缩 |

命中后调用官方压缩链路，把可压缩的历史压成一条 checkpoint。压缩本身产生的事件
会刷新活跃时间，所以不会连环触发。

## 安装

### 方式一：从 tgz 安装（推荐）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:C:/Plugins/dsh-auto-compact-0.1.0.tgz
```


### 方式二：从源码（GitHub）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/fpm0312/dsh-auto-compact.git
cd dsh-auto-compact
npm pack
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:$PWD/dsh-auto-compact-0.1.2.tgz"
```

PowerShell 里最后一行写成：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:$((Get-Location).Path)\dsh-auto-compact-0.1.2.tgz"
```

开发调试可以直接用 `link:` 挂目录（改动免重装，但需要重启应用让宿主重新 import）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:$PWD"
```

### 方式三：手工挂载（等价）

1. 把本包放进 profile 的依赖里（`~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json`）：
   `"dsh-auto-compact": "file:C:/Plugins/dsh-auto-compact-0.1.0.tgz"`
2. 在同一个文件的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 里追加 `"dsh-auto-compact"`。
3. 在 profile 目录执行 `pnpm install`。

本包自带 `cordis.patch.yml`（`dsh.bundle.patch`），安装后会把 `auto-compact`
一行插进配置树，不需要手改 `cordis.patch.yml`。桌面端的 profile 监听会在
`package.json` / patch 变化时热重载插件树；否则重启一次应用即可。

## 配置

配置写在插件行上（profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，或直接用上面的 `config` 段覆盖）：

```yaml
- id: auto-compact
  name: dsh-auto-compact
  config:
    thresholdRatio: 0.30     # 上下文占用阈值（占模型上下文窗口比例）
    idleMs: 180000           # 静默多久算“没动静”（毫秒）
    pollMs: 15000            # 巡检间隔（毫秒）
    cooldownMs: 300000       # 两次尝试之间的最小间隔（毫秒）
    minTokens: 0             # 低于这个绝对 token 数不压缩
    compactTimeoutMs: 600000 # 单次压缩超时
    dryRun: false            # true = 只记录“本该压缩”，不真的压
    statusFile: true         # 心跳状态文件；false 关闭，或给绝对路径
    via: auto                # auto | service | command
    verbose: true            # 是否输出 info 日志
```


### `via` 是什么

压缩后端挂在**每个 agent preset 的隔离作用域**里，宿主平面拿不到 `ctx.compaction`。
插件按以下顺序找通道：

1. `service`：`agent.ctx.get("compaction")` 能拿到就直接调 `compactNow()`；
2. `command`：拿不到就执行内置的 `/compact` 命令 —— 同一条官方压缩链路，
   会在会话日志里留下 `command/run` + `command/done`，界面上可见。

`auto`（默认）先试 1 再退 2；`service` / `command` 可以强制只走某一条。

## 可观测性

- **心跳文件**：默认 `~/.dsh/auto-compact.status.json`，每次巡检后刷新。里面有每个
  会话的 `totalTokens` / `contextWindow` / `ratio` / `reason` / `lastAction`，
  一眼能看出“为什么这次没压”。
- **命令**：`/autocompact` 查看当前会话的占用与判定；`/autocompact now` 立即评估一次
  （跳过静默等待，但仍受阈值与冷却约束）。
- **日志**：`[auto-compact]` 前缀，info 级汇报压缩结果，warn 级汇报真故障；
  “agent 忙 / 被取消”这类正常竞争只记 info。

## 设计取舍

- **只做决策，不重写压缩**：真正的摘要、写 checkpoint、替换 surface 全部交给
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic`，插件只负责“什么时候该压”。
- **零 `@deepseek-ai/*` 依赖**：安装成 tgz 后不需要解析宿主的 peer 依赖，宿主升级
  也不会因为类型/内部实现变化把插件带崩。
- **空闲优先**：绝不压缩正在跑的回合。压缩是重活（要调一次模型），空闲期做最划算。
- **百分比与界面同源**：优先读 token-meter 的 `contextPressure` 投影
  （`pressureTokens + surfaceTokens - sampledSurfaceTokens`），拿不到才退回
  `measure().totalTokens` 估算。

## 开发

```bash
node --test test/auto-compact.test.mjs   # 16 个用例：决策矩阵 + 假宿主集成
node --check lib/index.js
npm pack                                  # 产出 tgz
```


`test/` 里用假宿主驱动 `apply()`，覆盖：静默判定、阈值边界、运行中不介入、
事件刷新计时、冷却、dryRun、命令兜底、投影优先、心跳文件、`/autocompact`。

## 已知限制

- 只对**空闲**会话生效；回合进行中的压力压缩仍然交给 `compaction-basic` 自己的阈值
  （默认 80%）。两者互补，不冲突。
- 压缩会真实调用一次模型（摘要），会计费；`cooldownMs` 就是为此存在的。
- 如果 profile 里根本没有挂载任何压缩后端，`/compact` 也不存在，插件会如实报
  `missing` 并在心跳文件里留痕，不会静默失败。

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: Switch DSH's built-in web_search between the DeepSeek Search API (/v1/tools/search) and the default account search, with live fallback, a settings page and a sidebar switch.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-deepsearch

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-plugin-deepsearch)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-deepsearch)
[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/badge/github-SeaViod%2Fdsh--plugin--deepsearch-181717?logo=github)](https://github.com/SeaViod/dsh-plugin-deepsearch)

Switch DSH's built-in `web_search` between the **DeepSeek Search API** (`POST /v1/tools/search`) and DSH's default account search — with automatic fallback, a settings page, a sidebar switch and a model-facing tool.

English | [中文说明](README.zh.md)

- **ON (`deepseek-api`)** — the built-in `web_search` tool is served by the DeepSeek Search API. This is a paid API: successful requests are billed by DeepSeek; check the current pricing in your DeepSeek console before enabling it.
- **OFF (`builtin`)** — the default DSH route: server-side account search (one search consumes one model turn).
- Switching is **immediate** and survives restarts: the mode is persisted in `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-mode.json`.
- **It never makes search unavailable.** With no key, a 401, a network error, or 429/5xx retries exhausted, the provider falls back to the previous (or another available) search provider and reports the reason in `lastError`.
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — only `node:` builtins and the global `fetch`. No build step.
- Settings page and sidebar switch are localized in **English and Chinese**.

## What it does

The plugin has two halves that work together:

| Half | File | Responsibility |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `index.js` | Registers the model tool `deepsearch`, registers a search provider (default id `deepseek-search-api`), routes `web.searchProviderId` on/off, exposes four HTTP routes under `/deepsearch/`, and resolves the API key. |
| Browser | `client.js` | Hand-written bundle loaded through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load(...)`: the settings tab and the sidebar footer switch. |

`cordis.patch.yml` is the bundle patch: a `dsh plugin add` or plugin-market install puts the package into the profile's `node_modules` (recorded in the profile `package.json` under `dsh.profile.bundles`), and the bundle layer applies this patch at boot — you do not need to edit the profile patch by hand.

## Three entry points

| Entry point | Where | What it is for |
|---|---|---|
| Settings page | **Settings → Built-in plugins → DeepSeek Search** | switch, status details, endpoint test, API key editor |
| Sidebar switch | Footer of the left sidebar | one-click toggle that shows the current route (`API` / `builtin`) |
| Model tool | `deepsearch` (`status` / `on` / `off` / `search` / `fetch` / `check`) | toggle the route or run a search from a conversation |

## Install

### From the plugin market

Search for **dsh-plugin-deepsearch** (or "DeepSeek Search") in the DSH plugin market and install it. The storefront uses the package's `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the host half is registered automatically. After installing, the new settings tab appears under **Settings → Built-in plugins → DeepSeek Search**; a browser page reload may be needed the first time so the client bundle is picked up.

### From the command line

```pwsh
# Install into the default profile
dsh plugin add dsh-plugin-deepsearch

# Or target a profile explicitly: `web` for a `dsh web` server
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-deepsearch
```

Installing for the **Desktop app** uses the desktop profile / the in-app plugin market UI (the Desktop app keeps its profile under its own DSH home; no user-home path has to be typed by hand). The plugin's browser half declares `dsh.client.platform: "web"`, which is what the desktop shell also loads.

If you are installing from a checkout rather than the registry, `npm pack` the folder and `dsh plugin add` the resulting tarball.

### Upgrading from 0.1.x

0.1.x had no bundle patch; it was installed by hand with one insert row in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: deepsearch
      name: dsh-plugin-deepsearch
```

0.2.0 ships `dsh.bundle.patch` (`cordis.patch.yml` at the package root). A `dsh plugin add` or plugin-market install does **not** write an insert row into the profile patch: it installs the package into the profile's `node_modules`, records it in the profile's `package.json` under `dsh.profile.bundles`, and the bundle layer applies the package's own `cordis.patch.yml` at boot. **Remove the old hand-written insert row before installing 0.2.0 as a bundle** — a leftover hand-written row plus a bundle install would load the plugin twice. Mode and key files under `$DSH_HOME` are kept, so the switch state and the key file survive the upgrade.

The profile name depends on the client: use `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-deepsearch` for a `dsh web` server; the Desktop app uses the `desktop` profile and its plugin-market UI. Do not type a full profile path — let `dsh plugin` resolve it.

### Uninstall

Remove the package from the profile (or uninstall it from the plugin market). The plugin does not add other files to the profile. The state file `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-mode.json`, the diagnostics file `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-diag.json` and the optional key file `$DSH_HOME/deepsearch-key.txt` can be deleted, or left in place if you plan to reinstall.

## Configuration
