plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-catalog

> **DSH Web GUI 的技能面板**——点一下 ⚡，全部技能带中文备注与分类排在你面前，搜索、筛类、点选、插入，随消息发出自动加载。

[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](https://github.com/frzzaxszz/dsh-skill-catalog/blob/main/plugin/LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E2%89%A50.1.1--rc.1-4cc9f0)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/badge/npm-not%20published-lightgrey)](#安装)

---

## 解决什么问题

DSH 官方内置了 `/` 技能补全，但它是**记忆驱动**的：你得先记得技能名，打 `/` + 前缀才能过滤出来。装了几十个技能之后，谁也记不住。

本插件在输入框旁加一个 ⚡ 按钮，点开就是全部技能：

- **全量发现**——磁盘扫描与宿主注册表合并，连 `bundled` / `custom` / `runtime` 三类结构上看不见的技能也列得出来
- **8 类分类**——工程 / 排错 / 需求 / 设计 / 文档 / 调研 / 技能 / 自动化，点 chip 只看该分类
- **中文备注**——只影响显示层，不改任何 `SKILL.md`，模型的技能路由判断完全不受影响
- **拼音搜索**——`ji yi` / `jiyi` / `jy` 都能搜到中文技能
- **智能排序**——置顶 → 最近使用 → 常用 → 其余，再按「自动 / 手动」区分模型能否自行调用
- **技能管理**——右键置顶 / 关闭 / 定位 / 卸载（移入备份，可撤回）
- **跨端共享**——桌面端与网页端的置顶、使用记录共用一份

选中后把官方 `/技能名` 手势插进发送框，随消息发出，由 DSH 原生机制加载技能——**零 agent 侧改动**。

**记得名字用官方 `/`，忘了名字用 ⚡，两者互补，可同时使用。**

## 安装

本插件**不发布到 npm**，从 GitHub 装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://github.com/frzzaxszz/dsh-skill-catalog.git#path:/plugin"
```

> ⚠️ **`#path:/plugin` 不能省。** 这个仓库是「插件在子目录」的布局：根目录放仓库说明，
> 真正的 `package.json` 与 `cordis.patch.yml` 在 `plugin/` 里。少了这一段，pnpm 在仓库
> 根找不到 `package.json`，安装会失败。

固定到某个 commit：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "git+https://github.com/frzzaxszz/dsh-skill-catalog.git#path:/plugin&commit=<sha>"
```

重启 `dsh web`（或刷新页面）即生效。

> 国内 HTTPS 受限时改用 SSH（同样要带 `#path:/plugin`）：
> `dsh plugin --profile web add "git+ssh://git@github.com/frzzaxszz/dsh-skill-catalog.git#path:/plugin"`
> 或先执行 `git config --global url."git@github.com:".insteadOf "https://github.com/"`

## 自带技能

装插件会**一并装上**它自己的维护技能，不需要另外手放到 `~/.agents/skills`：

| 技能 | 什么时候用 |
| --- | --- |
| `sync-catalog-zh-descriptions` | 新装了技能、面板上还有英文备注、或新技能没落进分类 chip 时，调它一次，**同时**补中文备注与分配分类 |

因为 DSH 读技能的四个根（`~/.agents/skills`、`$DSH_HOME/skills`、`<cwd>/.agents/skills`、`<cwd>/.dsh/skills`）都不包含 `node_modules`，光把文件塞包里没人读得到——所以 host 半边启动时向 `skills` 服务注册了一个 provider（rank 350），机制与 `dsh-mattpocock-skills-deck` 的随包技能一致。

优先级：项目级（100/200）> 随包（350）> 你自己装在 `~/.agents/skills` 的同名副本（500）。**同名的以你那份为准**——用户的选择优先。

### 为什么这件事要「调用一个 skill」，而不是全自动

装了插件之后，新技能应该一进来就自动被翻译、自动归类——这是更理想的形态，本插件也确实**能做到**：host 侧用 `ctx.on('agent/pre-step', ({ agent }) => …)` 拿到活 agent，再 `agent.followup(msg)` 把任务塞进会话，模型自己就去做，不需要任何外部 API。同机的 `meow-memory` 就是这么把记忆整理做成全自动的。

**但我们仍然设计成由你显式调用**，理由有三个，都不是技术限制：

**① 自动化要往你正在跑的会话里插话。** `followup`/`steer` 不排队、不弹窗，表现为对话里凭空多出一次助手动作。对后台任务（记忆整理）这无所谓；但技能面板是个高频 UI，你点开面板只是想看一眼技能列表，却撞见 agent 在自动改写分类表——这个体验是有争议的，而且它会花你的 token。

**② 判定「这是新技能」需要一份基线。** 插件每次都是全量扫盘，本身没有「上次处理到哪」的记忆。要自动，就得再存一份已处理技能的快照（按 name + 描述哈希），多一个状态文件、多一类需要迁移和清理的数据。

**③ 自动生成的质量会低于一次显式调用。** 分类判据里有大量边界：「写文档 ≠ 文档」「`pr` 该归调研」「`prototype` 该归需求」这类需要揣摩技能实际用法；中文备注更要求读懂它在什么场景下被用。顺手做的版本大概率比不上专门做一遍。更麻烦的是**它错了不会报错**——只是安静地待在一个错的 chip 里，没人发现。

所以当前的取舍是：**把你「记得去调哪个技能」的负担降到零（插件自带它、面板上就能看到它），而不是把你「审一眼结果」的机会也一起拿走。**

如果以后确实想要全自动，可行路线是加一个**默认关闭**的开关（设置里打开才走 pre-step 自动模式），或者做成「面板上显示『有 N 个技能未分类』，点一下补」——后者不插话、也不花多余 token，是更稳妥的一步。这些都还没做。

## 文档在哪

| 想看什么 | 去哪 |
| --- | --- |
| 完整功能说明、分类表、用法、原理、更新日志 | [`plugin/README.md`](plugin/README.md) |
| 动手改这个插件 | [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)（三副本结构与同步纪律） |
| 参与贡献 | [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](CONTRIBUTING.md) |
| Issue 跟踪与分诊约定 | [`docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`](docs/agents/issue-tracker.md) |

## 仓库结构

```
plugin/          ← 插件的真相源（Git 跟踪的就是这份）
  src/           ← 可读的源码（client 半 + host 半）
  lib/           ← 实际运行的编译产物；无构建链，与 src 手维护同步
  bundled-skills/← 随包技能
  scripts/       ← 把 src 内联进 lib 的手工工具（幂等可重跑）
docs/agents/     ← 工程技能读取的约定
backup/          ← 本地回滚件（不进仓库）
```

> **`plugin/` 是真相源，但它不是实际在跑的那份。** 详见 [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md)——
> 改代码必须同步到 profile 的 `local-plugins/` 与 `node_modules/` 两处，否则下次
> `pnpm install` 会把改动冲掉。

## 贡献

Issue 与 PR 都欢迎。发现 Bug 请附上：DSH 版本、操作系统、在哪个面板看到的（本机输入框旁有**两个** ⚡，左边是 `dsh-skill-market`，右边才是本插件）、以及控制台的 `[dsh-skill-catalog]` 日志。

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-usage-breakdown

DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：**按「会话 × 供应商 × 模型」拆解调用次数与 token 用量**。

一个会话里同时用了 DeepSeek、WorkBuddy、Radeon 好几条路由？面板会告诉你每条路由各被调用了多少次、吃了多少输入/缓存/输出、花了多少钱。

---

## 它解决什么

DSH 本身只告诉你「这一轮花了多少」，`dsh-cost-meter` 告诉你「今天花了多少」。但当你想知道**同一个会话里，究竟是哪个供应商、哪个模型在烧钱**时，这两个都不够。

本插件补的就是这一层：把 cost-meter 的账本重新切成 `会话 → provider:model` 的二维视图，不采集、不写入、不重复计价。

## 功能

- **会话内拆解**：每个会话一张卡片，卡内按 `provider:model` 列出调用次数、输入、缓存读取、输出与成本，横条表示调用量占比
- **当日概览**：会话数、调用次数、输入 token、缓存读取、合计成本
- **日期切换**：可回看账本里任意一天
- **单会话聚焦**：`?session=<id>` 只显示一个会话
- **三种入口**：会话顶部快捷栏、输入框下方、设置 → 插件
- **快捷键**：`Ctrl+Shift+U` 直接打开
- **浮层显示**：面板盖在 DSH 界面里，Esc 或点遮罩关闭

## 前提

需要先安装并运行 **[dsh-cost-meter](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-cost-meter)**，且账本里有数据（`~/.dsh/storages/cost-meter/ledger.json`）。

没有账本时面板会明确提示「找不到账本 + 试过的路径」，而不是空白页。

## 安装

本插件暂未发布到 npm，手动安装：

```bash
# 1. 放进 profile 的 node_modules
git clone https://github.com/qigai74/dsh-usage-breakdown.git \
  ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/node_modules/dsh-usage-breakdown

# 2. 在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 末尾追加
#    （~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/cordis.patch.yml）
- insert:
    - id: dsh-usage-breakdown
      name: dsh-usage-breakdown

# 3. 重启 DSH
```

> Windows 路径形如 `C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\profiles\desktop\node_modules\`。

## 使用

| 操作 | 行为 |
| --- | --- |
| 左键点「会话用量」 | 只看当前会话 |
| 右键点「会话用量」 | 打开完整面板（当天全部会话） |
| `Ctrl+Shift+U` | 直接打开面板 |
| `Esc` / 点遮罩 | 关闭 |

面板直达地址：`http://127.0.0.1:<DSH端口>/plugins/dsh-usage-breakdown/panel`

> DSH 的 web 端口每次重启都会变，建议用界面入口或快捷键，别收藏固定 URL。

## 数据来源

只读 `~/.dsh/storages/cost-meter/ledger.json` 的这段结构：

```
days["YYYY-MM-DD"]
  ├─ calls / cost / input / cacheRead / output     当日合计
  └─ sessions[]
       └─ { id, calls, cost, input, cacheRead, output,
            byProviderModel: {
              "provider:model": { calls, cost, input, cacheRead, output }
            } }
```

`byProviderModel` 的键就是 `provider:model`，这正是本插件展示的核心维度。

## 设计取舍

**为什么不做采集。** 会话日志解析、增量同步、计价、余额查询，`dsh-cost-meter` 已经做好了，而且是它的本职。本插件只做「另一个视角的展示」，好处是：cost-meter 升级不影响它，两个插件的账本不会打架，也不会出现两份互相矛盾的用量数字。

**为什么不改 cost-meter。** 改第三方插件的代码，升级就丢。只读它的公开数据文件，是一份不会随对方发版失效的契约。

**为什么路由只接受 loopback。** 两个 HTTP 路由都校验 `Host` 是 `127.0.0.1` / `localhost` / `[::1]`，避免被任意网页当作数据源读走账本。

## 已知限制

- 只能按天看，不能跨天汇总同一会话（账本是按天的）
- 面板依赖 `dsh-cost-meter` 的账本格式；若其格式变更，需要同步适配
- 入口依赖宿主的 UI 插槽；若某个版本插槽变更导致按钮不显示，面板仍可通过直达 URL 或 `Ctrl+Shift+U` 访问

## 开发

```
lib/index.js    Host 端：读账本 + 两个路由（/data、/panel）+ 面板页
lib/client.js   浏览器端：入口按钮、浮层、快捷键
```

`lib/client.js` 用 `react.createElement` 而不是 jsx runtime —— 后者的 `jsx(type, props, key)` 第三参数是 `key`，把 children 传进去会让组件渲染成空白，且 `apply`/`register` 全都不报错，极难排查。

调试打点：`lib/client.js` 会在 boot / apply / 每个插槽注册处向 `/plugins/dsh-usage-breakdown/ping` 上报，记录落在 `~/.dsh/.session-usage-ping.log`。

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-locale-ko

**한국어** | [English](README.en.md)

**DeepSeek Harness(DSH) 비공식 한국어 언어팩** · 딥시크 하네스 한글 패치

> **Korean (한국어) UI language pack for [DeepSeek Harness](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/).**
> Install it from **Plugins → Add plugin** with `https://github.com/jjoni12/dsh-locale-ko`, then pick 한국어 in Settings → General → Language.
> Unofficial community translation; not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

DeepSeek Harness의 화면(채팅, 사이드바, 설정, 플러그인, 자동화 작업, 파일 미리보기, 대화상자 등)을 한국어로 바꿔 주는 플러그인입니다.
앱 프로그램 파일은 건드리지 않고 DSH 플러그인으로만 설치되기 때문에, 플러그인 화면에서 언제든 끄거나 제거할 수 있습니다.

| 적용 전 | 적용 후 |
|---|---|
| ![적용 전: 영어 화면](docs/before-main.png) | ![적용 후: 한국어 화면](docs/after-main.png) |

<details>
<summary>스크린샷 더 보기 (설정, 플러그인 화면)</summary>

![설정 → 일반 화면](docs/settings.png)

![플러그인 화면의 한국어 언어팩 상세 정보](docs/plugins.png)

</details>

## 기준 앱

이 언어팩은 DeepSeek의 [DeepSeek Harness 공식 페이지](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/)에서 배포하는 **공식 데스크톱 앱**(Download for Windows)을 기준으로 만들었습니다. 같은 페이지에서 안내하는 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`(Web UI)에서도 동작합니다.

이 프로젝트는 비공식 커뮤니티 번역이며, DeepSeek가 만들거나 보증한 것이 아닙니다.

## 지원 버전

| 앱 | 버전 |
|---|---|
| [DeepSeek Harness 공식 데스크톱 앱](https://www.deepseek.com/en/harness/) (Windows 64-bit) | 0.2.1-rc.2 |
| `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` (Web UI) | 0.2.1-rc.2 |

다른 버전에서는 일부 문구가 영어로 나오거나 동작하지 않을 수 있습니다.

## 설치

Node.js나 터미널은 필요 없습니다.

1. DeepSeek Harness 왼쪽 사이드바에서 **플러그인**을 엽니다.
2. 오른쪽 위 **플러그인 추가**를 누르고, 아래 주소를 입력한 뒤 **설치**를 누릅니다.

   ```
   https://github.com/jjoni12/dsh-locale-ko
   ```

3. 설치가 끝나면 **지금 켜기**를 누릅니다. 다시 시작하지 않아도 바로 적용됩니다.

설정 → 일반 → 언어에서 `한국어`를 고를 수 있습니다. 운영체제 언어가 한국어이고 따로 고른 언어가 없으면 자동으로 한국어가 선택됩니다.

### 끄기 / 제거 / 업데이트

- **끄기**: 플러그인 → 설치된 플러그인 → 한국어 언어팩의 스위치를 끕니다.
- **제거**: 한국어 언어팩을 눌러 상세 화면에서 **제거**를 누릅니다.
- **업데이트**: 제거한 뒤 같은 주소로 다시 설치합니다.

설치, 끄기, 제거는 모두 DSH 앱의 **플러그인 화면**에서 처리되며, 언어팩은 **내 설정 파일**(`cordis.patch.yml`)을 직접 수정하지 않습니다.

## 구성

| 파일 | 역할 |
|---|---|
| `package.json` | DSH 플러그인 선언 (번들 + 클라이언트 플러그인) |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | 번들을 켜면 언어팩 플러그인을 불러오는 설정 |
| `lib/client.js` | 빌드된 언어팩 본체 |
| `locale/*.json` | 플러그인 화면에 표시되는 이름과 설명 (영어·중국어·한국어) |
| `icon.svg` | 플러그인 아이콘 |
| `src/ko-dict.json` | 앱 번역 시스템에 등록된 문구의 한국어 번역 (0.2.1 기준 56개 네임스페이스, 2,566개 키) |
| `src/ko-static.json` | 번역 시스템을 거치지 않는 문구의 한국어 번역. `global`(어디서나), `plugins`(플러그인 화면 안에서만) 두 묶음 |
| `src/client.template.js`, `src/build.mjs` | 위 파일들로 `lib/client.js`를 만드는 템플릿과 빌드 스크립트 |

## 번역 수정하기

`src/ko-dict.json` 또는 `src/ko-static.json`을 고친 뒤 빌드하세요.

```bash
node src/build.mjs
```

오역이나 빠진 문구는 Issue나 Pull Request로 알려 주세요.

## 동작 방식

- DSH가 제공하는 언어팩 API로 `ko` 언어(대체 언어 `en`)를 추가하고, 네임스페이스별 한국어 사전을 등록합니다. 언어 선택은 DSH가 직접 설정에 저장합니다.
- 번역 시스템을 거치지 않는 일부 문구는, 화면에 표시된 텍스트가 정확히 일치할 때만 한국어로 바꿉니다. 다른 언어로 바꾸면 즉시 원래 문구로 돌아갑니다.
  - 플러그인 이름·설명은 플러그인 화면 안에서만 바꿉니다.
  - "Status", "Tools" 같은 짧은 단어는 바꾸지 않습니다. 같은 이름의 파일·폴더·세션 제목이 잘못 바뀌지 않도록 하기 위해서입니다.
  - 대화 본문(AI 답변, 사용자 메시지, 추론 내용, 코드)은 바꾸지 않습니다.

## 한계

- 앱 자체에 내장된 화면은 번역할 수 없습니다. 공식 데스크톱 앱의 창 메뉴(Application, Edit 등)가 여기에 해당합니다.
- 설정 → 기본 제공 플러그인 목록의 패키지 설명은 각 패키지의 개발자용 설명이라 공식 중국어판에서도 영어로 나오며, 이 언어팩도 번역하지 않습니다.
- 외부 플러그인과 서버에서 내려오는 일부 문구(도구 이름, 오류 원문 등)는 영어로 남을 수 있습니다.
- 앱이 업데이트되면 새 문구가 영어로 나올 수 있습니다.

## 라이선스

[MIT](LICENSE)

번역의 원문은 MIT 라이선스로 배포되는 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)(Copyright (c) 2026 DeepSeek)의 UI 문구입니다. 자세한 내용은 [NOTICE](NOTICE)를 보세요.

# dsh-skill-install

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) skill installer. From the Web settings page
(Settings → "Skills"), search GitHub repositories by name or paste a repo URL, list the `SKILL.md` skills inside,
tick the ones you want, and install them to a target directory. Integrates with the built-in skill-filesystem, so
installed skills take effect immediately — no restart required.

[中文](README.zh.md)

## Features

- **Search by name / paste a URL**: one input accepts a skill/repo name (searches repos by name), or `owner/repo`
  and `https://github.com/owner/repo` addresses.
- **Only matched repos**: search returns concrete matching repositories; click "Open" to browse their skills.
  There is no full-site discovery feed.
- **Selectable target, global by default**:
  - Global → `<dshHome>/skills` (watched by skill-filesystem by default)
  - Current project → `<project root>/.dsh/skills` (project root = nearest `.git` ancestor, else cwd)
  - Custom directory → any absolute directory; the plugin registers its own skill provider and hot-refreshes it
- **Installed list**: grouped by target directory, one-click removal.
- **Currently loaded skills**: the merged set from the built-in skill-filesystem and this plugin (read-only).
- **Proxy (collapsed entry)**: configure a proxy address, test connectivity, or clear it; requests go through the
  system `curl` when set, direct otherwise.

## Install

```sh
# Local directory — quit the Desktop app first; --profile is required.
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add ./dsh-skill-install

# From GitHub
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:<owner>/dsh-skill-install
```

Then restart Harness so the new bundle composes; "Settings → Skills" shows the new page. This package has
**zero external runtime dependencies** (`js-yaml` is bundled as a self-contained ESM build), so a GitHub install
needs no `allowBuilds` code-execution approval.

## Runtime dependencies

- The host plugin is pure ESM with no external runtime dependencies (`js-yaml` is bundled in `js-yaml.mjs`, MIT).
- Extracting the GitHub tarball needs system `tar` (built into Windows 10 1809+); using a proxy needs `curl`.

## Skill-system integration

- Global / project installs write into the standard roots watched by skill-filesystem, so the watcher hot-loads them;
- Custom directories are registered as an independent skill provider via `ctx.skills.registerProvider`, using the
  same discovery rules (`<root>/<name>/SKILL.md` or `<root>/<name>.md`), invalidated on install / remove / changes;
- All routes and providers are registered with `ctx.effect`, so they are removed automatically on disable / reload.

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
更早的版本（v0.4.x / v0.3 / v0.2 / v0.1） - **v0.4.1**：渲染器 v3 定稿（自由通道走线、viewBox 全几何自适应、API 直连、跨层聚合、缩放与悬停）； `normify_sync` 识别**未跟踪的新文件**（`git ls-files --others`）。 - **v0.4.0**：伴随开发（`state: pla

plugins.description: Guarded GitHub tools for DeepSeek Harness: 9 typed github_* tools (58 actions) where every state-changing action needs confirm:true plus a human approval seam, with a digest-verified self-update and a settings page. Zero runtime dependencies. | 面向 DSH 的 GitHub 工具：所有写动作都过审批门
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-github-gate

**GitHub tools for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) where a write cannot happen by accident.** Nine typed `github_*` tools over the GitHub CLI. Every action that changes remote state — 23 of them — needs `confirm: true` **and** passes a human approval seam. The model's flag is intent; it is not consent. ```text github_pr { action: "merge", number: 42, confirm: true } → an approval prompt naming the pull request; "no" stops it → after consent: gh pr merge 42 --repo owner/name ``` - **Argv arrays, never a shell.** `gh` is spawned with `shell: false`, so model text cannot become shell syntax — structurally, not by filtering. - **One credential chain, resolved per call.** DSH credential store → `GH_TOKEN` / `GITHUB_TOKEN` → `gh auth login` → git credential helper. Rotating a token applies to the next call. - **Configuration in the GUI.** Settings → Plugins → GitHub: paste a PAT, test it against the API, see which layer is live. The token is never displayed back. - **A branch pill** in the session header: current branch, its pull request, and a switch menu that fails closed when the caller cannot be judged. - **Digest-verified self-update.** `github_update` stages a release whose sha256 is checked against the digest GitHub publishes. Host-side tools plus one small browser half. Zero runtime dependencies. No build step. > **Requires** DeepSeek Harness `>=0.2.0-0 <0.3.0` and the > [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/) (`gh`) on `PATH`. Linux, macOS, and Windows. **Topics:** `dsh-plugin` · `deepseek-harness` · `dsh` · `cordis-plugin` · `github` · `gh-cli` ## Why this over another GitHub plugin Tool count is a bad proxy for usefulness — a broader surface with looser gates is easier to write and harder to trust. The trade this project makes is explicit: | | Other GitHub plugins for DSH | This one | |---|---|---| | Write safety | `confirm: true`, set by the model | `confirm: true` **+** an approval seam the model cannot set | | Raw REST | unrestricted escape hatch | path must be relative, no `..`, write methods gated at run time | | Correctness evidence | tests of its own API | 176 tests, 180 behaviour snapshots, and **84 argv shapes parsed by a real `gh`** | | Failure messages | HTTP code passed through | 401 / 403 quota / 403 SSO / 404 / 422 each name the fix | | Scope | as many tools as possible | 9 tools / 58 actions, one to a `gh` subcommand family | | Self-update | — | staged with a verified sha256, install left to the platform | If you want the largest possible tool surface with no gates, this is not the right plugin. If you want the model to be able to *look* at GitHub freely but need a person in the loop before it *changes* anything, it is. ## Table of contents - [Install](#install) - [Quick start](#quick-start) - [Guidance](#guidance) - [The branch pill](#the-branch-pill) - [Settings page](#settings-page) - [What it provides](#what-it-provides) - [Updating this plugin](#updating-this-plugin) - [Configuration](#configuration) - [Credential chain](#credential-chain) - [Device Flow needs your own OAuth App](#device-flow-needs-your-own-oauth-app) - [Safety model](#safety-model) - [Background jobs](#background-jobs) - [Known limitations](#known-limitations) - [Development](#development) ## Install Two ways, both through the Harness plugin manager (`plugin_manager` action `install_bundle`): 1. **From a GitHub release** — download `dsh-github-gate-.tgz` from [Releases](../../releases) and point `install_bundle` at the unpacked package directory, or at a local path holding it. 2. **From a packed tarball of your own checkout**: ```bash npm pack --pack-destination ../packages # pack OUTSIDE the source directory ``` then install `../packages/dsh-github-gate-.tgz`. **Install from a packed tarball, not from the source directory.** This is not a style preference. Installing a `link:` to a workspace directory produces a junction, and the launcher's runtime resolution does not reach bare `@deepseek-ai/*` packages through it — the plugin then fails with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` and refuses to activate entirely. Pack the tarball **outside** the source tree: one run that packed into the source directory itself left that directory emptied once the install completed (see [docs/DESIGN.md](./docs/DESIGN.md) §5.8). The tarball is a snapshot, so editing the source requires repacking and reinstalling; a restart loads the new module generation. ### One-command download The install scripts fetch the latest release, verify its sha256 against the digest GitHub publishes, and print the install path. They deliberately do not install — that step belongs to the plugin manager, which asks for approval: ```powershell # Windows irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1273984347/dsh-github-gate/main/install.ps1 | iex ``` ```sh # Linux / macOS curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1273984347/dsh-github-gate/main/install.sh | sh ``` Then install the printed path with `plugin_manager` action `install_bundle`. ## Quick start ```text 1. Is there a credential? github_auth { action: "status" } credential source: credentials-seam | environment | gh-cli | git-credential-helper | none 2. No credential? Establish one. github_auth { action: "login" } # Device Flow, needs your own OAuth App — or paste a PAT in Settings → Plugins → GitHub — or just run `gh auth login` in a terminal; the chain picks it up 3. Something is broken? github_auth { action: "probe" } # isolates each layer, names the failed one 4. Work on a pull request. github_pr { action: "status" } # CI for the branch you are on github_pr { action: "view", number: 42 } github_pr { action: "checks", number: 42 } github_pr { action: "merge", number: 42, confirm: true } # asks a person ``` The repository is taken from the workspace's git remote when `repo` is omitted, so the common case needs no argument. ## Guidance Beyond the tools, this plugin contributes a **prompt section** and three **skills** that say what the tool schemas cannot: when to use which capability, what evidence a conclusion needs, and when to stop. The rules are deliberately few — a prompt section is paid for on every step — and each one names the tool it applies to. Three workflows load on demand: `github-pr-review`, `github-ci-triage`, `github-issue-to-pr`. ## The branch pill `client.js` is the browser half: a branch pill in the session header slot (`conversation.session.header.utilities`) showing the checked-out branch, the pull request open on it, and a menu for switching branches. It is ~26 KB and it is the only part of this bundle that renders in the browser. It reads through four loopback HTTP routes this plugin registers on the `webServer` service: | Route | Does | Without a `connection` service | |---|---|---| | `/branch`, `/branches`, `/diagnostics` | read the workspace and branch names | served, with one logged warning | | `/switch` | runs `git switch` on the working tree | **refused with 403** | A missing service is not consent: an apparatus that cannot judge a request must not treat "cannot judge" as "judged safe". The read routes fail open because refusing them would disable the pill outright in a composition that legitimately has no Connection service; `/switch` fails closed because its consequence is a change to the user's working tree. `client.js` requires no Harness Client package and uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so a chang

plugins.description: A DSH plugin that turns one provider API key into a managed pool + more built-in LLM Providers
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Keys Manager

[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/dsh-keys-manager)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%5E22.19%20%7C%7C%20%3E%3D24-339933)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-keys-manager)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%5E0.2.1--rc.2-0969DA)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns one provider API key into a managed pool.
It extends the Models page rather than replacing it: providers, models, and the
model picker stay where they are; only the API-key source moves behind the
manager.

## Features

- Several keys per provider, each with an alias and health state.
- One key pinned to a session, with round-robin selection for new sessions.
- Bounded retry on the same key, then automatic failover to another key.
- Exponential cooldown recovery, capped at seven days.
- A search-driven Keys Manager page on the plugin's own detail page.
- A "managed by Keys Manager" badge inside the existing Models provider cards.
- Extra built-in providers installed as ordinary `llm-pi-ai` routes.

### Extra providers

`src/providers.ts` contains a curated catalog of 34 extra providers (21 from
the original catalog plus 13 added in this release, for example SiliconFlow,
Zhipu coding plan, Cline Pass, Ollama Cloud, and Alibaba Token Plan (CN)),
derived from
[oh-my-pi](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi)'s provider catalog (MIT).
An extra id is added only when the shipped DSH catalog does not already
declare that route id (for example, `meta` and `typesafe` are not
duplicated); same-endpoint providers with distinct credential identities
are kept by design.

## Quick start

### Install — published package

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-keys-manager
```

### Install — local checkout

```sh
git clone https://github.com/btspoony/dsh-keys-manager
cd dsh-keys-manager
pnpm i
dsh plugin --profile web link .
```

Only the published-package path avoids a local build: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-keys-manager` installs the npm
tarball as-is — package lifecycle scripts (`prepare` / `prepack`) do not run
for registry installs, and the tarball already ships the built `lib/` and
the client bundle. The local `dsh plugin --profile web link .` path is
different — installing a local directory runs `prepare` during `pnpm i`,
which builds `lib/` and the client bundle, so the clone flow above needs no
manual build step.

Refresh the Web page after installing so the browser half is fetched.

## Usage

Open **Plugins → Keys Manager → View** (rendered as
`Plugins → 密钥管理 → 查看` in the Chinese locale). The manager renders on the
plugin's detail page, between its description and its included rows, matching
the shipped plugin configuration cards.

1. Search for a provider. Existing DSH providers appear first; the plugin also
   ships the curated extra catalog described above.
2. Adopt a provider. For an existing provider the manager imports the
   currently resolved credential, writes a broker reference into the provider
   profile, and leaves the original key in the credential store so release can
   restore it.
3. Add more keys with an alias. Every key is stored in the Harness credential
   store under its own reference; the manager state document never contains a
   key literal.
4. Manage a key from the three-dot menu: rename, pause/resume, delete. A key
   row shows status, last use, and the recovery time while cooling.
5. Tune retry count (1–3), base cooldown, and recovery grace in the settings
   card.

### Selection and failure policy

- **Sticky session**: the first request of a session selects a key and binds
  it for that session/provider pair. Later requests reuse it.
- **Round robin**: a new session advances the provider cursor and takes the
  next healthy key.
- **Retry**: a failing request is retried on the same key `retryCount` times.
- **Switch**: after the retry budget is spent, the failing key is marked
  cooling, and the session is rebound to another healthy key.
- **Cooldown**: the first failure cools a key for `baseCooldownMs`. A failure
  while cooling, or within `recoveryGraceMs` after recovery, doubles the
  next cooldown. A long healthy gap resets the escalation. The hard cap is
  seven days.
- **Recovery**: the key is automatically selectable again when its cooldown
  expires; no manual reset is required.
- **Delegation**: request-shaped failures such as
  `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` and cancellation never cool a key. When no
  alternate key exists, the manager delegates to the composition's normal
  retry/fallback policy.

## Configuration & data

Manager metadata lives at:

```text
$DSH_HOME/keys-manager/state.json
```

with owner-only permissions. It contains aliases, credential references,
health counters, session bindings, and provider adoption facts. API key
literals live only in the Harness credential store. The file is written
atomically through a temporary file and a rename.

Each managed provider profile points its `apiKeyEnv` at a broker reference
such as `KEYSMGR_ZAI_CODING_CN_3FA2C1`. The Host credential layer answers that
reference per request with the session's selected key. The Models page sees
the profile as configured; writing directly to the broker reference is
refused with a pointer to the manager.

### OAuth2 extension point

The state shape already distinguishes `kind: "api-key"` from `kind: "oauth"`
and keeps a nullable `oauth` object beside the credential reference. A future
account flow can add records under `keys-manager/<provider>/<key>` without
rewriting existing rows. Providers whose only authentication is OAuth are
reported as unsupported in this version rather than being treated as API-key
providers.

## Provider classification

Every provider card carries its origin:

- **DSH built-in** (`DSH 内置`) — a route from the shipped DSH pi-ai catalog.
- **Plugin built-in** (`插件内置`) — a route from this plugin's extra catalog
  in `src/providers.ts`.
- **Custom** (`自定义`) — a hand-declared route in the active profile.

The following DSH built-ins are explicitly outside single-key pool management:

| Provider | Why |
|---|---|
| `amazon-bedrock` | AWS credential chain (profile, IAM keys, ECS/IRSA/EC2), not one API key |
| `cloudflare-ai-gateway` | API key plus a Cloudflare account ID and gateway ID |
| `cloudflare-workers-ai` | API key plus a Cloudflare account ID |
| `openai-codex` | ChatGPT OAuth sign-in only; no API-key credential |

All other DSH catalog routes expose an API-key credential. Providers that also
support OAuth (Anthropic, GitHub Copilot, Kimi, OpenRouter, xAI, Radius) remain
manageable through their API-key path; OAuth accounts are tracked separately
in the roadmap issue.

## Documentation

| Doc | Content |
|---|---|
| [Development](docs/development.md) | build and dev workflow, repository layout |
| [Release](docs/release.md) | CI checks and the npm release flow |
| [Known limits](docs/known-limits.md) | current design boundaries, including deferred providers |

Chinese versions: [README.zh-CN.md](README.zh-CN.md) and the `*.zh-CN.md`
files in `docs/` — [开发](docs/development.zh-CN.md) ·
[发布](docs/release.zh-CN.md) · [已知限制](docs/known-limits.zh-CN.md).
Current design boundaries at a glance:
[Known limits](docs/known-limits.md).

## License

Released under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

plugins.readme_text:
# 操作约定注入（dsh-ops-conventions）

把「操作约定」在**动手前**确定性注入上下文，解决「约定记了但干活时不提就不用」的问题。

## 它做什么

- **版本变化后下一轮就注入，不再等下一个操作轮**：不按「像不像要动手」过滤，闲聊轮也会注入；每会话每版本只注入一次（约 70 token）。
- **同一会话同版本只注入一次**：不刷屏。
- **约定版本变化自动再提醒**：改 `VERSION` 后，下一轮（任何类型）会重新注入。
- **注入日志**：每次注入记一行（含选中的约定目录、索引是否存在），生效与否可核对。
- **硬拦截（默认开）**：操作类轮次里，本会话还没 `read` 过 `INDEX.md` 时，`write`/`edit` 等写类工具会被直接拒绝，并提示先读索引；读过后本会话放行。闲聊轮次不拦；shell 默认不拦（可配置）。
- **零配置可用**：包内自带 `skills/` 示例清单；也可以指向你自己的目录，或 OpenViking 里存的那份。

## 为什么会有这个插件

作者是一名 DSH 日常用户（学生，用 DSH + OpenViking 管理学习和工具工作流），遇到的问题很具体：

- 把「写脚本前先看清单」「改文件前先备份」这类操作约定写进了 OpenViking 技能和记忆；
- 但真正干活时，模型并不会稳定地主动去读它们——**约定记了，干活时不提就不用**，等于白记；
- 靠提示词或 `AGENTS.md` 也不稳：要么每轮全量注入太费 token，要么模型想起来才看。

于是和 AI 助手一起做了这个小插件：每会话每版本注入一条极短的门铃（入口清单路径 + 版本号），约定版本一改，下一轮就重新出现——不等到「像要动手」的那一轮。后来发现「注入了也可能不执行」，就补了硬拦截：操作类轮次里没读索引前，写操作直接过不去。

**关于代码**：需求、取舍、验证由作者决定；具体实现是与 AI 助手协作完成的。

**为什么公开**：相信「约定记了但干活不提就不用」不是个例，才把它整理出来上传，希望能帮到有同样需求的人。如果你遇到同样的问题，欢迎直接拿去用，也欢迎把你的场景告诉我，一起改进。

## 安装

### 方式一：安装脚本（推荐，跨平台、零依赖）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/HeliosTangDev/dsh-ops-conventions.git
cd dsh-ops-conventions
node install.mjs                       # 默认装到 ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop
node install.mjs /path/to/profile      # 指定 profile
node install.mjs /path/to/profile --uninstall   # 卸载
```

它会：复制到 `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-ops-conventions`、在 `package.json` 的 `dependencies` 登记、把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`（不加不会被加载）。

### 方式二：手动

1. 把整个仓库复制到 `<profile>/node_modules/dsh-ops-conventions`；
2. 编辑 `<profile>/package.json`：
   ```json
   "dependencies": { "dsh-ops-conventions": "0.2.0" },
   "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ ..., "dsh-ops-conventions" ] } }
   ```

> 注意：`package.json` 里必须有 `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`（本包已带）。缺了它，插件管理器会报「没有声明组合包」，且**不会被加载**。

### 装完

- **热重载**：DSH 插件页 → 找到 `dsh-ops-conventions` → 关掉再打开（改 `skills/` 或配置时不用重启）。
- 改的是**代码**（`index.mjs` / `rule.mjs`）时，关掉再打开不保证重新 import，**重启 DeepSeek Harness** 最稳。

## 配置

| 配置项 | 环境变量 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `skillsDir` | `DSH_OPS_CONVENTIONS_DIR` | 包内 `skills/` | 约定目录，需含 `INDEX.md`；`VERSION` 可有可无 |
| `logFile` | `DSH_OPS_CONVENTIONS_LOG` | `~/.dsh/ops-conventions/ops-conventions.log` | 注入 / 拦截日志 |
| `enforce` | — | `true` | 是否启用硬拦截；`false` = 只注入门铃 |
| `blockedTools` | — | `write` `edit` `multi_edit` `apply_patch` `notebook_edit` | 拦截的写类工具名；要连 shell 一起拦就自行加 `bash` / `pwsh` |

解析顺序（会**逐个检查目录里真的有 `INDEX.md`**，取第一个有效的）：

1. 配置项 `skillsDir`
2. 环境变量 `DSH_OPS_CONVENTIONS_DIR`
3. **包内 `skills/`**（随包发布，开箱即用）
4. OpenViking 实际存储：`~/.openviking/data/viking/default/user/default/memories/ops-conventions`
5. `~/.dsh/ops-conventions/skills`

示例（写进 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`）：

```yaml
- id: dsh-ops-conventions
  name: "dsh-ops-conventions"
  config:
    skillsDir: "D:/my-conventions/skills"
    enforce: true
    # blockedTools: ["write", "edit", "bash"]
```

## 约定目录结构

```
skills/
├── INDEX.md          # 入口清单（注入文本里给的就是它的路径）
├── VERSION           # 版本号；改它 → 下一次操作轮重新注入
└── ops-scripts/
    └── SKILL.md      # 各类清单，INDEX.md 里引用
```

自带 6 类示例：`ops-scripts`（脚本/后台）、`ops-notes`（笔记）、`ops-files`（文件目录）、`ops-check`（自检）、`ops-longtask`（长任务）、`ops-dsh`（DSH/插件）。可以直接改成你自己的。

## 机制

- 监听 `agent/pre-step`（waterfall），在模型调用前判断最后一条用户消息像不像"要动手"（工具词 或 动作词+对象词）。
- 命中且该会话该版本未注入过 → 追加一条 `instructions` 来源的消息。
- **硬拦截**监听 `tools/pre-execute`（waterfall）：当轮用户消息像要动手、且本会话还没**成功** `read` 过 `INDEX.md` 时，对写类工具返回 `deny`（理由里带索引绝对路径），模型照做后重试即可通过；`tools/result` 观察成功的 INDEX 读取后放行。
- 钩子自身异常一律 **fail-open**（放行）并写日志；`skillsDir` 里没有 `INDEX.md` 时不拦。
- 任何异常都吞掉，不影响正常对话；多会话各自独立判断。
- 日志里可核对：`inject vN`、`guard deny`、`guard index-read`、`guard loaded enforce=...`。

## 常见问题

**Q：插件市场里搜不到？**
A：市场只索引 npm / GitHub 上的包，本地安装的不会出现在搜索结果里；在「已装」列表里能看到。

**Q：卡片显示「异常：这个包没有声明组合包」？**
A：`package.json` 缺 `dsh.bundle.patch`。本包已带；如果你自己改了包，记得保留。

**Q：模型说 `skill xxx is unknown`？**
A：那是会话启动时的技能目录快照导致的，与插件无关。直接用 `read` 读注入里给的那个 `INDEX.md` 路径即可。

**Q：写文件被拒绝，理由是「硬拦截」？**
A：本会话还没 `read` 过 `INDEX.md`。按理由里给的路径读一次（并执行对应清单），再重试原操作即可；不想要这个行为，把配置 `enforce` 设为 `false`。

**Q：注入的提醒会显示在对话里？**
A：会，作为一条来源为插件的消息。长度约 70 token，一个会话只出现一次（版本变了再一次）。

## License

MIT

## Star

如果这个插件对你有用，欢迎在 GitHub 上点个 ⭐ Star，让更多 DSH 用户看到。

plugins.readme_text:
中文 · English · 日本語 · 한국어 · Español

介绍 · 对比 · 证明 · 机制 · 快速开始 · 能力 · 配置 · 更新

> **这是踏雪寻仙 DeepSeek Harness 插件系列的一员**（[dsh-files](https://github.com/taxueseek/dsh-files) 39★）。同作者完整技能系列：[session-digger](https://github.com/taxueseek/session-digger) 29★ · [taxue-invest](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-invest) 21★ · [taxueskills](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxueskills) 23★ · [taxue-creative-style](https://github.com/taxueseek/taxue-creative-style) 12★ ## 它和「模型自带搜索 / AI 搜索 / 聚合搜索」比，强在哪 > 简单来说：前三种方案解决「**人**找信息」，Argo 解决「**Agent 及搜索核查于一身，具备一条龙的搜索服务**」。差别不在界面，在交付物，给人看的叫总结页或链接清单，给 Agent 的应是能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的优质内容，更可靠的搜索信息。

| 维度 | 模型自带搜索 | AI 搜索（总结型） | 聚合搜索 / 搜索引擎 | **Argo** | |------|------------|-------------------|---------------------|----------| | 结果形态 | 拼好的长文本 | 给人看的总结页 | SERP 链接清单 | **精简 JSON：证据候选 + 可信度分解** | | 垂直问题（行情 / 化学式） | 泛搜网页 | 泛搜再总结 | 泛搜网页 | **直连垂直源，直接给答案** | | 证据可信度 | 无评分 | 无结构化评分 | 无评分 | **selection · absorption · freshness · 共识** | | 重复查询 | 每次都打网 | 每次都打网 | 靠页面缓存 | **双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms** | | 成本控制 | 不可控 | 单次贵 | 免费但费事 | **预算模式，免费优先，Key 全可选** | | 多语言 | 随模型走 | 随模型走 | 随引擎走 | **语言检测 + 引擎语言参数 + 多国语言支持** | > 机制上，Argo 把搜索当成一条**证据管线**：语言检测 → 领域路由 → 多引擎召回 → RRF 融合 → 证据快评，交付的是 Agent 可直接排序、可 `fetch` 复核、不撑爆上下文的材料。工具链不用换，需要换的是「搜索结果应该长什么样」——再往下一层，还有和「再包一层搜索 API 的差别」，那是实现细节的对比。 --- ## 2026，检索正在发生什么变化 Agent 干活的量级变了，检索的玩法跟着变了四件事，每一件 Argo 都已经落在代码里： 1. **检索从「给链接」变成「给证据」。** Agent 不看网页排版，它要能排序、能复核、不撑爆上下文的结构化材料——所以 Argo 交付的是带可信度分解的 JSON，而不是 SERP 清单。 2. **上下文成为第一成本。** 一次网页抓取动辄上万 token，Agent 的窗口烧不起。Argo 的 Agent 档单次约 3.7KB，字段集合与字节预算都有检查卡着，升级不会悄悄变胖。 3. **网站开始为 AI 备料。** llms.txt 标准与 `.md` 直出在头部文档站快速铺开——Argo 抓取链第零级自动探测这些 AI 友好变体，命中即跳过整条反爬链；HTTP/TLS 都失败还有 r.jina.ai 阅读器级保底。 4. **免费开放生态够用了。** 政府、学术、标准、安全机构的开放 API + 免 key 引擎，已经能覆盖大多数领域（221 个免配置源）；稀缺免费额度（firecrawl 1000 credits/月、stackexchange 300 次/天）做了「日常补位、关键顶上」的分层，订阅墙不是唯一解。 5. **检索质量从「感觉」到「度量」。** 排序有金标（MRR/nDCG 地板）、融合有增益消融检查、路由有负向控制矩阵——「这版比上版好吗」从此是数字问题，不是玄学。 > v2.9.3 把以上全部落地：264 个源、94 个领域、229 个免配置开箱。逐项细节见 [docs/为什么选择argo.md](docs/为什么选择argo.md) 与 [发布说明](docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v2.9.0.md)。 --- ## 这是什么 **Argo 是给 AI Agent 用的多语言搜索基础设施。** 真实检索从来不是「一种语言 + 一个搜索框」：有人问 A 股行情，有人问 World Cup，有人用日文找动画，有人要 IMDb 上的导演信息。Argo 的出发点很朴素——**按领域、按语言、按需求选路**，把问题送到合适的源，而不是一律扫网页标题。联网搜索与本机文件搜索一体可用。 > 产出不是「链接清单」，而是「证据候选 + 可信度分解」。路选对了，证据才站得住。 ### 和「再包一层搜索 API」的差别 | 常见做法 | Argo | |---------|------| | 绑死一个引擎、一个 Key | 多引擎自动选路，免费优先、可配预算 | | 啥问题都泛搜网页 | **垂直源优先**：行情、影视、体育、宏观、化学等先给答案型结果 | | 默认只按中英优化 | **多语言识别 + 引擎语言参数 + 跨语言回退** | | 搜完直接拼摘要 | 选择门槛 × 证据密度 × 时效 × 多源共识 | | 引擎挂了整条链路挂 | 熔断、负缓存、分阶恢复（防垂直源串味） | | 每次查询都重新打网 | 双层缓存（内存 + SQLite），热查询约 10ms 级 | | 日常和研究一个慢 | **日常少开引擎、研究再放宽** | | Agent 上下文被长 JSON 撑爆 | MCP 响应可紧凑裁剪，snippet 可控 | --- ## 问啥像啥

| 你这样问 | 大致会怎样 | |----------|------------| | python asyncio error handling | 编程问答域 → StackOverflow/StackExchange 官方 API，带得分与采纳标记 | | AAPL / 美股盘前 | 美股域，与 A 股分流 | | 肖申克的救赎 主演 / Inception director | 影视域 → IMDb 等 | | 梅西 俱乐部 / 库里 球队 | 体育域 → TheSportsDB 等 | | 埃菲尔铁塔在哪 / where is Eiffel Tower | 地理实体 → OpenStreetMap 等 | | NASA founding year / 国务院职能 | 组织实体 → Wikidata 等 | | 周杰伦 专辑 / Taylor Swift album | 媒体域 → iTunes 等 | | アニメ おすすめ / 한국 영화 추천 | 识别日/韩语 → 语言友好源，少塞中文专用站 | | 美国 CPI、日本 通胀率 | 宏观数据域；国别分流（本国权威源优先） | | log4j 漏洞 CVSS / nodejs 22 end of life | 安全域 → NVD 官方；生命周期域 → endoflife.date | | attention is all you need | 学术域 → arXiv/OpenAlex/CrossRef，元数据与 DOI 直连 | | 阿司匹林 分子式 | 化学域 → PubChem 类答案 | | 台积电估值分歧（深度研究） | 拆子问题 + 多源并行，垂直源被 boost | --- ## 它怎么工作

``` 查询 ├─ 意图消歧（可选） ├─ 查询改写（可选；路由仍看原始意图） ├─ 语言检测 + 语言偏好 ├─ 路由（域规则 + TF-IDF + 预算 + 语言补充源 + 热路径缓存） ├─ 多引擎召回（熔断 / 负缓存 / 并行） ├─ 空结果分阶恢复（放宽 → 换同族/通用 → 跨语言；防污染） ├─ RRF 融合 + 可选精排 ├─ 证据快评（权威 · 证据密度 · 时效 · 共识） └─ 统一 JSON（含 engine_outcomes / recovery / route_reason） ``` ### 证据评分（简版） ``` selection ≈ 域名权威，SERP/跳转链压到很低 absorption ≈ 数字 / 定义 / 对比 / 披露等证据密度 freshness ≈ 发布时间（会忽略「2015 年以来」这类历史对比年） 综合 ≈ 0.40·selection + 0.35·absorption + 0.15·freshness + 0.10·引擎分 ``` 结果字段含 `selection`、`absorption`、`credibility_fast`、`evidence_flags` 等，方便 Agent 直接排序。 ### Agent 使用纪律（建议） 1. **高后果问题**（持仓、安全、是否属实）：search → 看快评分 → 对 top 结果 `fetch` → 再下结论 2. **数字**：写清计算方式，冲突时并列，不要硬合并 3. **搜索结果页 / 跳转链**：不要当正文信源 4. **社交帖**：当舆情与叙事，不当事实真值 5. **事实核查**：宁可多一两条分层查询（来源 / 对比 / 主体） --- ## 快速开始 任选一种即可。**以 GitHub 为唯一安装来源**（`npx github:taxueseek/argo` 或 `install.sh` / `install.ps1`），当前推荐 **v2.9.4**。**请勿用 `npm install argo-search`**——npm registry 上那份是**非官方陈旧版 v1.0.1**（非本仓库维护，功能残缺、不随本项目更新）。本包 `package.json` 已设 `private: true` 防止误发布到 npm registry。 **零配置就能跑**：不配 API Key 时走免费引擎 + 本地 `local_*` 引擎；配了 Key 的源质量通常更好，没配则自动跳过。 ### 方式一：一键脚本（推荐本机长期用） macOS / Linux： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh | bash ``` Windows（PowerShell）： ```powershell powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex" # 或下载后执行： # powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/install.ps1 ``` 装到指定目录、并挂 Skill 入口： ```bash curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/taxueseek/argo/main/scripts/install.sh \ | bash -s -- --home "$HOME/.local/share/argo" --link "$HOME/.claude/skills/argo" ``` 验证： ```bash python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py "python asyncio error handling" --json python3 ~/.local/share/argo/scripts/search.py --list-engines ``` ### 方式二：MCP 不装包，直接用 GitHub（推荐 Agent 快速挂载） 需要 **Node.js 18+** 和 **Python 3.9+**，首次执行一次： ```bash pip3 install pyyaml ``` ```bash npx -y github:taxueseek/argo ``` 客户端配置示例（Claude Code / Cursor / Kimi 等）： ```json { "mcpServers": { "argo": { "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "github:taxueseek/argo"] } } } ``` ### DeepSeek Harness 一键插件（.dsh-plugin bundle） 在 DeepSeek Harness 里一行安装（两种装法）： ```bash # 装法 A：19 个 mcp__argo__* 工具（主包自带 bundle，与 MCP 全量相同） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo" # 装法 B：搜索工具 + wide_research 并行研究调度（子包） dsh plugin --profile web add "github:taxueseek/argo#main&path:packages/dsh-plugin" ``` 重启 `dsh web` 后生效。包结构见 `packages/dsh-plugin/`；同 id `mcp-argo` / `wide-research` 可在用户层 `cordis.patch.yml` 覆盖。装法 B 的 `wide_research` 模块只存在于子包依赖树，主包 patch 不引用它，避免只装主包时 Cordis 解析失败。已在最新版 DSH 0.2.1-alpha.1 实测：三形态接入（原生一等工具 / web_search seam / wide_research）均可正常启用。 ### 依赖清单（通俗版） | 依赖 | 必需？ | 干什么用 | 不装会怎样 | |------|:------:|---------|-----------| | **PyYAML** | ✅ 必需 | 读配置文件 | 完全跑不起来，安装脚本会自动装 | | **curl_cffi** | ❌ 可选（v2.7.3 新增） | 模拟浏览器 TLS 指纹，过反爬站（Cloudflare 等） | 反爬站抓取成功率低一些，日常搜索无影响 | | **ddgs CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 本地免 key 搜索的 10 个后端引擎 | 少一批零成本本地搜索源，其余不受影响 | | **realtime-index CLI** | ❌ 可选 | 实时索引引擎（搜刚发布的内容） | 该引擎自动禁用，显式指定会回退通用引擎 | | **Chrome** | ❌ 可选 | 页面截图、JS 渲染页、登录态抓取 | 截图工具不可用，其余正常 | | **pdfplumber / PyMuPDF** | ❌ 可选 | PDF 提取 | argo_pdf 不可用，其余正常 | | **Playwright** | ❌ 可选 | 截图增强 | 截图工具回退 Chrome CDP，其余正常 | 安装脚本（install.sh）只自动装前两个；其余可选依赖按需 `pip install` 或 `brew install` 即可。 更稳、完全不依赖 Node 的写法：先装脚本（方式一），再指向本机 Py

plugins.description: dsh Agent Teams roster administration: newest-first display order, bulk cleanup, teammate rename/delete | dsh Agent Teams 名册管理：倒序显示、批量清理、成员改名与删除
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-team-roster

[dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 的 Agent Teams 名册管理插件：**最新在最上**的显示顺序、
**一键批量清理**，以及成员**改名 / 删除**。不修改上游代码，作为单个 Cordis bundle 行安装。

[中文](#中文) · [English](#english) · [详细英文文档](README.en.md)

---

## 中文

### 功能

| 工具 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `rename_teammate { target, new_name }` | 原地改名：保留历史、会话、任务与未投递消息；新名字成为它的地址 |
| `delete_teammate { target }` | 结束该成员当前回合、释放运行时、释放其未完成任务、丢弃未投递消息、释放名字 |
| `cleanup_team { scope }` | 批量清理，`scope` 为 `teammates` / `tasks` / `all` |

**批量清理的语义**：已结算（inactive/failed）成员会被删除；已完成任务会被删除。
以下会被**跳过并报告**在 `skipped[]`（含原因），不会被误删：
运行中的成员、仍在 provisioning 的成员、未完成的任务、仍阻塞着别的任务的任务。
只有 Team Lead 能调用以上三个工具。

**显示顺序**：团队名册、共享任务板、子智能体对话目录均为**最新在最上**；
Lead 行固定第一（它是当前会话的锚点，不是子成员）。

### 实现方式（不修改上游包）

- **改名 / 删除**：扩展已注册的 `agentTeam` 投影单元的 `def.apply`，把两种变更表达为
  既有 `team/member` 事件的新取值（`renamedTo` 字段 / `phase: "removed"`），
  因此名册、邮箱、任务板、工具、客户端视图全部照常读到变更。
- **显示顺序**：包装 `agentTeam` 与 `subagentCatalog` 的 `def.wire.view`——那是客户端实际收到的值
  （上游按 `wire.viewSchema.parse(wire.view(state))` 生成，冷会话的 `viewCheckpoint` 也走同一路径）。
  有序值以**打包视图的引用**为键做 `WeakMap` 记忆化，保持上游「单元自身忽略的变化不重复发布」的契约。
- **不变量**：投影状态、`stateVersion`、存储值、以及面向模型的服务契约
  （`list_agents` / `team_task_list` 仍按上游顺序返回）一律不变；倒序只影响客户端可见视图。

### 安装（dsh profile）

1. 把本仓库放到任意目录，例如 `/root/dsh-agent-team-roster`
2. 在 profile 的 `package.json` 依赖中加入：
   `"dsh-agent-team-roster": "link:/root/dsh-agent-team-roster"`
3. 在该 profile 的 bundle 插件列表中加入 `"dsh-agent-team-roster"`
4. 若该 profile 是 `patchReload: startup`，重启 dsh 服务后生效

### 测试

```bash
node test/build-pristine.mjs   # 从已安装的 dsh 生成上游模块副本并校验哈希
node test/run-tests.mjs        # 64 通过 / 0 失败
node test/run-wiring.mjs       # 14 通过 / 0 失败
node test/run-mount.mjs        # mount: ok（真实 ToolRuntime + SystemPrompt + 真实 Team 服务）
```

测试需要本机已安装 `@deepseek-ai/dsh`；**本仓库不包含任何上游代码**，
`test/core-pristine.js` 由 `build-pristine.mjs` 在本地生成（已加入 `.gitignore`）。

### 验收记录

本插件经过一名独立的第三方智能体两轮验收（它自己写脚本、自己下断言）：
功能主张 A–F 全部证实；第一轮查出的一处缺陷（包装后的视图破坏上游引用记忆化契约，
导致纯邮箱变更多发布一次）已修复，并在第二轮复验通过——纯 mailbox 事件的发布序列与
未安装插件时逐字节一致。

### 边界（如实说明）

- **已删除成员的子会话无法物理删除**：dsh 没有会话删除 API。清理覆盖名册行与共享任务；
  子智能体目录只有顺序生效。
- 倒序只作用于客户端可见视图；面向模型的 `list_agents` / `team_task_list` 保持上游顺序。
- 仅适配 dsh `0.2.0-rc.2`（依赖 `sessionProjections.registrations`、`journal` 等内部接缝）。
  上游结构变化时插件会在激活阶段**显式报错**，而不是静默降级。
- 像素级渲染无法在无浏览器的环境验证：已验证的是宿主交给客户端的值 +
  上游客户端对该值不做二次排序 + 人工观察。

### 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。本仓库不包含上游 dsh 代码。

---

## English

### What it adds

| Tool | Effect |
|---|---|
| `rename_teammate { target, new_name }` | Rename in place: history, session, tasks and undelivered mail are kept; the new name becomes its address |
| `delete_teammate { target }` | Stop the member's current turn, release its runtime and unfinished shared tasks, drop undelivered mail, free the name |
| `cleanup_team { scope }` | Bulk cleanup; `scope` is `teammates`, `tasks`, or `all` |

**Cleanup semantics**: settled (inactive/failed) teammates and completed tasks are deleted.
Running teammates, teammates still provisioning, unfinished tasks, and tasks that still block
another task are **skipped and reported** in `skipped[]` with a reason, never deleted by mistake.
Only the Team Lead can call these tools.

**Display order**: the Team roster, the shared task board, and the subagent conversation catalog
render **newest first**; the Lead row stays pinned first because it anchors the current conversation.

### How it works (no upstream package is modified)

- **Rename / delete** extend the registered `agentTeam` projection unit's `def.apply`, expressing
  both mutations as new values of the existing `team/member` event (`renamedTo`, `phase: "removed"`),
  so every existing reader — roster, mailbox, task board, tools, client view — sees the change.
- **Display order** wraps `def.wire.view` of `agentTeam` and `subagentCatalog` — the value the client
  actually receives (upstream builds it as `wire.viewSchema.parse(wire.view(state))`, and cold-session
  `viewCheckpoint` reads go through the same path). The ordered value is memoized by the packaged
  value's reference in a `WeakMap`, preserving the upstream contract that a change the unit itself
  ignores republishes nothing.
- **Invariants**: fold state, `stateVersion`, stored values, and the model-facing service contracts
  (`list_agents` / `team_task_list` keep the packaged order) are unchanged; ordering is display-only.

### Install (dsh profile)

1. Place this repository anywhere, e.g. `/root/dsh-agent-team-roster`
2. Add `"dsh-agent-team-roster": "link:/root/dsh-agent-team-roster"` to the profile's `package.json` dependencies
3. Add `"dsh-agent-team-roster"` to that profile's bundle plugin list
4. Restart dsh when the profile uses `patchReload: startup`

### Tests

```bash
node test/build-pristine.mjs   # materialize the installed upstream module and verify its hash
node test/run-tests.mjs        # 64 passed / 0 failed
node test/run-wiring.mjs       # 14 passed / 0 failed
node test/run-mount.mjs        # mount: ok (real ToolRuntime + SystemPrompt + real Team service)
```

Tests require an installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh`. **This repository contains no upstream code**:
`test/core-pristine.js` is generated locally by `build-pristine.mjs` and is git-ignored.

### Verification record

An independent third-party agent verified this plugin in two rounds, writing its own scripts and
assertions: claims A–F all confirmed. The one defect it found in round one — the wrapped view broke
the upstream reference-memoization contract, publishing one redundant event for mailbox-only
changes — was fixed and re-verified in round two, with mailbox-only publish sequences now
byte-identical to a run without the plugin.

### Limits (stated plainly)

- **A deleted member's child conversation cannot be physically deleted**: dsh exposes no
  session-deletion API. Cleanup covers the roster row and shared tasks; only ordering applies to the
  conversation catalog.
- Ordering is display-only; the model-facing `list_agents` / `team_task_list` keep the packaged order.
- Verified against dsh `0.2.0-rc.2` only (it depends on internal seams such as
  `sessionProjections.registrations` and `journal`). When upstream changes shape the plugin **fails
  loudly** at activation instead of degrading silently.
- Pixel-level rendering cannot be verified without a browser: what is verified is the host-side value
  the client receives, the upstream client rendering it without re-sorting, and human observation.

### License

MIT, see [LICENSE](LICENSE). No upstream dsh code is included.

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

plugins.description: Native Rapid-MLX provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — dsh reads model facts from the server instead of your settings.yaml.
plugins.readme_text:
# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against
> `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`; `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` is API-compatible — the `LlmAdapter`
> contract is byte-identical and the only changes are additive — and the
> adapter is re-verified against rc.8 at the protocol and unit-test level.
> DSH is still a developer preview that moves fast, so treat this as tracking
> a moving target, not a frozen compatibility promise.

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

## Verified

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"
  warning; the entry shows up in `dsh --profile headless --dump-config`).
- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates
  Rapid-MLX releases — the last one fixed the bug and made the target repo's own
  test pass, verified independently, in 36 s on `qwen3.6-35b-8bit`.

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.

## Three things worth knowing before you edit this

Each of these cost real

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
