| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `helperPath` | bundled | Override the helper script path. |
| `powershellPath` | `powershell.exe` | PowerShell used to host the helper. |
| `idleTimeoutMs` | `600000` | Kill the idle helper; it restarts on the next call. |
| `startupTimeoutMs` | `90000` | First-call budget (PowerShell start + Add-Type compile). |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request budget once warm (screenshots/UIA use longer internal budgets). |
| `screenshotMaxWidth` / `screenshotMaxHeight` | `1600` / `1200` | Helper-side downscale bounds before the attachment store. |
| `maxElements` / `maxTreeDepth` / `maxTextChars` | `600` / `12` / `20000` | Accessibility tree bounds. |
| `blockedProcesses` / `blockedWindowClasses` | `[]` | Extra denials added to the built-in list. |
| `allowedProcesses` | `[]` | When non-empty: allowlist mode (everything else is denied). |
| `keepScreenshots` | `false` | Keep captured PNGs in `%TEMP%\dsh-computer-use` for debugging. |
| `confirmRiskyActions` | `true` | Ask through `ctx.approval` before destructive/externally visible actions. |
| `warnWhenApprovalUnavailable` | `true` | Under approval policy `never`/no channel: continue with a WARNING instead of failing. Set false for fail-closed. |
| `allowWindowsKey` / `allowTerminalAutomation` | `false` | Escape hatches for the two most dangerous hard denies (still discouraged; the helper keeps its own che

plugins.description: Android companion for DeepSeek Harness | chat, goals, approvals & notifications from your phone, over your LAN. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Mobile — DeepSeek Harness Remote

An open-source Android companion that puts your DeepSeek Harness in your pocket.
Drive sessions, review plans and goals, answer approvals and questions, and get notified when the harness finishes — from your phone, over your network or a relay.

English · 中文 · हिन्दी · Español · Français · ไทย

DSH Mobile is an **unofficial companion app** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (MIT). It mirrors the web GUI feature for feature and uses the harness's own visual language. Android only, Kotlin + Jetpack Compose. Its companion on the other end is [**dsh-relay**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-relay), a harness plugin that adds the authentication layer the harness says it lacks, so this app can reach a harness with a real credential and a pinned key instead of an open port. See [Relay](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Relay). **[dshm.zyphite.com](https://dshm.zyphite.com)** is the project site: what the app is, what it looks like, and how to get it running, on one page. The [**wiki**](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki) is the user-facing guide: [getting started](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Getting-Started), [connecting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Connecting), [troubleshooting](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Troubleshooting), a [feature tour](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/Feature-Tour) and an [FAQ](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/wiki/FAQ). --- ## Screenshots | Connect | Chat | Trajectory | |:--:|:--:|:--:| | | | | | Recent harnesses with live reachability, LAN discovery, manual `host:port`, auto-connect. | Streamed turns, a glyph per tool, expandable tool cards, permission picker. | The same session as a per-turn ledger with usage totals. | | Session details | Subagents | |:--:|:--:| | | | | Context breakdown, goal, plan mode, background jobs, queued turns, host info, session-log export. | The subagent catalog — open a child's transcript, follow up, or interrupt it. | ## Features - Connecting — finds a harness on your Wi-Fi with an active subnet scan and a readiness handshake, remembers hosts and probes them for liveness on the way in, takes a manual `host:port`, handles loopback for same-device setups, and auto-connects when you tell it to (last used, LAN, or same device). - Navigation — the drawers work like Discord's: swipe right from the left edge for the workspace-grouped chat list, swipe left to close it, swipe left from the right edge for the session details panel. - Chat — streamed turns with reasoning disclosure, markdown, terminal/diff/read/search/web tool cards, a queue dock where you can edit, remove or steer a queued turn, history paging, and multi-photo and file attachments. Drafts are kept per host and session. - Workspace panels — tabbed text, Markdown, image, PDF and isolated HTML previews; native terminal controls with a bundled xterm renderer; archived-session restore in Settings. - Message feedback — confirmed ratings and retraction, with version-conflict handling. - Slash commands and skills — typing `/` lists the session's commands and skills above the composer. The composer checks a `/` line against the session's own command catalog and runs it through the harness's command gateway. Anything the catalog does not claim is sent as a prompt, which is how skills get invoked. With the dsh-rewind plugin on the host, `/rewind` opens a picker. - Everything the GUI does — goals (phases, rounds, pause/resume/edit), plan mode and plan review, permission approvals, user questions, todo dock, subagents (catalog, follow-ups, interrupt), background jobs, workflow runs, skills, model selection, agent presets, session search, trajectory ledger, session export, message feedback. - Notifications — turn complete, goal complete or blocked, review or question waiting for you. A foreground service keeps the connection alive in the background. - Harness look — the exact DeepSeek Harness design tokens (colors, type, radii, disclosure rows, shimmer, ink buttons), with light, dark and system themes. - 11 languages — English, 中文, हिन्दी, Español, Français, العربية, বাংলা, Português, Русский, اردو, ไทย (RTL aware). ### Added in 0.15.0 - A Check now button for updates in Settings > About. The automatic check also runs again when you come back to the app after a few hours. - Workspace links in replies drawn as file and folder pills; a folder opens in Files. - A redesigned Details panel, Workspace screen and Settings, with archived sessions on a tab of their own. ### Added in 0.14.0 - A `/` menu above the composer with the session's commands and skills. - A picker for the dsh-rewind plugin's `/rewind` and `/undo` that asks for confirmation before it restores files. The transcript hides what a rewind withdrew and marks the cut. ### Added in 0.13.0 - Automation catalog, timing edits, delivery history and session shortcuts. - Plugin installation, updates, toggles, removal, progress and recovery. Create plugin stages an unsent draft with the Creator preset when the host offers it. - Timed questions, continued replies, saved answer drafts and reopenable plans. - Draft text and file, folder and session references saved across app restarts. - Model search, YAML document properties and multiline goal editing. - Reverse-proxy path support and tool argument previews while the model is writing. ## Requirements - Android 8.0+ (minSdk 26). - A running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) at `0.2.1-alpha.2`, the protocol baseline for DSH Mobile `0.16.0`. Existing protocol fallbacks remain for `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.1.7-rc.x` and `0.1.6-alpha.x`; new management features need host support. See [compatibility](docs/COMPATIBILITY.md) and the [0.13.0 validation status](docs/VALIDATION-0.13.0.md) for what has been checked on this baseline. ## Quick start 1. Install the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/sorsama/deepseek-harness-mobile/releases/latest). 2. Open the app and choose how to connect. Relay and local network are two different setups, not two settings of one, so pick the one that matches wha

plugins.description: Unofficial visual control panel and MCP bridge for DeepSeek Harness: model, workspace and permission controls, task monitoring, and reusable sessions.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-bridge

English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

**A visible control panel for Claude Code and Codex delegation to DeepSeek Harness.** Choose the model, provider, workspace, and new-session permissions in Harness; inspect task state through MCP; find and continue the resulting conversations.

This project is for people who want to spend less of their main model's effort on bounded supporting tasks, and make repeated Harness calls and the resulting sessions easier to manage.

> Third-party, unofficial integration. Not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek, Anthropic, or OpenAI. Harness interfaces and MCP clients can change; check the compatibility notes before upgrading.

> **Archive-only maintenance in 0.2.4:** permanent deletion is disabled in every plugin entry point. The compatible `autoCleanupDays` setting now archives eligible MCP-created sessions, keeps their files, and uses the official non-stopping option; `0` turns automatic archival off. Old pending-delete files are retained unchanged and never executed. See [maintenance boundaries and upgrade notes](docs/troubleshooting.md#cleanup-limitation-and-pending-deletions).

## Why this bridge?

- **Delegate selectively.** Send a narrow review, summary, documentation task, or investigation to Harness, then bring the result back to your main agent.
- **Keep responsibility clear.** The main agent still scopes the task, checks the result, and integrates useful work.
- **Keep controls visible.** Use Harness's toolbar for task constraints and its conversations for context; use MCP status/results to inspect execution rather than relying on a silent handoff.
- **Manage repeated delegation.** Find task IDs after a disconnect, continue managed sessions, and archive conversations you want to keep.

Delegation can reduce the amount of work the main model performs, but it does not guarantee a fixed quota reduction, lower total cost, or faster completion. DeepSeek or your chosen provider can still charge for delegated work, and coordination, retries, and review still consume resources. See [choosing and measuring delegated tasks](docs/delegation.md).

## How it fits together

1. Claude Code, Codex, or another compatible MCP client sends a tool request.
2. The local bridge connects that request to the plugin running in DeepSeek Harness.
3. A Harness agent uses the configured provider, workspace, and execution permissions.
4. The client receives the task result for review and further work.

**A local bridge does not mean local model inference.** Prompts and relevant workspace content may be sent to the provider configured in Harness. Check your provider's terms and your own data-sharing permissions before delegating private material.

The current plugin installs into the **desktop profile**, so that Harness host must be running. This is a good fit if you already use Harness and delegate frequently. A one-off task may not justify the extra installation and process. Harness also has an official CLI; other hosting profiles for this plugin have not been verified. [CLI and hosting FAQ](docs/troubleshooting.md#does-harness-have-a-cli).

## Quick start

Bridge version: **0.2.4**. Target Harness desktop version: **0.2.1-rc.2**. Build with Node.js **22+** and npm. Maintainer-provided verification notes cover Windows; they do not establish support for every platform or MCP client.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/FishCityBee/dsh-mcp-bridge.git
cd dsh-mcp-bridge
npm ci
npm run build
```

Install `dist-package/` with Harness's bundled CLI. Windows PowerShell example, with paths replaced for your installation:

```powershell
& "D:\Program Files\Deepseek Harness\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd" plugin --profile desktop add "C:\path\to\dsh-mcp-bridge\dist-package"
```

Completely quit Harness, including the tray process, and reopen it. In the bridge toolbar, select your provider/model, a disposable default workspace, and read-only new-session permissions. Automatic archival defaults to off; enable it only after reviewing its scope.

Register the relay in the client you use, with its absolute path:

```sh
# Claude Code
claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user dsh-harness -- node "C:/path/to/dsh-mcp-bridge/dist-package/bin/stdio.mjs"

# Codex
codex mcp add dsh-harness -- node "C:/path/to/dsh-mcp-bridge/dist-package/bin/stdio.mjs"
```

Ask the client to call `harness_status`, `list_models`, and `list_workspaces` before starting a task. Then try one small task with no file changes. Model tasks can incur provider charges. See [installation, timeouts, environment variables, and upgrade steps](docs/installation.md) for complete instructions and official client references.

## Controls that matter

- **Model constraints:** single-model mode locks provider/model/effort. Provider mode also locks model/effort unless the user enables caller overrides; the provider stays locked.
- **Execution evidence:** requested and effective model selections are separate. `effectiveSelection` is populated only after the bridge observes a request, and does not prove provider acceptance or billing.
- **Permissions:** new-session presets use Harness's official permission service; that selector leaves existing sessions unchanged. Full access is a high-risk option, not a setup requirement.
- **Task lifecycle:** start, wait, inspect, find, and cancel tasks. Client disconnects are separate from task cancellation; cancellation cannot undo completed effects.
- **Sessions:** continue bridge-managed conversations and archive/unarchive them. Automatic maintenance only archives; permanent deletion is unavailable.

The default connection uses a local pipe/socket with the stdio relay, without opening a TCP port. Optional HTTP is off by default. Update the plugin and the entire relay together; 0.2.4 uses `tls-pinned-v3` and does not fall back to older handshakes.

## Documentation

- [Installation and Claude Code / Codex setup](docs/installation.md)
- [Configuration, model defaults, and permission boundaries](docs/configuration.md)
- [Tool reference, task recovery, and session maintenance](docs/usage.md)
- [Troubleshooting and FAQ](docs/troubleshooting.md)
- [Delegating useful work](docs/delegation.md)
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Security and responsible reporting](SECURITY.md)

## Permission boundaries

There are two separate decisions: whether your MCP client may call a bridge tool, and whether the Harness agent may perform an operation. Client-side MCP approval is not a replacement for Harness execution approval. Choosing a workspace does not by itself sandbox an agent.

Start in a disposable workspace with a small, read-only task. Keep credentials out of prompts, screenshots, and issue reports. Review substantive results before accepting changes. Back up important session data. Plugin deletion stays disabled until an official safe cross-process deletion boundary is available.

## Compatibility and verification

This bridge relies on version-specific Harness APIs and storage behavior. Other Harness versions, alternate profiles, and all client/platform combinations are not implied to be supported.

The repository includes maintainer-written technical records in Chinese: [reliability changes](docs/audit-2026-10-17.md), [desktop transport checks](docs/desktop-2026-10-18.md), and [new-session permission checks](docs/ui-permissions-2026-10-18.md). The [0.2.4 maintenance notes](docs/recheck-0.2.4.md) distinguish the current changes from earlier historical reports. Their stated test scope and remaining gaps matter; they are not a claim that all security risks or UI paths have been validated.

## Contribute

Bug reports, compatibility checks, translations, and focused pull requests are welcome in English or Chinese. Please read the [contribution guide](CONTRIBUTING.md), and keep secrets and private session content out of public reports.

If this project helps your workflow, a star helps others discover it.

# dsh-rea-toggle

[English](#english) · [中文](#中文)

One switch per conversation that decides whether the **REA**
(`reverse-engineer-anything`) MCP server's context reaches the model at all.

REA registers **207 tool schemas** plus a multi-kilobyte server-instructions
block. `dsh-mcp-client` puts both on the **global** layer, so every agent pays
for them on every request — whether or not the turn has anything to do with
reverse engineering.

With this plugin installed, a small pill appears below the composer:

- **REA on** (green) — exactly the pre-install behaviour. REA's tools and
  instructions are visible to the model.
- **REA off** (grey) — those 207 tool schemas and the `mcp:rea` instructions
  block **leave the model context**, taking effect on the next step.

**The switch is per conversation.** Each conversation remembers its own
position, and a new conversation starts **off**. That is the whole point: a
conversation about a web app should not pay for 207 reverse-engineering schemas
just because some other conversation needs them. Subagents inherit the position
of the conversation that created them, so delegating inside reverse-engineering
work does not silently break the subagent.

The same switch is on the keyboard: `/rea off`, `/rea on`, `/rea status`,
`/rea toggle` — all acting on the conversation you typed them in.

Nothing is uninstalled and nothing restarts. The MCP connection stays up; the
model simply stops being told those tools exist.

---

## English

### What it actually does

The token cost comes from two different places that travel two different paths,
so one mechanism is not enough:

| Target | Mechanism |
| --- | --- |
| Tool schemas | `tools.restrict({ deny })` is called **in each agent's own context**. `ToolRuntime.view()` filters what that scope *inherits* from the global layer, and the model-facing schema list is rebuilt from that view on every assembly. The reserved `run_code` transport sits outside the filterable layers, so it is unaffected. |
| Instructions text | `dsh-mcp-client` registers the server instructions as a prompt section named `mcp:<server>` at order `MCP_SERVERS` (3100). **A scoped section with the same name shadows the global one** — a documented contract of `systemPrompt.section()` ("a scoped section shadows a global section with the same name"), not an implementation detail — and an empty section is dropped at render (`renderPrompt` keeps only `text.length > 0`). Registering that name and returning `''` therefore removes the block for that agent alone. |

Both are scoped registrations, so disposing them restores the previous state
exactly. That is why flipping the switch needs no restart and no reload.

Coverage includes **subagents**: `agent/created` is serial and awaited by the
registry, so installing inside it lands ahead of any prompt assembly.

### Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:aurumple/dsh-rea-toggle
```

Or point at a checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-rea-toggle
```

The bundle row id is `rea-toggle`; the package name is `dsh-rea-toggle`.

### Use

| Where | What |
| --- | --- |
| Pill under the composer | Click to flip **this conversation**. Green = on, grey = off, red border = the host did not answer. |
| `/rea off` · `/rea on` | Set this conversation's position. `enable` / `disable` work too. |
| `/rea toggle` | Flip this conversation. |
| `/rea status` | Report this conversation's position. |

A new conversation starts off. The first time you turn one on, that conversation
is remembered; conversations you never touch stay on the default and are not
written down.

Positions are remembered in `$DSH_HOME/rea-toggle.json` (usually
`~/.dsh/rea-toggle.json`), keyed by session id, and survive a restart. The file
keeps the 500 most recently changed conversations; an older one simply falls
back to the default.

### Configuration

Every field is optional.

```yaml
- id: rea-toggle
  name: dsh-rea-toggle
  config:
    server: rea               # one MCP server to govern; default "rea"
    # servers: [rea, ghidra]  # or several; wins over `server` when present
    # defaultEnabled: true    # new conversations start ON instead of off
```

Changing `server` governs a different MCP server by the same rules: tool prefix
`mcp__<server>__`, instructions section `mcp:<server>`. Because the mechanism is
generic, this works for any MCP server whose tools are bridged by
`dsh-mcp-client` — the REA case is just the one that motivated it.

`defaultEnabled` exists for anyone who wants the pre-plugin behaviour back: with
it on, a conversation nobody has switched behaves exactly as if this plugin were
not installed.

### HTTP API

The Client half talks to the Host over one exact route on the bare `webServer`
(the same shape other bundles use, so it does not travel through the `/api`
prefix fence). The conversation is `session=` on GET and a body field on POST:
the pill always knows which conversation it is showing, and a request that does
not say cannot be answered for it.

```
GET  /rea-toggle/state?session=<id>
  -> { session, enabled, known, defaultEnabled, servers, agents, tools, statePath }

GET  /rea-toggle/state            (no session: a summary)
  -> { session: null, defaultEnabled, servers, conversations, agents, tools, statePath }

POST /rea-toggle/state
  body: { "session": "<id>", "enabled": true | false }   (omit `enabled` to flip)
  -> the per-conversation status object
```

`known` says whether this conversation has ever been switched; when it is
`false`, `enabled` is just `defaultEnabled` and nothing has been written yet.
`agents` is how many live agents of that conversation are currently covered;
`tools` is how many of the governed server's tools were recognised, which is the
honest answer to "did it find REA at all" — if it reads `0`, the server is not
connected under that name (and stays `0`-safe because `restrictableNames` is the
denyable set, not the filtered view).

### Scope and limits

- **One server per row by default.** Other MCP servers are untouched; use
  `servers` to govern more than one.
- **Hidden, not unloaded.** The MCP connection stays up and the REA process
  keeps running. When the switch is off the model simply cannot reach it —
  including indirectly through `run_code`. That is deliberate: leaving a second
  path open would save only half the tokens.
- **Per-conversation state, in-process.** Positions are read from the file at
  `apply()` and written on every change. Two DSH instances sharing one profile
  each read it once and do not live-sync with each other.
- **It does not delete anything.** Turning it off is reversible in one click,
  and uninstalling the bundle lifts every registration.

### Verify it yourself

The claim is that the tools are gone from the model's context, not merely
hidden in a UI. Check it where the model's own view is exposed:

1. With the switch **on**, ask the agent to list its tools — `mcp__rea__*`
   entries are there (207 of them for a stock REA install).
2. Turn it **off**, ask again — they are gone, and calling one by name returns
   `Error: unknown tool "mcp__rea__binary_session"`.
3. Turn it back **on** — they return, unchanged.
4. Open a **second conversation** and check its tool list: it is off, while the
   first one is still on. That is the property that distinguishes this plugin
   from a global toggle.

### Development

```bash
npm test        # node:test, no dependencies
```

The suite drives the real `apply()` against a small model of the three
contracts it depends on (tool view, prompt section merge, agent registry). It
pins what "off" removes, that "on" restores the previous state exactly, that a
new subagent is covered before its first step, that the position survives a
restart, and that the HTTP surface validates its input.

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-token-bar

[![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 Web 界面加一条**单轮 token 用量条**：放在每条回复自己的图标行里（复制 / 分支 / 用量 / 时间那一行），把这一轮的缓存结构画成灰 / 黄 / 绿三段条，配一条带百分比的完整图例。

![回复图标行里的单轮用量条：灰=未缓存输入、黄=缓存读取、绿=输出，后面跟带百分比的图例](docs/screenshot-turn-bar.png)

**极轻量**：纯客户端展示，不联网、不落盘、不注册任何 Host 路由、不写会话日志、不改任何官方包。
**零依赖**：一个手写 bundle，只用平台提供的 React。

[English](README.en.md) | 中文

---

## 它解决什么

官方在每条回复末尾的用量气泡里，点开能看到「本轮用量」的精确数字。但**数字是列表，要读；结构是形状，一眼就懂**：

- 这一轮是不是全命中缓存？
- 有没有跑出大量未缓存输入（意味着前缀失效、成本变高）？
- 输出占比是否异常？

`dsh-token-bar` 把这三个数字变成一条可扫视的带状图，并且带图例——**不需要悬停也知道每段是什么、占多少**。

## 外观

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 段序 / 图例序 | **灰（未缓存输入）→ 黄（缓存读取）→ 绿（输出）**，条与图例完全同序 |
| 条宽 | 132px |
| 最小段宽 | 只要有 token 就至少 **6px**，再小的占比也看得见，不会和图例对不上 |
| 图例 | 色点 + 名称 + 本轮占比百分比 |
| 字号 | 比正文小一号：`calc(var(--dsh-content-font-size-secondary, 13px) - 1px)`，跟随设置里的字号 |
| 配色 | 全部取自 `--dsw-*` 主题 token，浅色 / 深色自动跟随 |
| 对齐 | 图标行内垂直居中 |

悬停显示本轮完整明细：缓存命中率 + 每段精确 token 数与占比。

> 缓存写入未单独成段——当前路由上该值恒为 0。

## 数据来源

读本轮 `turn-tail` location data 里的 `tokenUsage`，即**本轮**的用量（和官方「本轮用量」弹窗同源），**不是**会话累计。

`conversation.chat.assistant-actions` 这个插槽只把**消息 id** 交给组件，所以 `useChat` 会从本轮数据反查一次：每条完成的 Turn 都会发布一份 `turn-tail`，里面既有收尾消息的 `messageId`，也有它自己的 `tokenUsage`——对上 id 就拿到了这一轮的账目。`useChat` 属于会话级插槽标配（`dsh-client-ui-chat` 的 `slots.d.ts` 把 `useChat` 挂在 `SessionStandardProps` 上），不需要额外注入。

感谢 [dsh-token-counter](https://github.com/OkliaoliO/dsh-token-counter) 提供的实现参考。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-token-bar
```

或从本地目录安装（开发时）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-token-bar
```

安装后**重启 `dsh web`** 生效。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-token-bar
```

## 兼容性

| 组件 | 支持 |
|---|---|
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`，在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 上实测 |
| Node.js | `>=20` |
| 界面 | DSH Web（依赖 `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` 插槽） |
| 系统 | macOS / Linux / Windows（纯 JavaScript） |

## 开发

```sh
npm run check   # 语法检查
npm test        # 纯函数测试 + 渲染测试
```

`npm test` 默认测试**源码** `client.js`。想验证浏览器实际收到的那份构建产物，从运行中的 `dsh web` 抽一份快照：

```sh
node scripts/snapshot-bundle.mjs "http://127.0.0.1:3080/?token=<启动时打印的 token>"
npm test        # 检测到 verify-module.js 后，自动改为测试服务端下发的产物
```

### 网络受限时推送

如果所在网络访问不了 `github.com:443`（`git push` 卡住超时）但 `api.github.com` 可以访问，用 REST API 推送：

```sh
node scripts/push-via-api.mjs <owner>/<repo> --dry-run   # 先看要推什么
node scripts/push-via-api.mjs <owner>/<repo>             # 真正推送
```

它会按 blobs → trees → commits 重放本地历史，并把分支指向**远端生成的**新 commit SHA（API 创建的 commit 与本地 SHA 不同，这点最容易踩坑）。

## 可调参数

都在 `client.js` 顶部：

| 常量 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `BUCKETS` | 三段（顺序、名称、颜色） |
| `MIN_SEGMENT_PX` | 最小段宽，默认 `6` |
| `TRACK_PX` | 条宽，默认 `132` |
| `FONT_SIZE` | 字号，默认比正文小一号 |

## 已知限制

- 只覆盖完成（`turn/end`）的轮次；正在流式输出的那一轮没有条。
- **图标行常驻**：官方默认只让最新一条回复的图标行常驻，更早的回复要悬停才淡入。为了让条一直看得见，插件把助手那一行固定为可见——只动带 `data-clock="end"` 的行，用户气泡不受影响。代价是每条回复下方的图标行都常显。
- **位置受官方排列约束**：那一行的顺序是硬编码的（复制 → 插件动作 → 分支 → 用量 → 时间），唯一可用的插件插槽在复制与分支之间。所以条落在用量左侧，而不是「用量和时间之间」——官方没有在那里留插槽。
- 依赖官方 `turn-tail` 的 location data 结构；DSH 若改动该结构，需要跟随适配。
- 没有设计器 / 配置界面，改样式需要编辑源码。

## 许可

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# Language Guard (dsh-language-guard)

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

> Make the DSH agent think and answer in the language you choose — Simplified Chinese by default, three strength levels, effective on the next message, zero dependencies, no build step.

---

## Table of Contents

- [Why you need it](#why-you-need-it)
- [What it does](#what-it-does)
- [Install](#install)
- [Strength levels](#strength-levels)
- [Configuration](#configuration)
- [Automatic language mode](#automatic-language-mode)
- [Settings panel and quick language switch](#settings-panel-and-quick-language-switch)
- [The `/language` slash command](#the-language-slash-command)
- [Verifying that the constraint reached the system prompt](#verifying-that-the-constraint-reached-the-system-prompt)
- [Coexisting with dsh-context](#coexisting-with-dsh-context)
- [How it differs from the official cot-translation plugin](#how-it-differs-from-the-official-cot-translation-plugin)
- [Known limitations](#known-limitations)
- [Design boundaries](#design-boundaries)
- [License](#license)

---

## Why you need it

The DSH system prompt is assembled from many sections: identity, plan policy, team policy, **tool descriptions**, deliverable references, deployment persona. The largest block by far is the tool documentation — written in English, and placed in the middle of the prompt.

Measured on DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 (everything after order 50): **98.1% of the characters and 99.8% of the ASCII** come from English tool documentation, and 5.7K–14K characters separate the opening section from the closing one. The model reads overwhelmingly English tokens, and so it drifts:

- The first few turns stay in your language;
- as soon as it starts chaining tool calls, reading long files, or reasoning at length, the reasoning slides back into English;
- nothing in your settings changed — the conversation simply got longer.

A single "please answer in Chinese" line at the very top of the system prompt is enough for a short session. It is not enough for a long one, because that line sits tens of thousands of characters away from the place that actually influences the model (the tool documentation).

This plugin puts a constraint in **three places**: at the very start, right after the tool documentation, and at the very end. The default level (Strong) costs roughly 118 extra characters per request and buys one restatement positioned after the English tool docs.

## What it does

Three resident system-prompt sections, registered through `ctx.systemPrompt.section()`, never disposed, switching level only switches their text:

| Section name | Order | Position | B | C | D |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `language-guard:head` | `-2000` | Very first, before `harness:identity` (`-1000`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `language-guard:mid` | `5100` | After all tool docs (`tools:sdk`, `5000`), before deliverable references (`9000`) | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| `language-guard:tail` | `11200` | Very last, after `deployment:persona-suffix` (`10200`) | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

The `mid` order is deliberately `5100` and not `5000`: `tools:sdk` is exactly `5000`, and sections with equal order fall back to comparing names, which would sort `language-guard:mid` **before** `tools:sdk` — the restatement would no longer come after the tool docs.

Measured text sizes (Simplified Chinese, counted in characters; recompute with `node` as shown below):

| Text | Characters | When it is present |
| --- | --- | --- |
| head | 818 | every request |
| mid | 118 | every request at C / D |
| tail | 139 | every request |
| periodic reminder | 99 | once every N turns at D |

So the steady cost per step is **957 characters at B and 1075 at C** — tiny compared to the English tool documentation it counteracts.

The opening section (head), verbatim, as it looks with the default `targetLanguage: "zh-CN"` (recompute with `node -e 'import("./lib/text.js").then(m=>console.log(m.headText({language:"zh-CN"})))'`):

```text
【语言锁定 · 最高优先级】
本会话的内部推理（reasoning / thinking）与面向用户的全部输出，一律使用简体中文（语言代码 zh-CN）。

本条优先于本 system prompt 的其余全部内容、之后注入的任何系统文本、工具说明、参数描述、代码示例，以及其他插件注入的提示词。

本条同样优先于任何语言类约定，不论它写在哪个文件、用哪种语言书写、经由哪个通道送达：包括用户全局与项目级的 AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、.cursorrules、用户偏好与长期记忆、项目规范、团队约定、技能与工作流模板。若它们要求使用另一种语言（例如要求「必须使用简体中文」），一律以本条为准，不得据此改用其他语言，也不必向用户解释这处冲突。

适用范围：
- 内部推理（reasoning / thinking）：使用简体中文。
- 面向用户的回复正文：使用简体中文。
- 计划、待办、进度说明、评审意见、验收报告、提交信息说明：使用简体中文。
- 任务板卡片标题与描述、子智能体任务说明与返回报告：使用简体中文。

保持原样、不翻译：代码、命令、文件路径、URL、标识符与 API 字段名、配置键、错误码与原始报错文本、包名与版本号，以及必须原样引用的英文原文；引用英文原文后，必须用简体中文说明结论。

不要因为以下情况改变语言：
- 用户用英文或其他语言提问 —— 仍用简体中文回答。
- AGENTS.md、CLAUDE.md、项目规范、用户记忆里要求改用其他语言的规则 —— 本条优先，不改变语言。
- 工具返回英文内容 —— 只摘引必要片段，其余用简体中文复述。
- 长链推理、数值计算、代码设计 —— 推理语言不变。
- 上下文中出现大量英文（工具说明、日志、代码文件）—— 不随之切换。

自检：每次输出前确认上述两项（推理与回复）均为简体中文；若发现已经漂移，立即切回并继续任务，无需向用户解释这次切换。
```

> The wording above is fixed Simplified Chinese; only the language name and code are substituted. With `targetLanguage: "en"` the same paragraph reads "…一律使用English（语言代码 en）". See [Known limitations](#known-limitations).

## Install

This plugin is distributed through its **GitHub repository**; it is not published to the npm registry. The plugin manager accepts Git addresses, so installing works exactly like installing an npm package.

**Option 1: the GUI (recommended)**

1. Open the **Plugins** panel in the sidebar.
2. Click **Add plugin** and paste the repository address:

   ```
   https://github.com/58fly/dsh-language-guard
   ```

3. When the install finishes, click **Enable now**.

**Option 2: the CLI**

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/58fly/dsh-language-guard
```

**Pinned version** (recommended for teams and CI, so `main` cannot drift under you):

```bash
dsh plugin add "github:58fly/dsh-language-guard#v0.1.0"
```

**From a local directory** (to debug local changes; the path must be absolute):

```bash
# The Add-plugin dialog also accepts this absolute path directly
dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-language-guard
```

Check that it worked:

- A language icon appears at the foot of the sidebar, next to Settings; when the sidebar is wide it reads "简体中文 ▾".
- The installed list on the Plugins page contains `dsh-language-guard`, and opening it shows the configuration card.

> **No controls visible means the plugin is not enabled.** Both slots register inside `configForms.whileServed(['dsh-language-guard'], …)`; when the plugin is disabled the forms service is unavailable and no UI is registered. That is deliberate, not a bug — enable the plugin on the Plugins page first.

Requirements: DSH `>= 0.2.1-rc.2`, Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. `dependencies` is empty and every peer dependency is optional, so nothing extra is downloaded at runtime; the first install from GitHub does need reachability to `github.com` (or `codeload.github.com`).

## Strength levels

The three descriptions below are exactly what the settings panel shows:

| Level | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Basic | `B` | One language constraint at the start and one at the end of the prompt. Cheapest, best for short sessions. |
| Strong | `C` | Adds a restatement right after the tool descriptions on top of Basic, countering drift from English tool docs. Recommended default. |
| Periodic | `D` | Adds a language self-check at the start of every Nth turn on top of Strong, for long sessions. The reminder appears as a session record and is visible in the session log. |

Behaviour differences:

| Behaviour | B | C | D |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Resident system-prompt sections | head + tail | head + mid + tail | head + mid + tail |
| Restatement after tool docs | ❌ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Self-check every N turns | ❌ | ❌ | ✅ (N defaults to 8, range 3–50) |
| New record in the session log | none | none | one per N turns (`source.kind = "language-guard"`) |
| Injection timing | — | — | the **first step** of a matching turn, alongside that turn's user message; no extra request |
| Counter after restart / resume | — | — | **not reset**: the turn number comes from the session log's `turn` projection, so `turn % N` is stable |
| Best for | short sessions, token-sensitive | the default | long sessions, or drift already observed |

How to choose:

- **Start with the default, Strong.*

plugins.description: Ordered web-search failover provider for DeepSeek Harness: try backends in priority order, fall back automatically.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-search-failover

DeepSeek Harness 的搜索故障转移插件：按顺序尝试多个搜索后端，前一个失败（HTTP 错误、没有 `web_search_tool_result` 结果块、或返回空结果）时自动落到下一个。

> **English.** A failover web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness. The harness resolves exactly one search provider per `ctx.web` seam and a provider carries a single `model`, so one upstream error kills the whole search. This bundle registers a `deepseek-failover` provider that walks an ordered list of backends — same request, next backend on any failure (throw, abort excepted, or an empty result) — and only fails when every backend did. The stock `web-search-deepseek` row is disabled by the bundle's own patch, so no manual profile editing is needed. Node ≥ 22, harness ≥ 0.2.1, MIT.

## 为什么需要它

Harness 的 `ctx.web` 每次只解析一个 search provider，provider 也只有单个 `model` 字段，没有失败重试链；`web-search-deepseek` 一旦上游出错，整次搜索就失败。new-api 的自动换渠道只在“同一个模型名有多个渠道”时生效，所以要么在网关造一个别名，要么在 harness 侧做转移。本插件选后者：网关保持官方模型名。

## 兼容性

| 平台 | 支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11（PowerShell 7 或 5.1） | ✅ | `dsh plugin` 本身跨平台；本文所有命令在 PowerShell 里原样可跑 |
| macOS（zsh / bash） | ✅ | 原生路径 |
| Linux | ✅ | 原生路径 |

前置条件：

- **DSH ≥ 0.2.1** — 插件复用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek` 导出的 `DeepSeekSearchProvider`，0.2.0 没有这个接口
- **Node ≥ 22**，且 **`pnpm` 在 `PATH` 上**（`dsh plugin` 内部调 pnpm）
- 能访问 `https://codeload.github.com`（public 仓库，不需要 token）
- 一个 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容的搜索网关，以及它的 API key

## 安装

一条命令（自动写依赖、写 `dsh.profile.bundles`、并跑 `pnpm install`）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

```powershell
# Windows 上完全一样
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

然后**重启 DSH**（关掉 `dsh web` 的终端再重新起）。插件是在 host 启动时 import 的，不重启不会生效 —— 详见排错第 1 条。

Desktop 版 profile 名是 `desktop`，需要先**完全退出应用**再加：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

插件没有 `prepare` 脚本、没有构建步骤，纯 JS，不会触发 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 拦截。

### 凭据

插件的 `apiKeyEnv` 指向一个**凭据引用名**，不是明文。把网关令牌写进 harness 的凭据文件：

- macOS / Linux：`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`
- Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\.credentials.yaml`

```yaml
refs:
  NEWAPI_API_KEY: sk-...
```

这个文件由 harness 的 credentials 插件注入，**不需要写系统环境变量**。如果你更习惯环境变量，把 `apiKeyEnv` 改成对应的变量名即可。

### 不想用 CLI 时

手工改 profile 的 `package.json` 效果一样：

```jsonc
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-web-search-failover": "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover"
},
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-web-search-failover" ] } }
```

再在 profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`，Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web`）跑 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH。

## 验证

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 "searchProvider"
```

```powershell
dsh --profile web --dump-config | Select-String -Pattern "searchProvider" -Context 0,3
```

应看到 `searchProvider: deepseek-failover`。再做一次真实搜索，网关日志里会出现主后端的模型名；只有主后端失败时才会多一条备用后端。

**关于默认网关地址**：插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `baseURL` 写的是一个示例网关（`http://43.133.21.227:3000/v1`）。用别人的地址跑不通，**请改成你自己的网关**，见下一节。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖 `id: web-search-failover` 这一行的 `config`（插件自带的默认顺序是 `deepseek-v4-flash` → `claude-haiku-5-5`，不覆盖就按这个走）：

```yaml
- id: web-search-failover
  config:
    providerId: deepseek-failover   # ctx.web 选中的 provider 名，一般不用改
    backends:
      - { model: deepseek-v4-flash,  baseURL: https://your-gateway/v1, apiKeyEnv: NEWAPI_API_KEY }
      - { model: claude-haiku-5-5,   baseURL: https://your-gateway/v1, apiKeyEnv: NEWAPI_API_KEY }
```

| 键 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `providerId` | `deepseek-failover` | 注册给 `ctx.web` 的 provider 名；bundle patch 里 `web.searchProvider` 必须与它一致 |
| `backends` | — | **有序**列表，第 0 个优先，其后都是备胎；每项 `model` / `baseURL` / `apiKeyEnv` 各自独立 |
| `apiKeyEnv` / `baseURL` / `apiKey` / `apiVersion` / `maxTokens` / `maxUses` | 见 `lib/index.js` 的 `Config` | 旧式单后端字段；用 `backends` 时不需要，插件按 backend 逐个构造 provider |

失败判定：抛错、或者成功但没有 sources。`WEB_ABORTED`（用户取消）直接向上抛，不换后端 —— 取消不该触发备用后端。全部失败才返回最后一个错误；如果所有后端都成功但确实没结果，返回那个空结果。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-search-failover
```

然后重启 DSH。bundle 的 patch 随之失效，harness 原有的 `web-search-deepseek` 行会恢复；如果你之前手工在 profile patch 里删过它，需要自己加回来。

## 排错

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh plugin add` 成功，但搜索行为没变 | 插件在 host 进程启动时 import，进程里的模块不会热替换 | 重启 DSH（关掉 `dsh web` 再起） |
| 改了插件源码（哪怕是 `lib/index.js`）也不生效 | Node 的 ESM 缓存：已 import 的模块不会重新执行 | 同上，重启 host；GitHub 安装还需先 `dsh plugin add` 重装以拉新代码 |
| `dsh plugin add` 卡住或报网络错误 | 拉的是 `codeload.github.com` 的 tarball，公司网络/代理常拦 | 走代理，或把仓库整目录拷过去，依赖改成 `file:` 路径后 `pnpm install`（插件无外部 npm 依赖，离线可装） |
| 报 `WEB_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | 所有 backends 都 `available() === false`，通常是 `apiKeyEnv` 指向的引用没有值 | 检查 `.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 里有该键，且键名与 `apiKeyEnv` 完全一致 |
| 搜索一直是备用后端的模型 | 主后端失败但未报错（返回空结果也会触发回落） | 看网关日志确认主后端返回码；密钥额度、模型名拼写是最常见原因 |
| 配置树里出现同一个 row id 冲突（`web-search-deepseek` 被两处同时声明） | profile patch 里手工加过 `id: web-search-deepseek` 的行，与 bundle patch 打架 | 删掉 profile 里那一行，插件自带的 patch 已负责禁用它 |

## 同步到另一台机器

逻辑全在插件里，换机器不需要搬配置，但要满足四件事：

1. **装插件**：跑上面那条 `dsh plugin add`。版本自动跟 `master` 最新提交，两台机器不必同 commit，但 harness 版本要一致（都 ≥ 0.2.1）。
2. **凭据**：`.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 里要有 `NEWAPI_API_KEY`。
3. **清掉旧的 provider 行**：profile patch 里若还有 `- id: web-search-deepseek`，删掉。
4. **网关可达**：`baseURL` 换成本机可访问的地址。

## 开发

本仓库是纯 JS、无构建步骤。仓库里没有 `node_modules`，直接 `npm test` 会因为找不到 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的 peer 依赖而失败 —— 先把本机已安装的 harness 包链进来：

```bash
node scripts/dev-link.mjs            # 探测 dsh 的安装位置，链入 schemastery / dsh-web / dsh-web-search-deepseek 等
npm test                             # node --test
```

`dev-link` 依次探测：`dsh` 可执行文件所在的 npm 目录、`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>`、`$DSH_HOME/profiles`、`$DSH_HOME`，也可以用第一个参数或 `DSH_PACKAGE_DIR` 直接指定 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 所在目录。Windows 上用 junction，不需要管理员权限。

改完代码在本地验证，再装到 profile：`dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库绝对路径>` 走 `link:` 依赖，配合 `dev-link` 即可改完重启 host 就看到效果。

## 相关插件

同作者、同一套安装方式（`dsh plugin add github:xingzoudefengye/<repo>`）：

- [dsh-browser](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-browser) — 给 agent 一个可驱动的真实浏览器，侧栏并排显示
- [dsh-compaction-local-handoff](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff) — 无模型的本地交接式压缩
- [dsh-project-memory](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-project-memory) — 有界、可提交进 git 的项目记忆
- [dsh-resume-budget](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-resume-budget) — 会话恢复时的输入预算控制
- [dsh-session-recall](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-session-recall) — 无模型、有界的会话史书

## 许可

MIT © xingzoudefengye，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DeepSeek 官方 API 峰谷价格提醒：Harness Web UI 胶囊 + deepseek_price_tip Agent 工具
plugins.readme_text: # DeepSeek 价格峰谷提醒 [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/jaaaa34/dsh-deepseek-price-tip) --- 在 Harness Web UI 的输入框下方显示一个小胶囊，提醒你 DeepSeek 官方 API 当前处于 **峰价** 还是 **谷价**，以及距离下次切换还有多久。点开胶囊可以查看当前价目表（人民币）、峰时规则、数据来源和抓取时间，并可从官网重新抓取。 胶囊样式和原生胶囊（会话统计、Token 用量、上下文用量）保持一致。 使用 DeepSeek Harness 的创造模式完成。 ## 功能 - **实时读数**：按官网规则计算当前时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，周一至周五，不含中国法定节假日），并倒计时到下一次切换。 - **人民币价目表**：读取官方中文定价页，显示模型、档位、缓存命中/未命中输入价、输出价，峰/谷两档同时列出，当前生效的一档高亮。 - **从官网更新**：面板里的“立即更新”会读取 ，同时更新价格和峰谷时段规则（时间窗口、星期、是否排除节假日）。 - **自动更新**：启动时以及之后每 30 分钟检查一次，缓存超过 `autoRefreshHours` 小时就在后台重新抓取。抓取失败时保留旧表，并在面板里报告原因。 - **Agent 工具**：`deepseek_price_tip`，`action: status | refresh`，与面板共用同一份数据。 ### 截图展示 ## 安装 本仓库就是插件包本身（`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 和 `dsh.client`），没有构建步骤，也没有第三方依赖，只用 Node 内置模块。 **从 GitHub 安装** 在 Harness 的插件管理里安装这个 bundle，安装 spec 填： ```text github:jaaaa34/dsh-deepseek-price-tip ``` 也可以让 Agent 调用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 用同一个 spec。装好后重启 Harness Web UI，输入框下方就会出现胶囊。 **本地开发时直接 link** 在 profile 的 `package.json` 里把依赖指向本目录，并把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`： ```json "@local/deepseek-price-tip": "link:C:/path/to/dsh-deepseek-price-tip" ``` ## 数据与缓存 | 内容 | 位置 | | --- | --- | | 人民币价格、峰时窗口、星期规则 | 首次抓取后写入 `data/pricing-cache.json` | | 内置兜底数据 | `lib/pricing.js` 的 `DEFAULT_PRICING`（2026-10-18 抓取，人民币） | | 中国法定节假日 | 内置 2026 年安排，来源见 `HOLIDAY_SOURCE`；跨年后请用配置补充 | 如果官网表格结构发生大改，解析会失败而不是写入半张表：界面继续显示上一次成功的数据，并提示失败原因。 ## 配置 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中给这一行加 `config`： ```yaml - id: deepseek-price-tip name: '@local/deepseek-price-tip' config: autoRefreshHours: 6 # 可选：覆盖峰时窗口，单位是 UTC 零点的分钟数 # peakWindows: [[60, 240], [360, 600]] # 可选：覆盖星期（0 = 周日，6 = 周六） # weekdays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] # 可选：追加法定节假日（YYYY-MM-DD） # holidays: ['2027-01-01'] # 可选：换一个抓取地址（英文页会按美元解析并显示 $） # sourceUrl: 'https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing' ``` `autoRefreshHours: 0` 关闭自动抓取，只保留手动按钮。 ## 验证 ```powershell npm test ``` 也可以单独跑其中一组： ```powershell node test/pricing.test.mjs # 解析、峰谷计算、节假日、缓存校验 node test/host.test.mjs # Host 路由、刷新、失败回退、Agent 工具 node test/client.test.mjs # Client 注册、locale 字典、样式清理 ``` 不需要 `npm install`：测试只用 Node 内置模块（Node 20+）。GitHub Actions 在 Node 20/22/24 上跑同一套测试，见 `.github/workflows/test.yml`。 安装后在 Harness Web UI 里确认：输入框下方出现胶囊；点开有价目表；点“立即更新”后抓取时间变化。浏览器内的实际渲染效果需要在页面中查看，测试只覆盖模块注册和纯逻辑。 ## 限制 - 峰时窗口支持官网中文页的“北京时间 … 为高峰时段”和英文页的 “Peak hours are … UTC” 两种写法；页面改版时可能需要调整解析器。 - 节假日只内置到 2026 年。2027 年及以后，界面会明确提示“未内置该年节假日”，避免把节假日误报成峰价。 - 价格表按官网当前的“模型列 + 峰/谷行”结构解析；Search & Fetch 的按次计费不在模型价目表内。 - 人民币价格直接取自官方中文页，不是按汇率从美元换算。 - 缓存写在插件包目录里的 `data/pricing-cache.json`（已在 `.gitignore` 中忽略）。重新安装或升级插件会让这份缓存丢失，下次刷新时重新抓取，期间用内置的 `DEFAULT_PRICING` 兜底。

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

plugins.description: Normify · DSH 插件：把项目架构写成归一化的分形模块树，三层校验（写时 / 校验 / 冻结回执）、30 个 normify_* 工具 + normify-gen 技能，一键渲染单文件交互式架构图；支持伴随式开发（change_open → brief → check → 实施 → refresh → change_close）。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。
更早的版本（v0.4.x / v0.3 / v0.2 / v0.1） - **v0.4.1**：渲染器 v3 定稿（自由通道走线、viewBox 全几何自适应、API 直连、跨层聚合、缩放与悬停）； `normify_sync` 识别**未跟踪的新文件**（`git ls-files --others`）。 - **v0.4.0**：伴随开发（`state: pla

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-plugin-hot-reload

标题、简介、图标和浏览器模块都按磁盘现读现发布：改完立即生效，不用重启 DSH。

A DeepSeek Harness bundle. It replaces three cached resolvers with plain filesystem
walks, so a plugin's display metadata and browser module follow the package on disk
instead of a verdict cached for the life of the process:

| Service | Why it is patched |
| --- | --- |
| `pluginPackages.metaOf` | The Host resolves `locale/*.json` and `icon.svg` through the Node ESM resolver. A package whose export was added after its first read stays bare until restart. |
| `pluginManager.listBundles` | The plugin inventory calls the Host reader directly, so it needs the same disk result even when the Host already produced a fallback. |
| `clientModules.resolveMeta` / `locatePkgJson` | Verdicts are cached in `pkgMeta`, `null` included. Moving a linked package makes its browser half disappear. |

Install it into a profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add <path-to-this-checkout>
```

Editing another plugin's `locale/`, `icon.svg`, or manifest then needs only a page
refresh. Editing this plugin's own `index.js`, or adding a new importable subpath
export, still needs a restart: Node caches modules by URL.

## Test

```powershell
$env:DSH_RUNTIME = '<dsh-runtime>'
$env:DSH_PROFILE_DIR = '<profile-dir>'
node test/live.test.mjs
```

The check compares this reader against the Host reader for every package the profile
depends on, and reproduces the late-locale case.

# @raullenchai/dsh-provider

A native [Rapid-MLX](https://github.com/raullenchai/Rapid-MLX) provider for
[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) — so `dsh`
gets its model facts from the server instead of from whatever you typed into
`settings.yaml`.

[![CI](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

> **Status: published to npm** as
> [`@raullenchai/dsh-provider`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@raullenchai/dsh-provider).
> The end-to-end `dsh` run in [Verified](#verified) was on an M3 Ultra against

## What it does for you

DSH can already talk to a local Rapid-MLX server through its generic
`openai-completions` provider. That route works — but it knows nothing about
your model beyond what you hand-wrote:

```yaml
# what the generic route makes you maintain, by hand, per model
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    rapid-mlx:
      baseURL: http://localhost:8000/v1
      defaultContextWindow: 262144      # you looked this up. is it still right?
      models:
        - id: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
          contextWindow: 262144
          reasoningEfforts: {off: none, low: low, medium: medium, high: high}
```

Rapid-MLX's `/v1/models` already publishes all of that and more. This adapter
reads it, so:

**1. Nothing to hand-write, and nothing to re-write when you switch models.**
Swap what `rapid-mlx serve` is running and `dsh` follows. No re-running setup,
no stale numbers.

**2. The reasoning control tells the truth.** Rapid-MLX reports whether a model
actually has a reasoning parser. A model that can't reason no longer shows an
off/low/medium/high selector that does nothing.

**3. Compaction is timed with the capacity that actually fits this Mac, not a
number that drifted.** This is the one that quietly costs you.
`dsh-compaction-basic` asks the provider for the route's capacity and compacts
at `thresholdRatio × capacity` (0.8 by default). The provider prefers the
server's **`max_model_len`** — Rapid-MLX's memory-fitted ceiling (what fits in
unified memory: weights + KV cache), in the vLLM/SGLang-standard field — over
the native `context_window`, and falls back to `context_window` on an older
server that doesn't report it. So compaction is timed to what the machine can
actually hold, not the model's advertised window (which it may not have room
for) and not a hand-written number copied from another model.

## Install

Needs Node ≥ 22.15 (dsh imports Node's Zstd stream API without declaring it)
and a running Rapid-MLX server.

```sh
# From npm:
dsh plugin --profile web add @raullenchai/dsh-provider

# …or straight from source — the package ships plain JS with no build step:
dsh plugin --profile web add github:raullenchai/rapid-mlx-dsh-provider

export RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000/v1     # optional; this is the default
dsh web
```

Then point the agent at the route:

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: rapid-mlx
  model: qwen3.6-35b-8bit
```

Verified: that command installs and activates as a profile layer against
`dsh 0.1.0-rc.7`. To hack on it locally instead, see
[Local development](#local-development).

## Model management (v0.2.0)

Beyond the provider route, the plugin registers five tools and a `/rapid-mlx`
command so the agent can see and manage models without leaving the session.
The split follows which surface actually owns each fact: served-model facts
come from the structured HTTP `/v1/models`; the download cache and pull/remove
are CLI-only, so those — and only those — shell out to `rapid-mlx` through the
harness subprocess seam.

| Tool | Source | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `rapid_mlx_serving` | HTTP `/v1/models` | The model(s) served right now, deduped, with context window, reasoning/tool parsers, MoE/hybrid, and modalities. |
| `rapid_mlx_cached` | `rapid-mlx models --cached` | Downloaded models and their on-disk size. |
| `rapid_mlx_pull` | `rapid-mlx pull <name>` | Download a model (alias or HF repo id). Cancellable; no fixed deadline. |
| `rapid_mlx_remove` | `rapid-mlx rm -y <name>` | Delete a cached model to free disk. |
| `rapid_mlx_health` | HTTP + `rapid-mlx --version` | API up? CLI reachable? Reported as two independent facts. |

`/rapid-mlx` prints a one-shot overview: health, the served model and its facts,
and total cache disk usage.

The CLI is resolved from the `cliCommand` config (default `rapid-mlx` on
`PATH`, or `$RAPID_MLX_CLI`); set it to an absolute path if the binary is not on
the harness's `PATH`. `rapid_mlx_pull`/`rapid_mlx_remove` are the only tools
that change anything on disk, and they run non-interactively (`rm` is forced
with `-y` because the subprocess seam ignores stdin).

Against `dsh 0.1.0-rc.7` on an M3 Ultra:

- Installs and **activates as a profile layer** (no "declares no `dsh.bundle`"

- Registers the `rapid-mlx` route with `ctx.llm` and serves real queries.
- Plain chat, a single tool call, and the multi-step bug-fix task that gates

## Not done yet

Being explicit, because the point of the adapter is to *use* what the server
says and some of it is still only read:

- `recommended_sampling` — should be applied automatically per model.
- `tool_call_parser` — should let `dsh` fail fast on a model that cannot emit
  `tool_calls`, instead of looping.
- `is_hybrid` / `is_moe` / `capabilities` — read, not yet acted on.
- **Memory-aware capacity.** Today `resolveModel()` reports the model's
  *advertised* context window. On a Mac the real ceiling is unified memory, and
  reporting that instead is the biggest remaining win — it needs Rapid-MLX to
  expose a usable-capacity figure first.
- Images are not carried through `stream()` — but they now **refuse** with
  `LlmError(..., 'UNSUPPORTED')` rather than being dropped, per the cookbook.
  Text, reasoning and tool calls are carried.
- The route is registered as `rapid-mlx`. If your `settings.yaml` also declares
  a `rapid-mlx` provider under `llm-pi-ai`, the two compete for one route name
  (`registerAdapter` owns provider exclusivity). Use one or rename ours.

## Conformance with the official adapter contract

Built against
[`docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/main/docs/cookbook/adding-an-llm-adapter.md)
and its "protocol obligations" section. Each item has a test:

| Obligation | How it is met |
|---|---|
| `usage` before `finish`, nothing after `finish` | usage is buffered and flushed at end-of-stream, so a trailing usage-only chunk cannot reorder it |
| Tool-call `arguments` are raw JSON strings end to end | fragments stream as `argumentsDelta` and reassemble unparsed |
| Block indexes in first-seen order, reused per block | verified across a reasoning-then-text response |
| Errors take exactly two sanctioned paths | transport/protocol failures **throw** `LlmError` with a stable code; nothing ends the stream quietly |
| Honor `options.signal` | passed to `fetch` and to the SSE reader; an `AbortError` is re-thrown unchanged, not reclassified |
| A field the provider cannot honor throws `UNSUPPORTED` | image content refuses instead of being narrowed away |
| Config is a schemastery schema with env fallback | `export const Config`, fed from `cordis.patch.yml` via `!!js process.env.RAPID_MLX_BASE_URL` |

`finish.replayState` is not emitted: Rapid-MLX needs no native response ids
or signatures on follow-up calls, so there is nothing lossless to project.
